10.titulo: Spiritual mobility. The principle of spiritual searching.
10.texto: Our original principle affects our divine part; the zero that appears in second place is the original principle and the 1 is our divine part. God is found in our most material part thanks to our body. Here is our spiritual mobility: how much spirituality I bring into matter. The 0 = anything can be.
10.atlante: Ser muy flexible, estar dispuesto a atreverte. Tienes muchas posibilidades de movilidad espiritual, pero todavía no sabes cuál es la correcta.

11.titulo: Spiritual and mental strength and power, spiritual will made manifest.
11.texto: Trusting that the psychic forces are inside me. Trust, security. A number of strength. I can always strengthen myself, I can always improve, I can always go on growing. Trusting that the divine forces are coming towards me. The more I trust in my spiritual forces, the more the spiritual world will help me. The great prophets knew how to do it, people like Nostradamus, Hezekiah. They saw these spiritual forces of the cosmos and knew how to handle them.

12.titulo: Faith. Trust in God, Love takes me to God, to unity.
12.texto: This is blind trust, or faith in God. I have to feel loved by God, as the 2, child of God. 12 months of the year, 12 signs of the zodiac, the 12 apostles. At Chartres there is the marcaba, which has 12 sides, it is a geometric figure. This number speaks to us of carnal love, which is also divine love. Atlantean meaning. I trust in my divine part.

13.titulo: It is the number of change and transformation, death and resurrection.
13.texto: Cosmic number of light, decision and new beginning. New opportunities, sailing towards new ports. Giving yourself over to new things and pushing myself. I have to have the appetite and the motivation for a transformation.
13.atlante: Valor para hacer cambios, abrirme a nuevas cosas, avance, no anclarme en la monotonía.

14.titulo: It is the number of service to the community.
14.texto: Here the 4 heads towards the 1, that is, man in matter heads towards his divine part. Number of love for one's neighbour. Thinking of others. This calls for my spiritual balance. Start by understanding others and that way you will be able to love your neighbour. Not thinking only of our own gain.
14.atlante: Auto control, auto dominio, auto superación.

15.titulo: All human beings are my training partners, teamwork.
15.texto: Every human being is my training partner. Enrichment from every experience. Cosmic law of resonance. Being aware that I have to learn with others and that they are the ones who will bring out the good in me and the bad as well. For that I need to draw the devilish out of my thinking, the darkness. Changing my consciousness of the things that happen around me.
15.atlante: Sabiduría en la ley de resonancia.

16.titulo: The right spiritual focus in matter.
16.texto: It is a number of tension; with this number I have spirit and matter set against each other: if I cannot carry out my spiritual work in matter, I am going to get tense. You steer the action and do not let the action push you round and round. There are no problems, only processes of learning and experiences of life.
16.atlante: Sé la causa y no el efecto, aprender a soltarse y no querer controlar.

17.titulo: I see God in everything created and manifested.
17.texto: What is good, what is beautiful and what is noble. Looking at the beautiful and good side of things. Not always looking for the hair in the soup. Applying the functions of the 7 chakras in a positive way. Having a good time while we learn in this life. Not feeling sorry for anyone, but trying to see the positive side of people.
17.atlante: Verdad, fe, esperanza y auto estima.

18.titulo: Emotional cleansing of my lacks in order to reach God.
18.texto: Temptation. As above, so below. Cleaning the subconscious, trying to recognise my reactions in order to improve myself. Why do I repeat the same mistakes and the same patterns? Looking at what is hidden in the subconscious, which I do not perceive. This number encourages us to notice things we do not see. Drawing a conclusion from the mistakes so as to improve my attitude.
18.atlante: Limpiar el subconsciente para poder tener libertad del espíritu. Libertad divina.

19.titulo: It is the Essene number, To Help (To Serve), To Teach, To Heal.
19.texto: The number of healers. Helping, teaching and healing. But first we have to bear in mind that we have to heal ourselves too. Spiritual progress, being at peace with my soul. Feeling satisfaction in helping other living beings and so being at peace with my soul. I come to serve and help other human beings.
19.atlante: La paz del alma es la verdadera satisfacción. Tengo que escuchar mi alma.

20.titulo: It is the number of doubts. The task is to get past these doubts.
20.texto: Once again the zero leaves everything open so that it can have an effect on us. We doubt whether we could really have so many possibilities in front of us. The most important thing is that we are the ones who have to decide and realise that all these possibilities exist.
20.atlante: Nueva creación, hay muchas posibilidades, en la pareja y con las relaciones personales, está todo abierto.

21.titulo: It is the number of the radiant Sun inside us. Looking for God within yourself.
21.texto: God's presence comes towards us; being aware that God is always present. But this does not mean that he has to do the work for us. This is the number of the inner Sun and the radiant light. Joy of living, and being aware of your capacities.
21.atlante: La presencia de Dios, ser consciente que esa parte divina está en mi pareja, en mí y en los dos.

22.titulo: It is the Master number of Unconditional Love. 211
22.texto: 22 paths of initiation on the tree of life. With the wisdom of these 22 paths of initiation I can find the solution to my worldly problems. I analyse a difficult situation, I analyse it, I recognise the cause and the effect. The 22 tells us that nothing can be forced. You have to understand what lies behind it and flow with it; I am not alone. Not acting with violence, but with understanding.
22.atlante: vivir la vida de forma humana, ser maestro de mi propia vida, y seguir aprendiendo y enseñando.

23.titulo: It is the so-called Number of Isis. Receptiveness. Maximum fertility.
23.texto: Yin fertility, letting it happen. Number of the Virgin Mary, Isis, fertility. Letting the cosmos give us gifts and not only looking at how what we have in front of us does not suit us. Becoming aware that I, as a cosmic child, the 2, have to let the fertility of the cosmos soak into me and make me pregnant, or wrap me in its energy so that I feel the gifts that are there for me. Feeling deserving.
23.atlante: Número de Isis, tiene que ver con la fertilidad, la luna, lo femenino, la intuición.

24.titulo: The number of faith in Matter.
24.texto: Bearing in mind that matter is not all there is. That when we do not do things well, as a consequence we meet results that are not pleasant for us. When we stagnate in matter we have to work on spirituality; that is the way out. Above all, with this number it is matter that has an influence on us, and we have to work on the energy of the angels. There are other forces that can control and help with our problems.
24.atlante: La fe en la materia, dejarse de lo superficial, y poner equilibrio entre la parte material y la espiritual, pero es la materia quien viene para que yo aprenda.

25.titulo: Luck, fortune and happiness. Living the expression of your Soul. Positivity and joy.
25.texto: If this number is carried well, it brings us joy and happiness in personal relationships. That goes on generating good luck and satisfying results. The 5 is the soul and the 2 is me as a child, that is, when my soul has more room and can come closer to me, I begin to experience happiness. If this does not work, I feel empty and unhappy.
25.atlante: Es un número de suerte, felicidad verdadera.

26.titulo: It is the number of the Ego and duality.
26.texto: The longing to feel the soul closer and to be united with it, which unfortunately the rush and the never stopping make us drift further and further away from. What the soul wants us to feel, it does through longing and memory. Not getting into fights and creating good loving relationships; these have to go on growing together so that a good harmony comes about between them.
26.atlante: Añoranza por la armonía interior, encontrar la paz del espíritu.

27.titulo: Learning in an esoteric way, the esoteric student.
27.texto: Learning esoterically, looking for answers inside yourself; first you will have to learn that the answers are in you. Not changing anyone. I can only change myself and, through my example, others may change.

28.texto: I am responsible for myself. I have spiritual freedom so that fate does not steer me, but I steer it. Not leaving our responsibility in other people's hands. Constantly asking a lot of people what do you think? It is a mistake.
28.atlante: Libertad de mis pasos, yo soy responsable de mí misma y esa es mi libertad verdadera. Estructuras número 7.

29.titulo: It is the number of the mental labyrinth. Rigidity. Stubbornness. Mental inflexibility.
29.texto: Getting lost in spirituality or spiritually. I do not understand the world. Using intuition and intelligence. They have to get out of the dogmas that the family, parents or society have set on them. A spiritual labyrinth. To stop being lost in this labyrinth, they have to get out of that labyrinth, through consciousness of what is happening, through understanding. Only wisdom gets me out of my duality.
29.atlante: Encontrar mi salida, que no es la misma que la de los demás.

30.titulo: It is the number of unproductiveness, stagnation. Trapped in logic.
30.texto: With this number we cannot block ourselves when it comes to taking decisions. The original principle is the 3, cosmic productivity; the decisive thing has happened, that is, the decision has been taken. The son has been born. Nothing has been decided yet, everything is open. Decisions cannot be put off any longer. Daring, and not seeing decisions with a fear of getting it wrong but as learning. Here the decisions may be in the home and the family.
30.atlante: Decisiones con prisas, hay que hacer movimientos rápidos.

31.titulo: God guides us. God guides my path so that I can be fertile.
31.texto: Here the 1 gets going, God personally. God guides us. He gives us support and strength, but the decisions I have to take myself. God's power to make things real, but that power is already inside me. I have to develop ideas so that I can motivate myself; I must trust that in matter I can carry these ideas through in order to get results. Learning the divine strength that is in us.
31.atlante: Tengo éxito si me dejo guiar por Dios, él me va a empujar a tomar decisiones. Debo dejarme.

32.titulo: Number of love for one's neighbour. Giving yourself to other people.
32.texto: I need the doubt, in order to think more intensely and reaffirm myself, so as to take the decision. Only with the doubts am I able to have alternatives to steer by. Turning towards others. It means trusting people because they are my training partners, not hiding, because if it is not with people I cannot evolve. Often there are people who become a burden to us; just have the understanding that they are there so that I can learn.
32.atlante: Amor al prójimo, voy a ser capaz de disolverme mis propias dudas.

33.titulo: The highest productivity. Teaching others to manifest their gifts.
33.texto: Taking decisions even when there are people against us; here you need a lot of strength to take the decisions. We have to show confidence in order to take these decisions. These are decisions with powerful strength. Jesus took the decision not to run away and to stay and be humiliated; this was a decision that took a lot of strength for him. Above all, when you have to convince others that it is for the best.
33.atlante: El número de Jesús el maestro, número de mucha fuerza.

34.titulo: Matter is the means for fulfilling myself by sharing my gifts.
34.texto: The fear of matter makes us feel tied to it and unable to take spiritual decisions, since if matter is missing, we feel empty. Pressure on ourselves. If I decide spiritually, I will feel free. If I take decisions with a spiritual bearing, the pressure around me will go.
34.atlante: Vitalidad liberadora, decide espiritualmente y te sentirás libre.

35.titulo: Negative people. Getting past the mistaken beliefs about yourself.
35.texto: Looking at our negative attitudes on certain points: money, health, love, and so on. A positive attitude towards the fear of seeing the future as uncertain, not saying: «I can't». To dissolve the negative attitude I need the strength of decision to get it out of my head. That is why it is the soul that helps me see my focus from inside. The soul wants to have a direct connection towards us in order to help us.

36.titulo: Number of the shadows, fears and lacks. Fear of your own shadows.
36.texto: Taking the decision that my joy of living should be alive in my life. But this joy of living is inside me, not outside. This joy does not depend on any person, only on my goals. A number of tension. I have to bring light into matter; in my relationship with a partner the tensions are needed so that I can improve myself and bring light into my darkest part. Looking at where my joy comes from, from inside or from outside, because I have to be well in order to give company and love to others.
36.atlante: Déjate guiar por tu corazón y por tus instintos y no te tenses por tu mente. Número del hombre animal.

37.texto: Bearing in mind that life is full of possibilities, not sitting around waiting too long and accepting what life brings; why wait any longer. If I have many possibilities, I first have to be honest with myself and know what it is that I want. With this number, waiting a long time to take the decision can be a mistake. It affects all the 5s of the energetic structure. Being spontaneous. Feeling the energy of the 7 chakras.
37.atlante: Perdón, voluntad, creatividad, amor, expresión, claridad, reconexión.

38.titulo: Commitment to my plan so as to give the best of myself.
38.texto: Important decisions for me, how to organise myself well so as to have time for myself. Changing the thoughts of lack means trusting that the cosmos will bring me the money to do such a course or to do such a thing, not thinking negatively in advance. These decisions that are healing for me are always taken from the spiritual focus and with the freedom the 8 gives us.

39.titulo: Active wisdom. Productive fertility. The strength of wisdom.
39.texto: When there is a feeling that a decision weighs heavily — for example, leaving a job, a relationship, moving country, and so on. They can only be taken with certainty when the feeling inside is so strong that it takes us in that direction; if motivation is missing and there is a lot of doubt, it is not the right one. Here wisdom is needed in order to take them, and that is why inner motivation matters. Number of enthusiasm. Breadth of view — that is wisdom, and not stagnating in the face of the decision.
39.atlante: Quitar el sentimiento de sentirse responsable y escuchar lo que me hace feliz, porque justo es esa la decisión sabia, que no tiene por qué gustar a todo el mundo.

40.titulo: It is the number of rational limitation.
40.texto: We have to react irrationally. The part that is schooling or influence is not there; we have to step out of the square and out of what is imposed. Make your thoughts and wishes real in matter, carry through everything you can achieve. Everything is open, in your worldly part, so do not limit yourself. Use your qualities and do not block yourself by thinking rationally, open up.
40.atlante: Abre las puertas que la educación y la sociedad te han cerrado.

41.titulo: Spiritual life made material. Bringing spirituality into matter.
41.texto: A lot of people do not start new things out of fear of the beginning; above all they think that every beginning is very hard. So they put off what God wants for them, because of that negative thought. This number teaches us that everything is achieved step by step, and that we cannot get hooked on being unwell and settling for what we have out of fear of starting something new. Trusting that, even if it goes slowly, you are always moving forward, above all if we are able not to settle for what we do not want. Every beginning is hard (negative thought). Yes to beginnings.
41.atlante: Dios quiere que disfrutes de la materia sin miedo a perderlo. Evolucionar paso a paso.

42.texto: I give love and expect nothing back. This number of unconditional love speaks of being open-handed, generous, and of not being afraid that if I give I may be left with nothing. You have to trust that God will reward you. The son. That is, I want to experience love in matter, or in a more material way, and how do I experience it best? Giving and expecting nothing.

43.titulo: It is the number of the pioneers, the innovators.
43.texto: New paths, not being afraid of the new and above all of being the first to try it. Getting out of monotony and being able to work my brain so it does not fall asleep. For example, going down a staircase backwards; my material part does not want to sink into monotony. The pioneer's number needs excitements and surprises. Challenges always suit them; what they are testing is whether they will be able.
43.atlante: Soy capaz y me lo voy a proponer por mí mismo.

44.titulo: Self-fulfilment in matter. Teaching others to be happy in matter.
44.texto: Not being afraid of myself and being able to let others really see you, baring the soul. Another number of great strength, since I have to express myself, that is, just as I am. I want to feel better with my body, with my place here on this earth, and that is why, both when I am well and when I am unwell, I need to have my own expression and to lose the fear of not being accepted. Anchoring my feet firmly in the earth.
44.atlante: Expresar desde mi propio ser, para ser cada vez un poco más yo mismo.

45.titulo: Expressing the I Am. Manifesting the expression of my Soul, my I Am.
45.texto: My soul wants to express itself closer and closer and I have to make room for it from my most material side. If I listen to my soul, it will tell me where I should head and what my qualities are. Getting out of the wrong roles and living more and more inside my own essence. When this number is carried well it wakes a lot of envy. Because we are very authentic. Number of authenticity.
45.atlante: Mi alma quiere gobernar, quiere crecer más en mi interior, ejercer más influencia sobre mi cuerpo.

46.titulo: Getting past the risk of being trapped in matter because of your ego.
46.texto: Being delicate, gentle and loving, having empathy and not getting tense. Try to make others understand and grasp what you want to get across to them, however hard that is. Not criticising them when they block and do not understand. Taking tensions away between people and bringing them understanding.
46.atlante: Número de la diplomacia, proceder de forma cuidadosa.

47.titulo: It is the number of Karma. Accepting my tasks.
47.texto: Going through experiences until one has understood. I want to resolve my learning processes in this life. The cosmos is fair with us and gives us the chance again and again until we have understood. With the 199 the tasks of karma are already bigger and there can be more tension. We do not have to learn by suffering; understanding and consciousness will make us learn in a relaxed way and with acceptance. Very brave souls in the energetic structure. «I am going to help you resolve your karma».
47.atlante: Número del karma, es decir, de cerrar ciclos de aprendizaje.

48.titulo: My fears and lacks limit me in matter.
48.texto: Putting my spiritual freedom into action. We belong to nobody and we are all free; even our children are not ours. But to know and understand this I have to recognise for myself that, although I am material because I have a body, I am light and I will return to the same place I came from. I have to change the chip so as to leave other people free and be left free myself. Recognising that I am free.
48.atlante: Libertad del espíritu al expresarme, pero también dejar a los demás que expresen su forma de vivir.

49.titulo: Opening myself to wisdom and making it the ground of my actions.
49.texto: Not making excuses when I know what I ought to do and do not do it, because I say «I can't do it right now». We need a lot of honesty, to know, to feel that we do not do things because we do not trust ourselves, not because it is not the moment. The wisdom inside me wants to come out but I do not let it, I limit it with my material part. Not making up pretexts and excuses.
49.atlante: Comprender que en mí está la sabiduría y llevarla a cabo con mis actos.

50.texto: The soul wants to show itself, and it is the soul that wants to prevail over the body, over the confused mind. But my zero brings me insecurity, that is, no, I do not have the security that anyone can help me. Even if we know nothing about the soul, it wants to become matter, so there will be a lot of pain if I do not let it soak into me.
50.atlante: Mi sensibilidad me puede hacer sufrir. No estás solo.

51.titulo: I recognise that I am spirit and unity and I manifest it.
51.texto: Balancing justice: I have to accept my dark side, because only then will I be able to clean and work my sides so that my soul can reach God. With the things that happen to us it is the same, I have to accept the conflicts as part of my training and trust in a balancing justice. With this number we have to accept that it does not matter that others do not accept us, but rather to recognise myself so that I can go on learning. It is God who turns to my soul to soak it in union.
51.atlante: El enriquecimiento con otras almas, me acerca a Dios.

52.titulo: It is the number of vulnerability. Excess of emotionality.
52.texto: I have to forget the wounds, what has hurt me. To be able to feel again I have to forgive, since, if I do not forgive and do not feel out of fear, I can block my soul's approach towards my part of God. If I am blocked, I will not be able to feel the messages and the language of my soul. I need personal relationships and relationships with a partner in order to heal myself.
52.atlante: Número de la vulnerabilidad. Desnuda tu alma sin miedo.

53.titulo: Being productive in a positive way from the Soul. Offering something from my soul. Being selfless.
53.texto: The number of salt, the «salt of life». Teaching without pride, and being able to be willing to learn from others. Do good and do not let others praise you, and do not boast about being the best. Pride is not needed and humility matters with this number. I come to help, but I as a man have no merit in it. It is God and the beings of light who lend me their strength. Flattery does not make me worse nor does abuse make me better; I am who I am before God.

54.texto: The soul suffers when we act only through matter, but it has to reach its destination in spite of the obstacles. Knowing that when there are things about others that bother me, to look at where I reflect this in i. What happens to me: what has it got to do with me? With this number the soul opens the door for us so that we do not throw in the towel when we are tired, so that we go on believing in matter.
54.atlante: Mi alma está cansada, por la experiencia de la materia.

55.titulo: It is the Master number of self-recognition. Teaching this.
55.texto: The answers are inside me. A number of strength and of luck. The strength does not come from God, nor from my human part: it comes from my soul. Bearing in mind that what I learn in this life is for my own benefit, not seeing it as a burden; only I, that is, my soul, can make use of this. Being a good esoteric student, knowing that what I learn in this life is for my own benefit. If I trust in this, my soul will give me answers that come only from inside me, so that I can get past the obstacles.
55.atlante: El alumno de esta escuela de vida, seguir aprendiendo ya que es lo que me voy a llevar cuando esté plano.

56.titulo: Getting past the ego takes me to the Soul. Duality. Lower Self / Higher Self.
56.texto: I need to find the balance between my Yin side and my Yang side in order to take the tensions out of my body; those tensions limit my soul's ability to act in my processes. This number tells us that we must not let anyone throw us off our rhythm or upset us so much that the tension is bigger than the search for the soul. The bad thing about this is that the person does not realise that their own tension and stress do not let their soul act.
56.atlante: Buscar las cosas que me quiten tensión, desbloquear mi energía para tener fluidez.

57.titulo: It is the number of the healer.
57.texto: Working with the 7 chakras, understanding the emotions behind them. Being well means having an influence on other people. Here the energy and strength of the 7 chakras are needed, in order to bring the qualities out into the light, because other human beings need healing.
57.atlante: Querer llegar a la perfección humana. Trabajar los chakras.

58.titulo: Manifest your Soul Plan in order to recognise and accept yourself.
58.texto: How I come to feel my soul depends on me, but I have to take out the things that limit me so as to feel free. Fears limit us and stop us feeling the soul's messages. The advice for the 58 is meditation, reflecting on what things stop me getting there: my partner, work, my circle of friends, and so on. Often upbringing and the way it should be make us lose the natural freedom of talking with our inner being. Our child.
58.atlante: Llegar al alma a través del niño interno, de la infancia. Salir de toda influencia que me impida sentir a mi alma. Llegar al alma a través de la libertad espiritual y la vida.

59.texto: The prophet is inside me; careful with self-inflicted prophecies. The soul wants to go on healing and growing; only when the wisdom of the 9 reaches my lama will I then have full consciousness of my being. The five, that is, my soul, is waiting for all the wisdoms of my lives that I need in order to become conscious of what I am and what I need.
59.atlante: El profeta, para tener equilibrio emocional tengo que curar mis otras vidas y mi pasado.

60.titulo: Getting past the limitations of the ego.
60.texto: Living the longing to return to God. At some point this number touches all of us; a moment comes when we have to feel that longing. I have to be balanced and not get tense, but let its energy flow and trust. I am who I am. «Check yourself and relax». I have to work on spirituality and matter.
60.atlante: Anhelo de encontrar a Dios y de volver a casa.

61.titulo: It is the number of the transformation of the sexual forces into spiritual forces.
61.texto: I AM WHO I AM. The 1 goes towards the 6, God draws near. The one brings balance to the six; balance means that the divine forces are heading my way and want to have an effect. If I do not get tense and let it flow I fill up with strength. «God wants to influence me». The sexual forces are transformed into spiritual forces. Sexual satisfaction and spiritual satisfaction.
61.atlante: La energía sexual me desbloquea y trae a mi vida felicidad. 62- Número de la dualidad. Transformar la dualidad en amor. 2/31-C26-T17-L79-P283 El número de la maduración necesaria. Que la dualidad no me impida la armonía y la alegría. La persona vive intentando decidir lo que es mejor para ella en su vida u orientación espiritual. Quiero saber quién soy, dónde está mi sitio gracias al otro. Significado Atlante: No dejarme presionar por mi pareja, yo tengo que descubrir quién soy.

63.titulo: If I manifest my gifts I tame the instincts of the ego.
63.texto: The 3 begins to be a son, it speaks to us of the son. Not getting tense. The best alternative decides; there are alternatives, but I must not get tense. Choose what is best for you. Weigh it up and decide: what is your experience of life? The decision about your course is your happiness. «Always choose what is best for you».
63.atlante: Decisiones que nos presionan para forzar a cerrar ciclos.

64.titulo: Power in matter. Handling power badly in matter.
64.texto: Through matter I have an effect on myself and on others. Exercising power, bringing matter to my body and not getting tense about the physical things of the body and of matter. Acting with compassion. I need matter in order to learn and to balance my Yin and Yang parts.
64.atlante: Necesita aceptarme físicamente, y saber dónde está mi lugar en este mundo. Soltar la rigidez. Efecto en mí y en otro. Elimina la magia negra, “el poder de la intención”.

65.titulo: It is a number of identity crisis.
65.texto: Five: the soul comes closer to my matter to relax me, to enter me completely with its influence. The psychic strength comes when I let my soul act and trust that it knows very well what I need, «to use it for good». The more I let it come closer, the more I can help.
65.atlante: No tener miedo a perder el control. El alma nos hace ser espontáneos, sobre todo al disfrutar de las pequeñas cosas.

66.titulo: Danger of getting hooked on matter. Not only on material goods (money), but they can also be emotional attachments.
66.texto: they can also be emotional attachments. 2/33-3/22-6/11-M15-M51-C11-T11-L77-P313 When I evolve spiritually, matter comes on its own. I cannot look for my joy of living only in material things. Trusting the divine forces and not getting tense about being mentally trapped in material thoughts. It is a double tension, important to relax. Very rigid people.
66.atlante: La tensión por entregarse a los demás, relajarse disfrutando con la pareja. Superar la energía sexual sin prejuicios.

67.titulo: Healing the ego, refinement in order to get past the limitations of the ego.
67.texto: The number of testing, of distrust. If my distrust is big enough I stay stuck in checking, and that means I end up distrusting from the outset. Then I cannot use the energy of the 7 chakras, they get tense or blocked. When we are carrying the energy of distrust towards the other person, I get tense and my chakras do not flow, they tense up. It has the opposite effect on me. Here, from the outset, something active has to be done so that others feel they can trust. Working on unblocking the chakras.
67.atlante: Mi tensión puede hacer que me cierre a ver lo bonito en otros seres humanos. Confiar y por lo menos probar, intentarlo.

68.titulo: The joy of living. Harmony and self-responsibility make me free.
68.texto: The number of stubbornness. We find it hard to see what is real in us because we are afraid. Looking at my fears and working on them. Here I can put tension on my freedom and if I stay shut inside my fear I am no longer free, not really. Not facing things — it makes you tense. Working on courage. You have to be careful about laying a lot of fog over yourself; sometimes we do not want to face a situation that is tense, and we say: nothing is going on here, and we look the other way.
68.atlante: Yo soy libre y mi alma quiere que yo sienta que en verdad lo único que me limita son las influencias de la sociedad.

69.titulo: Through the sum of all the wisdoms I want to reach balance.
69.texto: I need my wisdom especially in very hard and very tense moments. Making the effort to see what is really happening in those difficult moments or situations. Wisdom comes towards our tension and reminds us to learn from experiences and that the same thing does not have to happen again.
69.atlante: No te cierres a seguir aprendiendo, todo acaba, todo comienza y eso siempre es una nueva oportunidad.

70.titulo: It is the number of inner exile.
70.texto: Our original principle affects our divine part; the zero that appears in second place is the original principle and the 1 is our divine part. «I have plenty of chances of reaching perfection with that learning». God is found in our most material part thanks to our body. Here is our spiritual mobility: how much spirituality I bring into matter. Not blaming yourself, knowing how to live with your weaknesses. You have to discover your abilities and ask for help when it is needed.
70.atlante: Siempre somos libres para decidir, la libertad es un regalo que Dios nos da a todos y es mediante ella que llegamos a la perfección.

71.titulo: It is the number of Jesus. Consciousness on Earth, making contact from my 1.
71.texto: I am already perfect, let God come. They have been close to Jesus. Trusting that the psychic forces are inside me. Trust, security. I can always strengthen myself, I can always improve, I can always go on growing. The more I trust in my spiritual forces, the more the spiritual world will help me. The great prophets knew how to do it, people like Nostradamus, Hezekiah. They saw these spiritual forces of the cosmos and knew how to handle them.
71.atlante: Es el número del Cristo. De la fuerza de energía de Amor y de Dios en mí. Ejemplo de Cristo.

72.titulo: Number of wisdom. Applying the cosmic laws to my life.
72.texto: Applying wisdom through reason, which would be the corresponding cosmic law. I have to try to apply the spiritual laws in my life. Wisdom and reason. Logic is not the same as wisdom.
72.atlante: Mi pareja me ayuda a ser equilibrado y perfecto, me ayuda a verme en su espejo y saber qué es lo que tengo que perfeccionar en mí.

73.texto: The number of decisions full of wisdom. Bring the irrational side into your decisions. This number is in direct contact with the tree of life. A capacity to apply consciously the 22 paths of initiation of the kabbalistic tree, once again so that I can pick myself up and go on learning. There are no mistakes, everything is fine. «Do not let the rational part come out», very demanding people. It is good for them to walk the Camino de Santiago.

74.titulo: It is the number of the pilgrim. Learning through the experience of life.
74.texto: Learning through the experience of life: from experience we know our limit, and what we cannot control. They have to handle money, matter. Walking consciously along the paths of our life. Letting matter teach me and not closing myself off from it. My perfection, learning through people and through conflicts.
74.atlante: La materia es necesaria para mi evolución. Yo soy un ser de luz con un cuerpo material. Sabiduría según las experiencias vividas, necesito ser material, más práctico. Vienen a probar mucho la materia, debes vivir bien con el dinero.

75.titulo: Number of The Source, of luck and happiness.
75.texto: Happiness and luck. My soul wants to reach my being and fill it so that I can reach my perfection and my union, soul and being. Accepting myself. Sometimes they need space and solitude. As children they may have had to protect themselves from an adult. Here I want to learn to use the energy of my 7 chakras. My soul is going to see to it that people come to me to help me with this. You have to be careful not to be afraid of closeness.
75.atlante: Mi alma quiere acercarse un poco más a mí, el perdón, el amor, la expresión, la voluntad, son dones en los cuales ella quiere apoyarse. Mi alma va a procurar que lleguen personas que me ayuden en esto.

76.texto: Here we have to catch it ourselves before we can pass it on to others. If I find balance in certain situations in my life, then I reach, or come closer to, my 7, my perfection. The key to human perfection is not getting tense in difficult situations and acting with balance and control. Not getting tense, not being so serious, taking things more lightly.
76.atlante: Las tensiones del exterior llegan a mí. Soy yo quien no reacciono ante ellas y sólo dejo que me traspasen, confianza.

77.titulo: Trusting what you feel. Trusting the strength of your wisdom. It is the perpetual motion of energy and of spirit.
77.texto: of energy and of spirit. 7/11-M16-M61-C22-T22-L99-P383 These people feel everything with more and more urgency. This number is the perfect vehicle of the spirit. A concrete state of wisdom. Being open to learning a little more every time, so that next time I will have and know something more. When you have a certain wisdom things are felt better. A number of competitiveness, I want to become the best. They want to finish cycles perfectly.
77.atlante: Tener amor hacia mí mismo y no exigirme más de lo que puedo. Las ganas de hacerlo todo perfecto pueden hacerme sufrir. Tengo que entender que ya soy perfecto, dentro de mis limitaciones de humano, Dios me hizo perfecto.

78.texto: We are back with spiritual freedom. Applying your capacities consciously, so as to reach your perfection step by step. Do what you believe is important for you. You do not have to justify yourself to anyone. Looking for your quality, the thing that makes you feel good. What ability?
78.atlante: Saber lo que es la verdadera libertad del espíritu, si no somos como niños, no sabremos lo que es la libertad.

79.texto: I do not have to use violence, nor speak with violence. I do not have to fight for my rights; it is enough to know that I am right. Accepting myself with wisdom and understanding. Complete separation from the wrong government.
79.atlante: Yo quiero actuar con astucia y armonía, con habilidad hacia mí misma, sentir que en mí se haya la Fuente de la Sabiduría.

80.titulo: Limitation of your own freedom. Limiting yourself mentally. Not moving spiritually.
80.texto: The 80s have to do with spiritual freedom, or with testing one's own freedom. If it shows up, our spiritual freedom was cut off in another life (God could not be spoken of. Do I really have this spiritual freedom? Am I free? Recognising your freedom so that you can rise to great heights. It is like a bird in a cage: even though the door is open for it to fly out freely, it does not recognise its freedom and goes on fluttering around the cage.
80.atlante: De nuevo Dios me recuerda que soy libre, que todo puede ser, y que sólo es mi responsabilidad lo que yo decido.

81.titulo: The number of liberation from fears. God helps me and frees me from my fears.
81.texto: The number of liberation. This is like a call to God. God helps me and frees me from my fears and from all the nonsense I think. If we were conscious of our fears and of everything we think, I believe we would call on God several times during the day. We think wrongly, we judge, we criticise… Our cage? Out with limiting thoughts, «God is going to help me». Trust.
81.atlante: Dios viene hacia mí para decirme una y otra vez que yo no estoy hecho de limitaciones, que yo soy luz y la luz vuela muy rápido.

82.titulo: Facing my doubts and living my Soul plan.
82.texto: Calling one's own state into question. This means that we constantly have a concrete state, physically, mentally and spiritually; it is not for a long time, but if it is an unpleasant state, 10 minutes are too long. «I live to please others» — a mistake. All of us want to get our spiritual freedom. The first step is for me to recognise the need for me to be able to develop, grow and evolve myself through my spiritual freedom. The 41 tells us that every beginning is hard. Making them conscious: serving others makes us happy, but first I have come to myself. A need to go on developing and growing. Deep down they distrust themselves.
82.atlante: Mi pareja está conmigo y me enseña la luz y la oscuridad de mi ser. Es mi libertad que alimenta a uno o al otro.

83.titulo: It is the number of the Messiah. Spiritual decisions that take me to my spiritual freedom.
83.texto: The number of the Messiah, or to put it another way, the miracle of prayer. What this is about here is taking spiritual decisions in order to evolve spiritually, or perhaps better put, with cosmic evolution; cosmic evolution is completely personal. With cosmic evolution comes the addition that I have to give myself to my surroundings. When I have withdrawn completely into myself, then I am no longer joined to this part of the Cosmos at all. Finding the path through prayer, through the heart, talking a lot with God. They want to set an example. The Our Father in Aramaic helps them take decisions.
83.atlante: Las decisiones vienen a mí para que me sienta con la capacidad de poder dirigir mi vida, y mis metas. Tengo la libertad de poder decidir sobre mi vida.

84.titulo: Manifesting my Soul plan by means of my actions in matter.
84.texto: Actions have an effect on my spiritual freedom, material decisions. What must I do in order to be free? Not getting attached, but enjoying matter. Money does not set you free, but it calms you down. Finding freedom through actions. Not getting hooked on matter. We humans in matter are independent.
84.atlante: La materia viene hacia mí para que aprenda de ella, y pueda saborearla sin quedarme apegado a ella.

85.titulo: My soul guides me towards freedom.
85.texto: If I believe in the soul and I cannot reach it, it cannot guide me. The soul only shows us what is good and all it cares about is that we evolve and do not limit ourselves spiritually, whatever our society, dependency, religion, and so on. What is beautiful, what is good, what is noble: if I only think negatively I am missing contact with the soul. A need to spend more time in nature.
85.atlante: Mi alma quiere que yo reconozco la esencia de su energía, para que pueda desbloquear todo aquello que me impide ser libre.

86.titulo: Accepting my learning tasks in matter lovingly opens the doors to my own freedom.
86.texto: freedom. 2/43-C68-T31-L117-P439 Getting past the obstacles, daring to do new things. It is 2/43, which is the number of the pioneer, walking new paths. The 3 is decision and the 4 is matter, and the 86 is a higher energy. The 43: dare to do something new for your spiritual freedom. It may be a trauma; what kind of blockage stops me being free? Open to new things, not getting tense. Encouraging them to do something new: change it, dare.
86.atlante: La tensión puede venir hacia mí y bloquearme si yo no establezco unas bases de vida que me hagan sentirme único y especial.

87.titulo: Getting people out of their labyrinths with perfection. It is a healing number.
87.texto: It is a healing number just like the 19: helping, teaching and healing. 3/29 a spiritual labyrinth. My freedom is cut off because I cannot see the way out. They need to get themselves out of their labyrinth and to get others out.
87.atlante: La perfección y las ganas de volver a Dios vienen hacia mí y yo decido si dejo que ese sentimiento me influya.

88.titulo: It is the master number of spiritual freedom. The Fool.
88.texto: Other people's freedom and one's own. Do not overdo spiritual freedom or you turn into an illusionist, that is, do not become someone who lives permanently among illusions. Here are the technicians, or the people who can find very creative solutions in very difficult situations, who are the people with a free head. «Nobody can tell you what you have to do». We have here a person who is far ahead of their time, for example Leonardo da Vinci. 8/11 strength on the 3 planes: material, mental and spiritual.
88.atlante: Mi libertad me da armonía interior, pero mi libertad termina donde empieza la de los demás.

89.titulo: Here I use all my spiritual wisdom to keep myself spiritually free, balanced.
89.texto: If we limit ourselves just when things get hard, then the problems come; I limit myself. When I take the freedom to try something new, it really works very well and gives a feeling of joy. Being wise when it comes to choosing people, because of the emotions they bring on.
89.atlante: La sabiduría que está en los demás viene a mí y me da oportunidad para nutrirme con experiencias de otras personas. Es mi libertad quien decide, si aprender o no.

90.texto: With the 90s wisdom goes first. Understanding all the definitions of all the original principles from 1 to 8 and using them properly. The demand of not wanting any compromise. Many commitments to stability limit my evolution completely (a partner).
90.atlante: Está todo abierto, de nuevo puede crear nuevos pensamientos, puedo por mi madurez, pensar distinto y crear de nuevo unas buenas bases.

91.titulo: It is the number of the Universe. The universal cosmic connection.
91.texto: We are not only a part of the Universe; we are also built into the Universe. For the 91 it is important to be connected with many people, and if they withdraw fully consciously and almost live like a Hermit, they will fall ill. If they have path 16 (The Tower), things get complicated because it asks them to be responsible before a group. Number of the leader: being responsible before a group, helping them.
91.atlante: Dios quiere que con su presencia yo me expanda un poco más. Que siga aprendiendo y experimentando. Dios me rodea para que lo vea en más personas.

92.titulo: The number of incalculable intelligence. I have all the wisdom inside me, but I do not say it.
92.texto: People who have a very great potential, but have it asleep. Worse if they know they have it but deny it. Intelligent people who do not know what to do with so much intelligence. At school they do not feel like doing anything. I have everything in me, but I do not know how to live it. Very intelligent people, they will pass any course of study. Trying to bring the wisdom out.
92.atlante: Mi personalidad quiere coger un equilibrio. Sólo puedo sentir quien soy yo verdaderamente cuando me escucho y me siento a mí mismo.

93.titulo: I take decisions that lead me to wisdom. They are the cosmically productive decisions that lead me to experience my inner wisdom.
93.texto: lead me to experience my inner wisdom. 3/31-C39-T48-L141-P479 Higher wisdom if I trust in God. Trusting that God with his creation is going to do everything possible to help me, but what he is not going to do is carry me through life in his arms so that I have a quiet life. Take decisions that lead you to wisdom. Cosmically productive decisions. Trusting that he is going to help you, decisions from inside. Trusting = Letting go.
93.atlante: Las decisiones vienen de nuevo a mi vida, se tratan de decisiones que requieren de mi parte unos momentos de reflexión y de recuerdo de mis experiencias de vida.

94.titulo: Carrying out actions in order to recognise wisdom, doing something in order to find wisdom. I need many experiences in matter in order to reach wisdom.
94.texto: many experiences in matter in order to reach wisdom. 2/47-C49-T49-L143-P487 Falling flat on your face over and over is called the turn of the fallen; it is like trying to go through a wall head first. It is 2/47, the number of Karma. There is a karmic background. The 94 shows us that we often learn through suffering. Sharing wisdom, helping other beings materially by saying what I know; I can help them with my wisdom.
94.atlante: Es la materia quien quiere influenciarme para que desde mi parte de experiencia yo sepa lo que es más importante para mí en estos momentos.

95.titulo: Man experiences his wisdom guided by his soul.
95.texto: The soul is at stake. The motto of the Essenes matters here. A person grows out of their wisdom, guided by their soul. This has a great advantage, because if I follow my soul, my soul sees to it that I get so much recognition that little by little, but in a balanced way, I am going to become, along with other people, someone wiser. Growing and evolving. 5/19, helps people, animals and plants.
95.atlante: Es el alma quien quiere acercarse y tratar de hacernos sentir, que la sabiduría no tiene nada que ver con el conocimiento.

96.titulo: Using Yin-Yang energy with courage, with decision, in order to reach the highest wisdom.
96.texto: Using Yin and Yang courageously leads me to wisdom, and Yin and Yang always in harmony. Tension teaches me that there is something in me that is not right. Taking the tension away with my wisdom.
96.atlante: A través de mi sabiduría interior, aprendo a soltarme y relajarme. De esta manera los bloqueos desaparecen.

97.titulo: It is the absolute master number, acting from the example, being the example.
97.texto: With your human perfection you have to reach your wisdom. That wisdom has been in you for a long time and now the question is: when is someone really a Master? The 97 is an important point. A Master always does what he says with Mastery, which means acting by example. He is an example of life for others.
97.atlante: Mi perfección o mi superación me invade para que no me duerma y siga creciendo mi vida.

98.titulo: I apply my spiritual freedom in order to recognise new wisdoms.
98.texto: The Cosmos is infinite, and therefore knowledge about the Cosmos is infinitely great too, whatever my definition of a Master may be; we can always evolve a little further with our knowledge, which of course means that I have to want to evolve.
98.atlante: Yo tengo todas las respuestas en mi interior, sólo tengo que serenarme y liberarme de pensamientos de carencia que me limitan.

99.titulo: A purely spiritual task. The sum of all my wisdoms in order to wake all my potential.
99.texto: It is about getting past temptation (egos-attachments). In life nothing is a temptation for me, I know exactly the situation I am in now. Every thought is realised instantly — you can imagine. What does this mean? Always following the motto «the spirit rules or controls matter». There is a lot of light, and therefore a lot of darkness. It is the number of the Christic Force.
99.atlante: Una cosa es la experiencia que me enseña y otra son las enseñanzas generales que nos ofrece el cosmos.

100.titulo: I do not know how to find my true calling.
100.texto: Being twice the 50, the definition of the 50 is taken.

101.titulo: A calling that takes me to unity.
101.texto: The number of sanctification. It is about healing the inside, becoming a Saint or being sanctified. There is something in the subconscious that needs healing. There may be something dark: sanctify it and help it to heal. Dissolve what is devilish, do not take it away. Do not dissolve it or erase it step by step. The best solution is to think about it, to find little by little what the cause of it is and to change my thoughts on that particular subject.

102.titulo: A calling in which I can channel all the love and compassion I carry inside.
102.texto: They are the discoverers and the co-creators. There are people who, whatever the subject, always discover something new. On the tree of life, they are the ones with a special creative energy, and 102 is the portal of energy 10 in the energetic structure, the calling in place of a profession, and here you have to be very creative to find your calling. Path number 13, Death. Energy to invent, to discover, very creative.

103.titulo: A creative calling in which I can share my gifts.
103.texto: The number of the dissolution of the negative. It is not enough only to criticise, nor is it enough to stop criticising at some point: the task is achieved by doing something positive. Constructive criticism. Expressing the idea positively. Healers by nature, psychologists, therapists.

104.titulo: It is the number of the technologist who offers technical solutions for humanity. In negative it is the so-called cold technician or technocrat.
104.texto: the so-called cold technician or technocrat. 2/52-4/26-8/13-C40-T59-L163-P563 The number of the cold technician. The word technocrat means that these are people who trust only in technique; for these people human matters are completely unknown. Great organisers, practical. Good with their hands. The 104 is also the limitation of Nature; these are the people who take it for granted that nature is being wounded or harmed — this is the green party, working as a defender of the rights of living beings.

105.titulo: A calling in which I determine my own truth. It is the number of the Priest or the Priestess.
105.texto: Priestess. 3/35-5/21-7/15-C50-T50-L155-P569 Having a sanctifying effect (through religion). This sanctifying effect does not hold for one person only but for many. Binding yourself back to God and helping other people look for that connection. Freedom through religion. A leader, good advisers.

106.titulo: A calling in which I can channel selfless service.
106.texto: Motivators, encouragement, «salt of life», good at teaching.

107.titulo: It is the number of the psychic therapist.
107.texto: This person is going to find their calling in the field of therapy; what form those therapies take is something that person will have to discover for themselves, that is, this person first has to find out for themselves what healing is. It wakes our values, our gifts, our abilities.

108.titulo: A calling that is in harmony with my purpose and soul plan.
108.texto: The esoteric number. It is the number of the Holy Spirit. It is the so-called «angle of the pentagram». Whoever lives by the 108 has to live their life according to their spiritual focus; these are the people who are within themselves and are active, the material part seems not to be so important to them and they steer their life through their spiritual focus.

109.titulo: A calling in which I channel my inner wisdom. Perhaps teaching.
109.texto: The number of telepathy. You have to be very responsible with telepathy, not influencing others without permission. A professional focus: we have to relax and let the information come from the Cosmos, so as to know what our calling is.

111.titulo: It is the number of light. The decisive thing has happened.
111.texto: The 111 would correspond to the root chakra. It is 3 times the 37. A lot of God's strength. Things that God wants are going to happen.

112.titulo: It is the number of Christ, that is, the vibration of the word Christ.
112.texto: We have said here that the 47 is the number of Karma, and I have also told you that there is a bigger number of Karma, which is the number 199; with this number you really do get into the subject. It is the value of Christ.

123.titulo: It is the number of Yin Karma.
123.texto: Wherever the 123 shows up there are karmic processes, but you only manage to resolve them if you have a Yin orientation, taking an attitude of receptiveness and acceptance instead of trying to force things or take drastic measures. The message is clear: FORCE NOTHING, trust the process and allow things to unfold naturally.

144.titulo: It is the number of Atlantis. It is a very special number.
144.texto: There are the 144 Angels of Atlantis, but there is other information that also has to do with the 144: it is the number of all our planes of consciousness, that is, when all is said and done we have 144 planes of consciousness. Consciousness.

157.titulo: It has a lot to do with charisma. Charismatic beings.
157.texto: This gives charisma; there is a corresponding path on the tree of life for it too, and we can perceive that charisma because the etheric body gives off an energy of positive success; this lies in the fact that point 1 is lived religion.

183.texto: Jesus is a man, that is, Jesus as a man (the human part). The number 112 was the value of Christ; this is practically Christ as the divine part, and the two things together give us the true man. This is the number of the Christ in man.

474.texto: Creating Karma out of matter, that is, getting so tangled up in matter, obviously, and having an influence on other people, that Karma comes out of it; and the number also exists the other way round, that is, the 747, where you can see the 47 again, and that would be learning from Karma.

666.texto: 666 corresponds to the brow chakra. This has a lot to do with the Devil, because if your thoughts are correspondingly dirty, the 666 has something Devilish about it in your case, but if you have pure thoughts, the strength of your spirit is clear and pure and it is a very powerful and very positive number.

0.texto: Vacío absoluto, potencial de todo. Bloqueo. (-) Inmovilidad, incapacidad, estancamiento, negligencia. (+) Ser conscientes de que tengo que moverme, búsqueda, arriesgarse, movilización espiritual. Salto al vacío. Este principio original nos habla de la nada, por lo tanto, de muchas infinitas posibilidades. Estado de creación en el que todavía no hay nada. Dios es todo y nada. La primera causa para algo. Un tarro vacío se puede llenar de cosas y depende de lo que llenes tendrá un aspecto u otro. Pero existe hueco para llenarlo. Significado Atlante: La nada, ilimitado, abierto.
0.pos: Ser conscientes de que tengo que moverme, búsqueda, arriesgarse, movilización espiritual. Salto al vacío. Este principio original nos habla de la nada, por lo tanto, de muchas infinitas posibilidades. Estado de creación en el que todavía no hay nada. Dios es todo y nada. La primera causa para algo. Un tarro vacío se puede llenar de cosas y depende de lo que llenes tendrá un aspecto u otro. Pero existe hueco para llenarlo.

1.texto: Fraternidad, unidad universal. (-) Sentimiento de incapacidad, desconfianza en el proceso de la vida. No soy merecedor. Soledad. (+) Regreso al padre / Unidad, enfoque espiritual en la vida. El número 1 es el número de Dios. Todo es uno, la unidad, todos somos partes de Dios. Cada ser en sí mismo es divino y tiene energía de Dios. Dios es el principio y es el fin, origen divino. Él quiere estar presente en todo y en todos. Pero sin él nos perdemos. Significado Atlante: El origen divino o la voluntad divina. Dios quiere imponer su voluntad. Otros significados: Representa el principio masculino, el Yang. Es el pionero que avanza solo, buscando las experiencias que le darán su inequívoca identidad. Se halla en proceso de descubrir sus propias capacidades. Es energía en su estado natural, positivo, original y creativo, en perpetuo movimiento. Al encontrarse solo e imbuido de su gran energía creativa, debe decidir cómo ha de usar tal energía. Debe tomar las riendas y tener el valor de mantener el rumbo sin miedo a la oposición. El número 1 es el verdadero “Yo soy” de la humanidad, la unión de todo, la unidad de medida vibratoria. Es autoconciencia. Palabras clave: original, independiente, agresivo, individualista, creativo, dominante; el primero en una serie, el comienzo de toda operación o actividad, el líder el pionero, el jefe al que le gusta la autoridad. “Aquel que avanza hacia delante”.
1.neg: Sentimiento de incapacidad, desconfianza en el proceso de la vida. No soy merecedor. Soledad.
1.pos: Regreso al padre / Unidad, enfoque espiritual en la vida. El número 1 es el número de Dios. Todo es uno, la unidad, todos somos partes de Dios. Cada ser en sí mismo es divino y tiene energía de Dios. Dios es el principio y es el fin, origen divino. Él quiere estar presente en todo y en todos. Pero sin él nos perdemos.
1.claves: original, independiente, agresivo, individualista, creativo, dominante; el primero en una serie, el comienzo de toda operación o actividad, el líder el pionero, el jefe al que le gusta la autoridad.

2.titulo: Polaridad, dualidad, flexibilidad (cualquier número par = tensión añadida)
2.texto: Polaridad, dualidad, flexibilidad (cualquier número par = tensión añadida). (-) Lógica aplastante, separación de mi corazón, dogmatismo, imperio de la razón, inflexibilidad. (+) Amor incondicional (conciencia crística dentro de nosotros). Todos somos uno: “Lo que te doy, me lo doy, lo que te quito, me lo quito”. La dualidad en la materia sólo puede resolverse a través del Amor. Decisiones: la única decisión, poner el amor por delante. Dios nos creó a su imagen y semejanza, Dios es el 1 y se crea una imagen de sí mismo, este segundo sería el hijo/a. La división de la célula de Dios ha dado como resultado a su hijo. Aquí se forman las dos posibilidades, padre, hijo dualidad, pero también es la otra parte, la pareja. Amor y comunidad. Significado Atlante: Amor, la comunidad, la unión. Otros significados: El par, el dúo. Mudable y adaptable, puede mostrarse también indeciso. Es el agente, el mediador, el diplomático y pacificador, porque la unión sólo se cumple mediante un encuentro entre las mentes, un compromiso de cada una de las partes. El 2 representa el principio femenino de receptividad, el Yin, que permite la unión de dos entidades distintas, el período de gestación en que las cosas empiezan a tomar forma. El 2 recoge y asimila. Establece un equilibrio entre fuerzas opuestas y, por consiguiente, representa la cooperación, la solidaridad y la asociación. Actúa como un pacificador y presta una ávida atención a los detalles. Al ser tan consciente de las oposiciones, tiene un pronunciado sentido del ritmo y la armonía. La música atrae su naturaleza compasiva y emocional. La característica maternal, paciente y sensitiva del 2 le induce a ceder el primer lugar a otros, dejándoles pasar delante de él. Busca la unión, no la separación, por lo cual se muestra obediente y comprensivo. Desea ante todo la armonía y la asimilación. Los iones de hidrógeno que empezaron a existir bajo el 1 chocan ahora en el espacio. Se sienten arrastrados los unos hacia los otros por la ley de la atracción mutua, la ley del número 2. Palabras clave: adaptable, político, amable, precavido. Un seguidor más bien que un dirigente.
2.neg: Lógica aplastante, separación de mi corazón, dogmatismo, imperio de la razón, inflexibilidad.

3.titulo: Fertilidad, cuando amplifico la vibración del 3 de un número, estoy calculando la potencia máxima de algo.
3.texto: Fertilidad, cuando amplifico la vibración del 3 de un número, estoy calculando la potencia máxima de algo. Ejemplo: 2 = amor incondicional. Potencia máxima = 2x3 = 6. Generación producida por/desde el corazón = creatividad. (+) Fertilidad cósmica. (-) Incapacidad y bloqueo. Cuando dos se aman, lo siguiente es el fruto, la creación, el hijo. Este es el número de la productividad cósmica. Con una buena ley de mentalismo, el cosmos se ocupa de proporcionarte unos buenos frutos. Número triangular 1, 2, 3, es decir, forman un triángulo. Padre, hijo y espíritu santo. Significado Atlante del 3: La creación, la productividad cósmica, la decisión. Espíritu, acto y creación. Otros significados: Combina las cualidades del 1 y el 2. Vibración fascinante y diversificada, posee las cualidades de manifestación y autoexpresión. El ion, que entró en la existencia a partir de 0, buscó su individualidad bajo el 1 y descubrió la atracción de los otros bajo el 2, toma conciencia ahora de su necesidad de una interacción social. El 3 significa la necesidad de comunicar y se sumerge en la pura alegría de vivir. Gracias a su exuberante respuesta ante la vida, irradia alegría y entusiasmo. El 3 es el extravertido cuyo magnetismo personal arrastra a los demás y les impulsa a expandirse y desarrollarse, el ejecutante que posee una apreciación innata del placer, el romanticismo, el arte y la belleza. Su imaginación creativa permite que todas las cosas sean posibles, por lo cual aparece involucrado en muchas emociones y experiencias. Amistoso y expansivo, medrando con la sociabilidad y la variedad, si hay algún número al que se pueda llamar irresponsable, el calificativo corresponde al efervescente 3. Palabras clave: expansivo, sociable, espectacular, comunicativo, diversificado, creativo.
3.neg: Incapacidad y bloqueo. Cuando dos se aman, lo siguiente es el fruto, la creación, el hijo. Este es el número de la productividad cósmica. Con una buena ley de mentalismo, el cosmos se ocupa de proporcionarte unos buenos frutos. Número triangular 1, 2, 3, es decir, forman un triángulo. Padre, hijo y espíritu santo.
3.claves: expansivo, sociable, espectacular, comunicativo, diversificado, creativo.

4.titulo: Entender la materia / Tierra como nuestro hogar, el lugar o reino al que hemos venido para realizarnos.
4.texto: Entender la materia / Tierra como nuestro hogar, el lugar o reino al que hemos venido para realizarnos. (+) Reconozco a Dios en la materia. Acepto el mundo como campo de aprendizaje. (-) Veo la materia separada de Dios. “Si existiese Dios, no permitiría esto”. Limitación racional, busco seguridad a toda costa. Incluso a costa de mi cuerpo. “El cuerpo lo aguanta todo”. Este es un número de la materia, tenemos que ejecutar algo a la acción y poner pies firmes en el suelo. En la figura sagrada es un cuadrado con las 4 estaciones del año. Los 4 evangelistas, que llevaron a la materia escribiendo las profecías que Dios les mandaba. Los 4 Arcángeles. La materia es necesaria. Significado Atlante Llevar algo a cabo, la materia, tiene que ver con la cultura, poner mis pies en la tierra. Otros significados: Es la estabilidad, una conciencia cuadrada, el símbolo de la ley, el sistema y el orden; la firmeza, la seguridad, la estabilidad y el conservadurismo; el constructor que debe crear las cosas terrenas en que predominan los elementos de forma y sustancia. El 4 es la naturaleza y se relaciona con la tierra. De acuerdo con la historia bíblica de la creación, la tierra se formó en el cuarto día. La atracción que los iones sintieron bajo el 2 les condujo bajo el 3 a la interacción. Ahora, bajo el 4, se produce la inevitable concentración de las energías. Y se lleva a cabo la formación. Los iones advierten que no pueden dispersar por más tiempo sus energías, sino que deben empezar a aunarlas dentro de un sistema productivo y ordenado. Por consiguiente, el 4 desarrolla una naturaleza práctica y, gracias a la autodisciplina, se fuerza a sí mismo a un ejercicio convencional y rutinario de su energía. Palabras clave: forma, trabajo, orden, espíritu práctico, construcción, estabilidad, resistencia, disciplina.
4.neg: Veo la materia separada de Dios. “Si existiese Dios, no permitiría esto”. Limitación racional, busco seguridad a toda costa. Incluso a costa de mi cuerpo. “El cuerpo lo aguanta todo”. Este es un número de la materia, tenemos que ejecutar algo a la acción y poner pies firmes en el suelo. En la figura sagrada es un cuadrado con las 4 estaciones del año. Los 4 evangelistas, que llevaron a la materia escribiendo las profecías que Dios les mandaba. Los 4 Arcángeles. La materia es necesaria.
4.pos: Reconozco a Dios en la materia. Acepto el mundo como campo de aprendizaje.
4.claves: forma, trabajo, orden, espíritu práctico, construcción, estabilidad, resistencia, disciplina.

5.titulo: Número del Yo Superior, el que recoge la identidad o Alma
5.texto: Número del Yo Superior, el que recoge la identidad o Alma. Nos conecta con el Tikun (propósito de vida). (+) Dar respuesta a quien soy yo. Reconocerme como hijo de Dios, único y especial. Es la base de la autoaceptación y la autoestima. (-) Crisis de identidad, baja autoestima, no acepto mi cuerpo, vivo desde la máscara, busco el reconocimiento y aceptación externa. Miedo al rechazo. Este es el número del alma, por eso es el número de la religión, religar, volver a conectar con el alma. Responsabilizarte para hacer tus tareas del alma. Expresar de forma material, abrirse al alma, dejarle sitio. En la figura geométrica estamos hablando del pentagrama. Significado Atlante: Apertura para la sensación de responsabilizarse, para la adoración a Dios, el número del Alma y el número de la psiquis. Reconectarnos con nuestra esencia. Otros significados: Es la libertad, el cambio y la aventura. La actividad y la curiosidad constantes producen una entidad ingeniosa, adaptable y versátil, siempre dispuesta a aprovechar las oportunidades. Dado que el 5 ocupa el puesto intermedio en el ciclo del 1 al 8, hace posible tomar decisiones. Se le puede considerar como el pivote en que los iones, ya provistos de carne y de forma, han de decidir su futuro durante el resto del ciclo, del 6 al 9. En este momento se les ofrecen muchas oportunidades y variedades de experiencia, a través de las cuales reciben la información que precisan para tomar esa decisión. El 5 interviene en un gran número de interacciones superficiales con grupos y multitudes. Gracias a sus diversas experiencias pasadas, es el promotor y publicitario por naturaleza, de fácil comunicación, en posesión de un poco de información sobre muchas cosas y siempre deseoso de andar de allí para aquí con objeto de comunicarla. El 5 atrae al sexo opuesto por su irresistible magnetismo, y su atracción siente las bases para las responsabilidades domésticas que siguen naturalmente bajo el 6. Palabras clave: versatilidad, ingenio, adaptabilidad, cambio, actividad, viaje, aventura, promoción, especulación.
5.neg: Crisis de identidad, baja autoestima, no acepto mi cuerpo, vivo desde la máscara, busco el reconocimiento y aceptación externa. Miedo al rechazo. Este es el número del alma, por eso es el número de la religión, religar, volver a conectar con el alma. Responsabilizarte para hacer tus tareas del alma. Expresar de forma material, abrirse al alma, dejarle sitio. En la figura geométrica estamos hablando del pentagrama.
5.pos: Dar respuesta a quien soy yo. Reconocerme como hijo de Dios, único y especial. Es la base de la autoaceptación y la autoestima.
5.claves: versatilidad, ingenio, adaptabilidad, cambio, actividad, viaje, aventura, promoción, especulación.

6.texto: El Yo personal, el EGO. Experimentar el placer de vivir. Éxtasis de la creación (2x3 = 6, potencia máxima del amor incondicional). (+) Placer de la vida, capacidad de amar a través de los sentidos (la piel). Desarrollo del ego fértil, relación armónica con la creación. (-) Número del EGO “Yo soy”, como separación de Dios. Ego estéril. Individualismo, egocentrismo, ignorancia, exceso de energía material en su vida. Depresión y tristeza. Yonki del trabajo y/o de las endorfinas. Sensación de desamparo… Es un número de tensión. Armonía entre el Yin y el Yang. Buscar el equilibrio para tener las dos polaridades en sintonía. Debo mirar con exactitud mis procesos de aprendizaje para no salirme de mi armonía. Estoy en tensión hasta que sepa qué es lo que tengo que aprender. Significado Atlante: Tentación y proceso de aprendizaje. Otros significados: Concienzudo, el 6 desea difundir la armonía, la verdad, la justicia y el sentido del equilibrio en su medio ambiente. En su mente predomina el amor y la compasión. Por consiguiente, puede ser un excelente maestro, consejero o sanador. Los demás se sienten atraídos por la comprensión que emana de él. Bajo el 5, los iones tuvieron la oportunidad de experimentar muchos acontecimientos y encuentros emocionales. Ahora están preparados para aceptar las responsabilidades sociales y familiares, es decir, la vibración 6. El 6 es una vibración doméstica y artística y, bajo este número, los iones han de ajustarse a las necesidades de los demás. El 6 desea un compañero íntimo, el matrimonio y un hogar, una familia en la que reinen la belleza y la armonía. De esto se sigue lógicamente una necesidad de armonía en el grupo y de servicio a la comunidad. El 6 se asienta, fundiéndose con el elemento conservador de la comunidad, en la que puede crear mejores niveles de vida. Dotado para las artes, expresa también a veces su potencial creativo a través de su desarrollado sentido del equilibrio y se convierte en un excelente artista en su campo particular. Palabras clave: responsabilidad familiar y social, servicio, amor, compasión, consejo, poderes curativos, creatividad.
6.neg: Número del EGO “Yo soy”, como separación de Dios. Ego estéril. Individualismo, egocentrismo, ignorancia, exceso de energía material en su vida. Depresión y tristeza. Yonki del trabajo y/o de las endorfinas. Sensación de desamparo… Es un número de tensión. Armonía entre el Yin y el Yang. Buscar el equilibrio para tener las dos polaridades en sintonía. Debo mirar con exactitud mis procesos de aprendizaje para no salirme de mi armonía. Estoy en tensión hasta que sepa qué es lo que tengo que aprender.
6.claves: responsabilidad familiar y social, servicio, amor, compasión, consejo, poderes curativos, creatividad.

7.titulo: Número de la conciencia y el perfeccionamiento
7.texto: Número de la conciencia y el perfeccionamiento. Hago honor al compromiso de mantener el paraíso en las condiciones en las que Dios nos lo regaló. Tierra/Cuerpo. Origen divino, rendirle culto. (+) Número de conciencia: importancia de la comunidad, donde pongo mi energía y para qué, de la importancia de trabajar conscientemente. Sutilizar mi huella en el mundo. “Lo que yo haga eleve la vibración de mi entorno”. No deben criticar a la gente. Una cadena es tan fuerte como el eslabón más débil que lo forma. (-) No nos integramos en la comunidad, no profundizamos en los aspectos de la vida, no tomo conciencia, no me sano, no utilizo mi energía de forma consciente. No acepta su sombra, no toca con los pies en la tierra. Conflicto con el mundo y sensación de sentirse un extraterrestre. 7 chakras, 7 días de la semana, 7 sellos sagrados, 7 pecados capitales que son: Envidia, avaricia, ira, deseo, soberbia, gula y pereza. Detrás de este número, está la perfección o deseo de llegar a la totalización. Pero no la perfección divina si no la perfección humana. Conocer los 7 chakras y trabajarlos. Significado Atlante: La perfección alcanzable para los seres humanos. Lograr lo que me he propuesto. Victoria divina a través de la armonía y la voluntad. Otros significados: El 7 busca respuestas. Procura establecer una filosofía de la vida e intenta penetrar el misterio que se oculta tras la existencia, sobre el cual nadie se había interrogado hasta ese punto. Al ser necesaria la soledad para un tal análisis, el 7 siente la urgencia de permanecer solo, lejos de las multitudes, en contacto con la naturaleza. Se procura la amistad de los seres de elevada conciencia, equiparable a la suya. Y Dios descansó al séptimo día. Todas las cosas descansan bajo el 7, ya que se necesita tiempo para pensar. Los iones se sienten equilibrados y en calma. Se dan cuenta de que precisan mantenerse inmóviles y aprender. Han establecido ya una rutina para su energía y, a partir de aquí, inician el análisis. El 7 introduce en el ciclo una consecución física sin aparente esfuerzo. Las metas durante tanto tiempo perseguidas se alcanzan ahora mágicamente. Se dispone de tiempo libre para dedicarlo a los intereses filosóficos y metafísicos. El razonamiento perfecto constituye la meta del 7. Por eso se le llama el número sagrado. Por eso también se hallan bajo su influencia los científicos, filósofos, maestros, místicos y clérigos. La faceta física del 7 se relaciona asimismo con la salud del cuerpo, muy sensibilizado gracias a esta vibración. Palabras clave: tranquilo, introspectivo, intuitivo, analítico, inspirador, inclinado a la reclusión, filosófico, místico.
7.neg: No nos integramos en la comunidad, no profundizamos en los aspectos de la vida, no tomo conciencia, no me sano, no utilizo mi energía de forma consciente. No acepta su sombra, no toca con los pies en la tierra. Conflicto con el mundo y sensación de sentirse un extraterrestre. 7 chakras, 7 días de la semana, 7 sellos sagrados, 7 pecados capitales que son: Envidia, avaricia, ira, deseo, soberbia, gula y pereza. Detrás de este número, está la perfección o deseo de llegar a la totalización. Pero no la perfección divina si no la perfección humana. Conocer los 7 chakras y trabajarlos.
7.pos: Número de conciencia: importancia de la comunidad, donde pongo mi energía y para qué, de la importancia de trabajar conscientemente. Sutilizar mi huella en el mundo. “Lo que yo haga eleve la vibración de mi entorno”. No deben criticar a la gente. Una cadena es tan fuerte como el eslabón más débil que lo forma.
7.claves: tranquilo, introspectivo, intuitivo, analítico, inspirador, inclinado a la reclusión, filosófico, místico.

8.titulo: Número de la libertad y la responsabilidad
8.texto: Número de la libertad y la responsabilidad. Yo estoy en armonía cuando me responsabilizo de mi plan de Alma. Sólo a través del profundo compromiso con este plan, me libero de mis miedos y carencias. (+) Toma de responsabilidad, que le lleva a estar en armonía interna, por tanto, a conectar con su paz y alegría interior. Me siento completo y mi vida tiene sentido. (-) 2x4 = Limitación racional / miedo a la materia. Disociación entre mente/corazón. Miedos – esclavitud por miedo a la materia. Carencia de uno mismo y de su propósito. Número de vulnerabilidad de astral. Victoria divina a través de la armonía. Lo que nosotros sembramos es lo que recogemos, se trata de realización mental, espiritual y física. Necesitamos convencimiento para que aquello que tenemos en la cabeza también lo podamos realmente transformar. Necesitamos libertad espiritual, necesito ser libre de influencias para poder hacer realmente lo que mi alma necesita hacer. Vivir la espiritualidad desde mi verdad. Es justo que lo que yo siento en el espíritu se materialice. Significado Atlante: Tal como es arriba, es abajo. Justicia cósmica, agradecimiento, paz y tranquilidad. Otros significados: El 8 asumirá el poder, para lo cual habrá logrado el control y la responsabilidad en el campo elegido. Obtendrá reconocimiento y recompensas financieras y conseguirá expansión y desarrollo en el mundo de los negocios. Bajo el 8, el karma es el rey, y los iones cosecharán lo que hayan sembrado. El poder constituye la cualidad asociada con el 8. El ardor, el celo, la resolución y la capacidad de ver las cosas en términos amplios le inspiran ambición, añadiéndose a esto las cualidades requeridas para conquistar objetivos materiales. El 8 posee el vigor preciso para superar todos los obstáculos y termina por triunfar gracias a su capacidad y su perseverancia. Puede llegar muy alto basándose en las ideas y los planes que se han ido formulando gradualmente durante los siete ciclos anteriores. Con sus normas justas y éticas, sus capacidades de buen juicio y organización, logrará el reconocimiento, el poder y recompensas financieras. Palabras clave: poder, responsabilidad, recompensas financieras, buen juicio, reconocimiento.
8.neg: 2x4 = Limitación racional / miedo a la materia. Disociación entre mente/corazón. Miedos – esclavitud por miedo a la materia. Carencia de uno mismo y de su propósito. Número de vulnerabilidad de astral. Victoria divina a través de la armonía. Lo que nosotros sembramos es lo que recogemos, se trata de realización mental, espiritual y física. Necesitamos convencimiento para que aquello que tenemos en la cabeza también lo podamos realmente transformar. Necesitamos libertad espiritual, necesito ser libre de influencias para poder hacer realmente lo que mi alma necesita hacer. Vivir la espiritualidad desde mi verdad. Es justo que lo que yo siento en el espíritu se materialice.
8.pos: Toma de responsabilidad, que le lleva a estar en armonía interna, por tanto, a conectar con su paz y alegría interior. Me siento completo y mi vida tiene sentido.
8.claves: poder, responsabilidad, recompensas financieras, buen juicio, reconocimiento.

9.titulo: Número de la sabiduría, vibración en la que alcanzamos la conciencia de nuestro Yo Superior: Reconozco mi divinidad.
9.texto: Número de la sabiduría, vibración en la que alcanzamos la conciencia de nuestro Yo Superior: Reconozco mi divinidad. (+) Proceso de revelación, que implica intuición manifestada, certeza interior manifestada, revelación manifestada. Clariperfección – diferenciar lo que es real y lo que no en la vida. (-) Control mental, por miedo a que le vuelvan a hacer daño. Rigidez, dogmatismo, inflexibilidad mental. Número de la autoexigencia y perfeccionista. Quiere que su vida sea perfecta, y que todo esté bajo sus estándares de perfección. Esta es la suma de todas las sabidurías. Esto tiene que ver con Hermes Trimegisto, las 7 leyes espirituales.
