Cada acontecimiento en mi vida siempre es resultado de estas leyes cósmicas. El 9 tiene que ver con el embarazo cósmico, y seguridad del corazón. Mi sabiduría y mi certeza proceden del corazón. Tiene que ver con la clariperfección en la estructura energética, intuición y guíate por tu interior. En ti está toda fuente de sabiduría. Significado Atlante: Auto reconocimiento y sabiduría, amor por la verdad. Otros significados: El 9 es abnegación y compasión. Puesto que su amor lo abarca todo, desea aplicar su energía al servicio del universo. El 9 confiere una visión de la verdad impersonal, pero justa, generosa, benévola y paciente. Artista y pensador, desarrolló sus cualidades en los ciclos precedentes y ahora está dispuesto (o dispuesta) a compartir su conocimiento con el resto del mundo. Los iones han llegado al último estadio. Pasaron por el ciclo completo de las nueve vibraciones, almacenando experiencia a lo largo del camino. Y al cerrarse el ciclo, alcanzan una total comprensión y tolerancia respecto a los puntos de vista y los prejuicios de los demás. El 9 se halla preparado para devolver en cierta medida al universo lo que aprendió durante los ocho grados previos del ciclo. La ley de la ciclicidad no permite pérdidas y exige rendimiento a cambio de consumo. Cuando se acepta así, la perfección alcanzada bajo el 9 aporta sólo alegría como un regalo de la vida, además de la libertad para entrar en el próximo ciclo sin impedimentos. Palabras clave: amor, compasión, paciencia, universalidad, tolerancia, servicio abnegado, desenlaces
9.neg: Control mental, por miedo a que le vuelvan a hacer daño. Rigidez, dogmatismo, inflexibilidad mental. Número de la autoexigencia y perfeccionista. Quiere que su vida sea perfecta, y que todo esté bajo sus estándares de perfección. Esta es la suma de todas las sabidurías. Esto tiene que ver con Hermes Trimegisto, las 7 leyes espirituales. Cada acontecimiento en mi vida siempre es resultado de estas leyes cósmicas. El 9 tiene que ver con el embarazo cósmico, y seguridad del corazón. Mi sabiduría y mi certeza proceden del corazón. Tiene que ver con la clariperfección en la estructura energética, intuición y guíate por tu interior. En ti está toda fuente de sabiduría.
9.pos: Proceso de revelación, que implica intuición manifestada, certeza interior manifestada, revelación manifestada. Clariperfección – diferenciar lo que es real y lo que no en la vida.

0.texto: “ENERGY OF FIERY, SPONTANEOUS CONSCIOUSNESS”. The 0: everything is open, anything can happen. Inspiration from God, spark, spontaneity. In some decks the figure is a jester, the only one allowed to laugh at the king. Your law of mentalism is the one that decides whether I listen or not. A chance to begin something. The law of mentalism (faith). God gives the idea and the person has to trust (Uranus is on the Yin side). Nothing is decided, it is a good card. From Kabbalah it is a path 11 = it is the first path, after the spheres. It is related to path 11, Strength. Triad of the spirit = existential crises. Leap into the Void – act of faith – trusting life. I give myself over to the spirit, I know that what I need will be given to me. It has only one direction, Kether Chokmah. Blockages: impatience, apathy. Fear of the unknown. 11: Master number = spiritual life = identifying your truth, the path is made by walking it. To get a spiritual life, I have to look for the spiritual life. Spiritual and mental strength and power: spiritual will made manifest. The Fool is the card of radical change, it symbolises our capacity to unlearn and to take whatever risks are needed to feel well. It usually represents a push from the soul, when you do not know exactly where you want to go, but you do know where you do not want to stay. It is related to abrupt, dynamic energy, capable of making unexpected and often apparently senseless changes, and it is usually lived with a certain anguish and uncertainty. It speaks to us of the idea of irresponsibility, of risk, and of nonconformity. It urges us to take the leap, to bet on ourselves and our dreams, to allow ourselves to be who we are, genuinely, whatever way people may judge us. The child, the naive one, the simple one, the fool. A principle open to all possibilities. Yin polarity. Trusting ourselves and trusting God — that is faith. Trying new things, new beginnings. Decisions with trust in God. An absence of prejudice. Spontaneity, adventurous, an open attitude, naive. Its planets give us trust in the supreme, in the divine plan. The faith is so great that mistakes are completely indifferent to it, with no fear of getting it wrong. That is why this path gives us a consciousness of spontaneity so that only the heart comes out and not our mind. The enlightenment, that fool who appears in us, makes us take drastic decisions and other people stare at you as if thinking «how mad this one is».

1.texto: “CONSCIOUS ENERGY OF GOOD WILL”. The four elements: Swords: mind = air. Wands: earth. Coins: money = fire. Cups: emotions = water. Kether–Binah. You can create, but not constantly. Self-realisation. All that is above is below, all that is below is above. Plain conscious energy of the will. To create and to trust, it is infinite. It is God's will revealing itself on Earth. God makes material what you need, we can ask for what we want (free will). It is a Mixed Yang path. Taking the initiative, manifesting the innate truth in the world. Has every tool at their disposal. Triad of the spirit – possible existential crisis. Anger with father/mother. Authoritarian. 0 is God's will. 0 is mine. Concrete creativity, effective communication. Initiative. Blockages: Hyperactivity / Laziness. Scattering, Aggressiveness. Path number 12: Unconditional love in order to find their spiritual life. It is their mind that rules, not their spirit; a logical mind, lacks. Number of faith, trust in God, love takes me to God. Related to Arcanum 12, The Hanged Man. The Magician symbolises the beginning, where all the energy is pure, radiant, daring and impatient. This arcanum makes us connect with our curious side, with the need to learn and to start projects, even when its function is not to finish everything it starts, but to keep moving towards different interests. It represents trust in life, the capacity to take a risk and throw yourself into being yourself. Its character is dynamic, original, creative and impulsive. We could say that this is the arcanum capable of doing impossible things, because it never believed they were. It is related to joy, to lightness, to childhood and youth, and to all those things we do for the sheer pleasure of doing them, because they catch our attention. One of its great teachings is that, to walk any path, a first step has to be taken. To achieve any dream, you have to move into action and set the energy in motion. Taking initiative, driving things forward, working at our tasks, mastering the will. Here God's will becomes visible. The Magician represents the Solar consciousness that lights everything up, and looks for clarity and light. This attitude of the master shows us that he does not act with his own forces, but uses the energies of the cosmos and knows how to use the 7 universal laws. With his tools he alters the circumstances of the path, using his unbreakable initiative and will. A restless seeker. Not easily convinced, but transforms himself in order to go on evolving. He has the capacity to transform destiny, stepping in wonderfully, because he understands everything that causes obstruction in human evolution.

2.texto: “ENERGY OF CONSCIOUSNESS OF DENIAL”. Black pillar B = Binah (Neptune). White pillar J = Yesod (Moon). Wisdom. II = twice God. Mother / Father = duality. The keeper of the doors: she gives you access to other planes of consciousness, but not 24 hours a day. Astral travel. We have to be able to set priorities, to choose which matters more, the duality. The wisdom is inside you. Harmony with ourselves and a clear choice. Kether Tiphereth. Path of the arrow, raising of consciousness, 2-14-21. Rescuing your voice. Link between spirit and mind. Access to all hidden knowledge, everything is revealed to me and I understand the laws that govern the Universe. Absolute peace, love of the silence in order to listen, priesthood, freeing of the last veil. The 7 Laws of the Kybalion. Blockages: Indecision, duality. Putting things off, distrust. Mental rigidity, disconnection from the senses. It joins the triad of the Spirit with the triad of the Soul. Identity crisis. Existential crisis. In revolt against themselves or against the world. Spirit–Mind link 2/20/11. 20: I have no idea how to love myself, it comes from the mother. 11: Because I do not know who I am / I do not accept myself. The physical body does not accept it. Path 13: I have to share my gifts, what I know, in order to be one with God. Number of change, transformation. Death and resurrection. The High Priestess or Papess is an arcanum of reflection. It is the card of knowledge and of wisdom, but also of intuition and of the capacity to hear what is not said, to see what is hidden. That is why the Priestess is said to be the most intuitive card of the tarot, and the best adviser. She symbolises waiting, patience, humility and quiet. This archetype invites you to reflect on how you listen to others and on your capacity to understand deeply the world around you. She also represents the capacity to learn on your own. She is related to what is stable, to what is serene, to acceptance and to listening. One of her great teachings is becoming conscious, serenity and the observation of the world that brings the answers from within. She symbolises the reflection needed so that it is not outside expectations that control us. Her archetype is that of intuition and of going deeper inwards, that of sensitivity, of stillness. The wish to let yourself be carried along and the patience to observe and to feel; her message is: «Everything comes at the right moment». She asks us to take a decision positively with all our strength. Sometimes we give a heap of excuses for not doing it and when we are asked what it is we really want, we block. If I block and I no longer know what is positive for me, I will not be able to take the decision positively. This path teaches us what is best for me, and I am not going to reason it out; this answer will come from my wisdom, my inner intuition, that is, from listening to the divine that is in me. She puts us in touch with the subconscious, with the deepest part of our psyche and with the emotions. The influence she has on her surroundings, and the mediation that follows from it, are based on the respect that flows from knowing the natural laws. Mentally, she has the psychic supports that make her transform herself and, with her actions, transform other people. She keeps her intentions silent since they are constantly being formed in her conscious mind and she waits for the right moment to act without obstructing the natural cycle.

3.texto: “ENERGY OF ILLUMINATING CONSCIOUSNESS”. Binah–Chokmah. Cosmic current, it is Yin / Yang. 3 = the Son = Life. Expresses what she knows. 12 stars in the crown = 12 months, 12 signs of the zodiac… 12 = 2+1 = 3. The mother. People of closeness, they need to be face to face with everyone else. She bears fruit talking with others and others with her. She is able to nourish you. Relationships, small communities. She has to come close and to let go. They must not isolate themselves. Very Venus people, they like what is beautiful, a great sensitivity to beauty. Triad of the Spirit. Rescuing your fertility. The highest path of force. A path of synthesis. I know = I give. I know what I give / I give what I know. I know who I am and I offer it to the world and that is the ground of my abundance and fertility. It speaks to us of our physical mother. I know what to give, I share my gifts, a capacity for synthesis, the fall of the last veil. Blockages: Denial of myself. Mental blockage, a stagnant life. Union of polarities at any price. Submission / Rebellion. 3 – 12 – 21: my life is fertile, is it worth anything? Path 14. 14 = Fulfilment in matter in order to have a spiritual life. Matter is the means, not the end. Number of service to the community. The Empress is one of the archetypes of power. She symbolises the magna mater, the abundant and fertile mother earth. Within herself, being the number three, she has the best features of the Magician and the Priestess combined. That is why the Empress's qualities are unlimited. She is related to the capacity to achieve what you want, to know what you want and to use the available resources intelligently in order to get it. This archetype questions us about the emotions, both what we feel for ourselves and the way we relate to others. It represents emotional intelligence. The Empress teaches us how we as people can inspire one another, support one another, motivate one another to be who we want to be. The energy of this archetype is one of growth and expansion, of abundance, of hope and of triumph. Among the archetypes she is the mother, fertility, nature, the outside, creativity, beauty, protection, freedom. She is the absolute embodiment of creativity and the life force. She is the original source, virtually inexhaustible, that gives life to new things, over and over. She represents the fertile phases, the evolution of life situations and the stages of cyclical renewal. The key to this path is human, close relationships, from the widest to the smallest. A relationship with a partner, with friends, at work, with yourself, with Mother Earth, with the cosmos, with God, and so on. Fundamentally the kind of relationship the Empress generates is community, in order to share with every person she meets. When the empress shares and exchanges experiences with closeness and communication, fertility comes about and we all make each other fertile, and this makes us come relatively close. The person who walks this path is marked by a great inventive, creative capacity, and their inexhaustible gifts are obviously fertility and fecundity in ideas. This path exalts love, material and spiritual abundance in the widest sense. Whenever she isolates herself she will have a bad time, because her soul needs to form community.
3.pareja: (-) It speaks to us of problems in relationships. Sterile couples, unhealthy relationships. (+) Fertility, abundance in the couple.

4.texto: “CONSTITUTING CONSCIOUS ENERGY”. Masculinity, animal instinct. 4: matter, earth, the most essential. These people have to draw up their own constitution, secure their principles (their Sun). They will have people around them who make them doubt, so that they discover their principle. Path 15. Spirit – Mind connection. Living by my rules and my truth. I live and die by my truth. I am the constituting emperor. Related to the physical father. Either I am the father or I am the son. Either I raise him as a father or I raise him as a son, not both at once. Who I am and what meaning life has. Authority / order, I finish what I start. Relationships with the masculine and with the father's lineage. Blockages: Abuse of power, tyranny. Mental rigidity, nobody has given me anything. A mask, identity crisis. Logic. Fear of setting in motion what they came to do, from king to tyrant. Very hard lives, a lot of hardship, it has cost them a great deal of pain and tears. 4 – 13 – 22: killing the ego, for enlightenment. 15: Through self-esteem, I find my spiritual path, faith. Every human being is my training partner. Number of teamwork. The Emperor symbolises matter and the practical world. He is the number 4, which is related to the four elements, the cardinal points, the phases of the moon, and so on. He personifies everything that is ordered in the material world. His energy is pragmatic, stable and decisive. He represents what needs organising in our existence, and the capacity to order the world around us and get the most out of resources, both outer and personal. It is a loyal, honest and direct energy, which looks to settle conflicts in a concrete and real way. The Emperor helps us understand that the outer has a reflection in the inner and the other way round, and that, to find the elevation of the human being, physical needs have to be met. It is essential to take care of the material world in order to go on advancing towards fullness. He is the archetype of the father, of order, of the constitution, of responsibility, the one who has the power, the command. His noble strength lies in perseverance; he represents the power to make ideas, wishes and intentions become reality. He does and he carries out, he is the one who knows the right way to do the work. We have to develop our own constitution on the basis of our experiences and our premises, and that is precisely what the strength of the Emperor tells us. The experiences of life that we have been collecting step by step should serve us to develop our own particular constitution. What this is about here is setting out the most important basic lines so that we can govern our lives by our own laws of conduct and our own moral and spiritual values. Things should not be done without reflecting, nor should we act without knowing what our priorities are. Once we have created our own constitution we will be able to act, but always using the strength of our heart, so that whatever we do will all be steered by a spiritual inspiration. I need to develop a feeling of happiness that makes me happy doing what I do, otherwise I turn into a cart dragging life along behind me. When things get hard in our lives. The emperor has to come out of his emotions and of the obstructions of the mind. He has to enter the heart, the Sun, and trust.
4.pareja: (-) Tyrannical people, physical and verbal violence, always ready for a fight. There is usually low self-esteem. (+) People concerned for the other's well-being, even-handed, natural authority.

5.lema: Energy of consciousness of lived religion
5.texto: “ENERGY OF CONSCIOUSNESS OF LIVED RELIGION”. 5: Soul. Looks for something deeper. Inner strength (great strength). Kindness. Is clear that they have to reconnect with their inside. Looks for experiences outside, but I must let things happen (yin). Wants no impositions or dogmas. Takes religion its own way. Where there are impositions, it goes badly. They have a great responsibility towards themselves, they practise what they preach. They need to put what they think into practice. They have been religious in other lives. Great speakers. Path 16. Spirit – Mind connection. Joy as a way of life. I discover and joyfully live what I am. I love what I know about myself (a calling). Chesed Chokmah (Ascending). Games, loving what I do, a calling. Living completely what I am. The playful, the pleasure of a guided life. The ritual, building bridges. I live what I preach, the joy of «knowing yourself conscious». Blockages: Ignorance, infantilism. Existential emptiness, disappointment with life. Hypocrisy, denial of their calling. Fodder for sects, an «enlightened» guru. Learns by doing, that way they have the certainty that they are doing it well. In doing, they discover their certainties. Not waiting to act. 16: Accepting their role and the right spiritual focus in order to be a high priest and find spirituality. Number of the right spiritual focus in matter. An imbalance in how I focus in matter. Discovers the capacity to love: I love the Father, the Creator… expansion, growth experienced from love. Fear of matter, from guru to guru. This is the archetype of the passing on of knowledge, in any of its forms. It represents what you need to learn and study, but also what you already know and are able to pass on to others who do not yet know it. It is related to curiosity, intelligence and the appetite both for learning and for sharing what you know. It also refers to a good capacity for expression, through speech, writing or any other medium. It is an arcanum of recognising your own worth, by yourself and by others. The Hierophant symbolises the master and the spiritual guide, in their most positive expression, when one person's experience and advice can help others develop and evolve. So it is related to the work of teachers, advisers, mediators and experts. An archetype of holiness, goodness, an adviser, altruism, morality, compassion, revelation, knowledge, professionalism. The Hierophant represents spiritual restlessness and the deep search for the spiritual keys and mysteries hidden inside us by means of intuition. He knows that dogmas are not good and that they only serve the outer or conventional form, without going deeper into the mystery they hold. He needs to understand what he does, and what he does it for, since impositions are no use to him. The awakening this path holds has to lead to an ethical stance, since for these people it is important to practise what they preach. They need to have their thinking, their feeling and their action in accord in life. Whoever walks this path has to be able to create their own model of God without letting themselves be influenced by dogmas or religions. They have to find, by way of intuition, the path of reunification with him and so teach other people the way to do it for themselves. To bind themselves back, to be reunited with their inner truth and to walk the path of lived religion from truth and honesty. They are destined to become an example for others. When we find ourselves on the path of the Hierophant, then we radiate this for others so as to influence our surroundings. If we are walking this path others are going to be watching us; in fact, they become an intermediary between the spiritual and the material world, whose mission is to unify the two worlds into one, to join the two poles.
5.pareja: (-) I do not live what I am, incoherence in life. (+) A calling, coherence in life.

6.lema: Energy of consciousness of magnetic attraction
6.texto: “ENERGY OF CONSCIOUSNESS OF MAGNETIC ATTRACTION”. Binah–Sun (ascending path). 6: a number of tension. Has great psychic strength. Law of Attraction. They have charm by nature, a lot of pulling power. When they are in a bad way, they attract what is bad. Power of attraction, people with charm. «As it is inside, so it is outside». Path 17. Yang path. An outward journey. I choose what I give. When I am, there is only giving; the decision no longer exists. Free will: Decision and renunciation (Aspects, it is only worldly). I give what I love. Free will, choice. Relationship with the mother and the feminine lineage. Mental clarity (Mercury). Blockages: Renunciation, elimination, duality. Manipulation, I reject my body. I am not able to decide. The rule of Reason. It joins Triad Soul = Spirit. I love what I give. I love myself for what I give. 6-15 17: Consciously I look to unite myself with God. I see God in everything created and manifested. You have to shine with your own light. You need to realise that you have to develop your personal power. What I give has to make me happy. Wake up to life, give with new eyes. Giving without love is not love. Energy = awakening. This is an archetype related to the need to take a decision and the feeling of uncertainty. It refers to a crossroads in your life's path, when you know you have to decide between two options, and that you can only choose one. It symbolises the need for reflection and for action, since it teaches us that one of the greatest gifts of the human being is free will. This arcanum invites us to become conscious that in fact the decision we take matters less than the very fact of being able to decide. Part of this process includes hesitating and putting off taking decisions. Meanwhile you tend to consult everyone around you, even though it is not particularly helpful, because in the end you are the one who has to decide. It is the archetype of genuine and pure love. The power of love, service, commitment, loyalty, the force of attraction, freedom of choice. On this path the need arises to face the conscious choice of taking the way of love and service over other possibilities life may set before us. It is necessary to find the purity and the transcendence of our worldly feelings and emotions in order to walk the path of the Soul. To take this decision, whoever walks this path will need to ally themselves with their intuition, from the silent personal strength that knows the answer and lights up the courage to dare to make the right choice. To serve others first, since the most effective giving is to give and not to ask. Once the ego is beaten, you discover that the need to choose disappears, because everything is equally perfect when love lights up the choice. When we find ourselves walking this path we are talking about our force of physical radiation and this has an influence on others. What this is about is that this force should act in a way that attracts, as in life itself there are people who attract us and others who do not. What makes that effect of attraction happen is the loving force a person radiates; it is what happens when we say that a person is charming. The force of attraction is a Cosmic Law: as it is inside, so it is outside; when I radiate that love I have inside outwards, I attract others. The people who walk this path are masters at relating to people. They harmonise their relationships brilliantly. Their strongest gift is charm, and they radiate solidity, naturalness, inner love.
6.pareja: (-) The path of self-esteem, a lack of self-esteem. «I do not love myself», does not know how to love themselves. (+) Knows how to love themselves and to love, loves what they give.

7.lema: Conscious energy of influence without violence
7.texto: “CONSCIOUS ENERGY OF INFLUENCE WITHOUT VIOLENCE”. Geburah–Binah (ascending direction). Working with the 7 chakras, 7 laws, 7 days of the week. The 7 is a number of action. Active. Yang path. They must be very careful with Mars, the God of War. They want to have an influence on others, they have the strength to pull the chariot (the strength of Mars). They come in order to be active. The violence can be in words. They need no influence from anyone, they themselves have that influence of Mars = Action. Path 18. Yang path – Outward journey. Spirit – Mind connection. I take responsibility for my life. I take responsibility for what I can give. Everything starts from responsibility as a human being for my purpose. The adult, work, maturity. Responsibility for my life, for the things I do. What for? Power in service. Blockages: Peter Pan, I take no responsibility. Problems on the professional plane. Armour, fear of looking ridiculous. Mental rigidity, I cannot stand change. Putting your power at the Service of things: I can Give. The well-being of their loved ones and those close to them (sign of Cancer). 18: Emotional cleansing of my lacks in order to reach God. The Moon. Power loaded with fears. Freeing my fears and doing what brings me peace and harmony — the path I have to follow to reach spirituality. Freedom – commitment / responsibility. Freeing the neuroses = by committing myself to the path of my Soul. Realising that I can give, I give what I can. Taking the reins of your life. You need to take initiatives in order to manifest in matter, otherwise you are not taking the reins of your life. I am afraid to tell the truth, or where I am heading. I take the reins of my life. The Chariot is the arcanum of triumph. Its energy is dynamic and nomadic. It has a great capacity to adapt. It symbolises freedom, confidence in yourself and in the path you want to walk. Its highest expression is taking the reins of your life and being self-sufficient. It is related to originality, since it is an archetype that cares little about the conventional and about how others may judge it. A restless and curious personality, with a quick and interesting mind. The Chariot makes us reflect on what is really important in life, and what you want to take with you on your path. It represents full acceptance of yourself, and having the capacity to prioritise your time on what really moves you. An archetype of movement, of action, of energy, of victory, of drive, of influence. This path asks something very clear of us. To have an influence on others without violence. To master and get past the contradictions. To develop consciousness in order to bring on the awakening. To learn to master my strength and my power so as to act with balance. This is the path of drive and action par excellence, so it is important that, once they become conscious of their potential and learn the path of humility and commitment, they exercise their influence in the world. The capacity to decide, steered by the will, is essential for walking this path, which will undoubtedly take them to the goal they have set, towards their own destiny. So it is essential for them to have a goal and to put their will into action. Their great strength and influence bring victory and success as long as they steer their ego from consciousness and join their contradictions and their opposites in order to reach the stillness needed to know how to steer actively, without violence.
7.pareja: (-) The coward, handles their power badly. Tends towards mental rigidity, anger and fighting. (+) Brave, I put my power at the service of the collective.

8.lema: Path of consciousness of spiritual justice
8.texto: “PATH OF CONSCIOUSNESS OF SPIRITUAL JUSTICE”. «As you sow, so shall you reap». Very much a righter of wrongs, cannot stand injustice. Geburah–Chesed. Current of cosmic force – Yin / Yang. Sowing in order to start reaping. They have plenty of strength and spiritual help. It will fall to them to defend someone weaker. They need a lot of enthusiasm. Defenders and righters of wrongs. They should not develop many projects at once, a single aim. Order. Path 19. Triad of the Soul. Living my purpose or calling. There is no power greater than love. A capacity for Judgement. Loving what we do. A crosswise path of force. I live my purpose: what do I have to keep? What do I have to shift? A capacity for Judgement. Loving what we do. Blockages: Fast karma. Law of Action / Reaction. I reap what I sow. The law of «should». Fear of loneliness and of rejection. Putting my power at the service of my personal development. Everything built out of lack, and not with my essence, will come down. 19: My wisdom leads me to be one with God (who I am). Essene number, bases its growth on serving, healing and teaching. A person with a facility in health, teaching and dependency. I can love, the power of love. Everything I do from love opens up for me. Without love, Justice pulls it down. The trauma of rejection. Putting my power towards what I came to do. Feeling able to love – rejecting love. A need to balance; fear disappears when we trust. It is the representation of order and of what respects a set of rules, which is why it is usually associated with all bureaucracy. At a deeper level, it speaks to us of the need to establish codes and rules so as to lay the ground for living together, both in community and in relation to the world around us. It is the pure archetype of the mind, where reasoning, analytical intelligence and mental order prevail. Even-handedness, structure, controlled reactions and intelligent calculation are the qualities of Justice. It represents the capacity to set healthy limits, since it is an energy that does not prejudge and, in fact, tries to treat everyone equally, beyond its favouritisms. The thing is that, although it does not prejudge, it does have the capacity to judge, so it applies consequences to any infringement, its own as well as other people's. In Kabbalah we say that this path has great Spiritual strength. There is a very strong and direct connection between «Ying» and «Yang». Compassion and divine love. This is the path inwards. The person who finds themselves walking this path is very well oriented spiritually. In daily life, whenever we want to undertake something or take a decision, we should listen to our spiritual strength. Cosmic Justice works under the Law of sowing and reaping. It fits everything to do with our spiritual attitude: it is what we sow spiritually and afterwards our harvest will be the result of what we have sown. With my spiritual attitude I create my own reality in matter. I, with my inner spiritual attitude, create my own heaven or my own hell. My negative thought will give me what I sow, my positive thought will give me what I sow. We will have to learn to take considered decisions on the basis of reasonable judgements supported by intelligence and consciousness, which we will reach by making critical analyses based on objective data, but always helped by our intuitive side and our sense of justice. On this path we are asked to learn to weigh up carefully and consciously the consequences of our actions, moulding, refining and at last mastering our mental powers with dedication and shrewdness. Reason, the capacity to perceive and intelligence are capacities we can count on when we walk this path. To get the harvest we have to create with justice between what I want, what I feel, and the action of whether it is fair that I should have that. The people who walk this path have to channel their energy with order and not develop many projects at once. they have a great mental capacity, but they have to focus all their energies on one aim. To visualise it, to feel it, and to carry out the action in matter. Lastly, always asking the cosmos for permission as to whether such a purpose is fair for your life.
8.pareja: (-) Very polarised people. Conflicts about not having space, a feeling of castration. You need to be patient with these people. (+) In harmony.

9.texto: “CONSCIOUS PATH OF GOAL PROGRAMMING”. Chesed–Tiphereth. A path into the inside of the Yin, inwards. 9: the highest wisdom. Wants to go to the wisest part of the inside, programmed to look for God because they know that is what lights their path. «God's trust is my staff» – Full trust. They look for solitude from time to time, they need it. They do not want to fight; they can be a «mediator», with a deft touch. They want the misunderstanding cleared up, the fight stopped. Path 20. Triad of the Soul. I steer the light towards my inside. Who am I not to love myself? Prudence, inner master, individuation. Sought solitude. Self-sufficiency. Relationships with men of our own age. What do I not want of myself? What do I hate about myself? Blockages: Solitude, socialising at all costs. Fear of being left alone. Excessive introversion / extroversion. Money problems. A victim path, has spiritual arrogance. The lessons will have to do with lovelessness. 20: Rescue of their emotional life, the capacity to give and receive love. Number of doubts, getting past the doubts. I love, I love myself. When I open myself to love, I discover that the greatest love is towards myself. Individuation. Who am I? Who do I have to love? The Hermit holds one of the great teachings of the tarot, related to solitude and to our search for a purpose in life. This card helps us understand which part of our journey we make in complete solitude, since we are born alone and we die alone. Whoever is able to embrace solitude receives a great knowledge of themselves. It is an archetype of spiritual transcendence, related to symbolic pilgrimage: leaving what we know and handle comfortably, in order to go into the unknown and discover who we are. The Hermit symbolises serenity, patience, the capacity to detach yourself from the material world and its distractions, in order to flow with what really resonates with your authentic nature. His archetype is the wise one, quiet, solitude, concentration, stillness, calm, an adviser, enlightenment, a guide. Energy of consciousness of goal programming, understanding goal as the highest. The hermit always recognises God's presence, whatever the situation he finds himself in; he does not want confrontations. He knows that he does not have to fight: behind a fight there is always doubt, and if I fight it is because I doubt that I can really achieve it. I change fighting for faith. The highest interest is to find a solution that satisfies both sides in such a way that there is never a loser and neither side imposes itself on the other. This is the path of wisdom. The person who walks this path wants to reach wisdom by means of non-attachment, solitude and silence. It is a path of enlightenment because before there was darkness; of wisdom, because before there was ignorance; of non-attachment, solitude and silence, because before there was unwise advice, immaturity and noise. This is a path of shelter and refuge. It is a search for true knowledge on the three planes: material, mental and spiritual. To reach this knowledge, you have to accept the solitude and the meditation that every effort towards meeting yourself brings with it. The path that leads to consciousness involves understanding who we really are, independently of everything our parents, teachers, family and friends may have told us about it. This perception of the true identity is a fruit that can only be harvested in solitude and in silence. Only in this setting can we experience who we truly are. The person walking this path is going to have a very intense relationship with their subconscious. A relationship that has to be cultivated and constantly encouraged, since we must not forget that our subconscious has wonderful magical powers and protects us and helps us stay alert and awake. When we discover who we truly are, the challenge implied, from that very moment, is always to be faithful to ourselves, never to betray ourselves. It offers us as a gift the magical tool of a great activity of our subconscious in the form of an inner master who advises us and protects us. To come to live this gift we need to cultivate patience, meditation and retreat, protecting ourselves from outside influences, since we cannot force the miracle of what is granted to us only by divine will at the perfect cosmic moment; then we have to allow it to show itself in us.
9.pareja: (-) A person who needs to have their space, their silence. (+) Honesty, prudent, sound, centred.

10.texto: “CONSCIOUS PATH OF REWARD”. 10: God leaves everything open. The number of spiritual mobility. The principle of spiritual searching. Chesed–Netzach. Go past your limits = let go, come away. A wheel that never stops, everything comes back. Law of rhythm: we have to know the vibrational frequency of our thoughts. «Law of vibration». The higher the thought, the more we make the wheel turn in our life. It is important to let go: the more we let go (forgiving, grieving…), the faster the wheel will turn and the sooner the reward will come. These people have to live intuitively, without questioning it, following their sensations and hunches. That way we will get the gift of the cosmos (the reward). You expand your wisdom a little further. Path 21. The influence of the mind on the personality. I am conscious of what moves me in the shadow. I set my truth in motion in matter. The change that comes from the surroundings; the only fixed thing is that everything changes. Liberation through commitment. By accepting my change, I change my future. Travel. Being conscious of what part of my life is obstructing, which acts in my life. I love – I heal – somatised illnesses. If you want something different, do something different. Blockages: Fear of change, I shut out the new. A chronic lack of interest in the present. Apathy, resignation. Fear of the future, mask and reputation. Focused on matter and money. Trauma of rejection and of abandonment (they go together). They have to rescue their victim. 21: A need to mobilise myself spiritually, looking for unconditional love. Number of the radiant Sun inside us. Looking for God within yourself. When I love, I heal. I feel good when I am loving, children. I heal my wounds through love. Through creativity and Art. It speaks to us of our truth, of decisions to be taken. What makes me enjoy myself? What makes me grow? The Wheel of Fortune is a more complex archetype than it looks. The symbols on the wheel seem to tell us that good luck or destiny are fickle, and that you can just as easily be rising, growing and evolving as falling and regressing. But this archetype goes further, because it reveals to us that there is a possibility of mastering the Wheel of Fortune, of being above the swings of life. This is the archetype that makes us understand that both good luck and development are for those who decide to accept life's gifts. It is related to good opportunities, to what waits behind the signs, so easy and beneficial that we might call it a gift from the universe. It represents full trust that life is abundance and that gratitude and the appetite to get better mean that more and more opportunities appear. Ask, and it will be granted to you. This archetype is renewal, change, intuition, learning, mutation, cycle, drive. Living the here and now (the present), taking on our teachings, leaving the past behind. Following the dictates of our intuition. Accepting wisely that everything changes. Learning that what appears bad can be good and the other way round. I always follow the path of my intuition. I turn the wheel of destiny so that my fortune changes. I have a situation in front of me, I look at this situation and I start to analyse it, comparing it with other situations from my past. Here I take no account of my intuition. We have to throw out the path of reason, because we need intuition to appear. If we do it this way, it will appear and will help us to discover new qualities inside us for us to develop. If we follow intuition, we always expand our limitations a little further at the level of knowledge. If we follow our intuition and get success as a result, we are going to use intuition more consciously. That is why it is the path of reward, with consciousness. This result helps us take in and train intuition little by little. From there a wheel of fortune is formed, always the same circle, with new tests that force us to draw on intuition, and so on gradually. This path is one of renewal in life, the need to understand that change is necessary as well as constant and that in life this is going to show itself with ups and downs, like a wheel in constant movement. What is achieved on the material plane is the result of what is achieved on the spiritual plane as it is lived. That is why experiences are not absolute but relative, subject to changing circumstances, but these can perfectly well be controlled from the spiritual plane, and so the answers have to be looked for on this plane.
10.pareja: (-) Trapped by the shine of matter, a materialism that tries to cover up the emptiness and inner imbalance. (+) A person who knows how to enjoy what they have, whose aim is to enjoy life. Matter is a means.

11.texto: “CONSCIOUS ENERGY OF INNER STRENGTH”. Geburah–Tiphereth. 11: 2 times God = double strength. Strength born from within, security. Full confidence in oneself, feeling alive and connected with oneself. Maturity. They have to be aware of their power in order to transmute it, to have strength enough to master situations. They are very intelligent about recognising how far their strength reaches, how far they are able to go. Path 22. Triad of the Soul. Identity. I show and I am my light. How do I manifest my power? I shine without complexes, sociability. I defend my truth and who I am. I am the keeper of my individuation. Relationships with women of our own age. I recognise my limits and I accept them. Self-mastery. I can love myself. Blockages: Fear of rejection, mask. I live without spirit, focused on matter. Cowardice, weakness. Anger / frustration. Conflicts, power struggles. They have the negative aspects of Leos, if they have this path in their Kabbalah. My power serves to light me up, the power of my shine. Identity crisis. 22: Mastery of the 2 – Unconditional love. When there is no unconditional love, there is mental rigidity. Mental flexibility. Master number of unconditional Love. I can, I love myself = Unconditional love. Accepting yourself completely without judging, your most intimate instincts. I can only love myself when there is light about who I am. Am I looking for power in order to feel loved? Responsibility for our actions. Strength is the representation of the human will. The capacity we have to build our destiny and to change circumstances and surroundings in order to make the world better. It is related to steadiness, willpower, humility, patience. It is the unstoppable and incorruptible archetype. It does not give up, it does not tire, it does not impose itself. It simply goes on walking slowly towards what it has set out to do. Obstacles are only part of the process. It is an archetype that symbolises the capacity to help others, to be a pillar and to give support to whoever needs it. The card of Strength knows very well who she is, and controls her needs and reactions without crushing them. It represents the mastery of the ego. Its archetype is inner strength, security, firmness, beauty, courage, a defined character, maturity. Confidence in myself. Trust in God. Balancing our impulsive and intuitive nature by means of understanding what is hidden, of humility and of accepting what we are, opening our consciousness. Mastering our instincts by means of understanding God. Integrating our shadow. Feeling completely alive and connected with oneself. What matters is being conscious of our Strength; that is the aim of this path's energy. The energy of consciousness of trust means that trust gives us strength. This strength gives us confidence and strengthens us; it is said to give us wings. It gives us strength towards ourselves and so that others feel confident with us. On this path there are two parts, self-confidence and trust in God. It is better, however, to work on trust in God and self-confidence will come of its own accord. You have to work actively on your self-confidence, and that is why this path is on the «Yang» side. When this strength is well channelled we make ourselves respected and we come harmoniously into our own nature and inner wisdom. This path symbolises the energy of nature; to understand that nature is a manifestation of the divine energy is to reach its strength. So our own inner nature, what we call our subconscious or our dark area, is also part of this divine creation. It is important that the people who walk this path go deeper into it in order to understand it, to love it, to guide it. To master it so that it does not control us and lead us to act unpredictably or to act unconsciously, guided by our primary instincts. We have to accept and take in all these aspects of ourselves, drawing out the wonderful wisdom there is in them and not hiding them and repressing them. The person who walks this path has to be conscious of their power, to know it and to transmute it so as to know the circumstances around them and not be ruled by them. This mastery is the triumph of the spirit and the intellect over the brutality of the instincts. A triumph that is exercised only with harmony and firmness of conduct.
11.pareja: (-) A lack of self-esteem. A lack of trust in the process of life, difficulties enjoying sex, a blockage in the senses. Accepting your most intimate desires. (+) A person with great strength for taking their decisions.

12.texto: “CONSCIOUS ENERGY OF PERSEVERANCE”. Geburah–Hod (descending). Goes against the established, is able to light up (bright head). Needs to find something, knows it has to go through a sacrifice or a struggle. 12 – 3 – Thanks to a sacrifice it is able to understand something. 3 = mother, father and son. I need to come out, to be born. To create something. Odin hanging upside down to see the meaning of the runes. Needs a lot of Mars energy and a lot of skill and dexterity. A path of steadiness / perseverance. Places themselves in difficult situations in order to know. They have been through difficult situations. A path of karmic reunion. They come to settle karma, and that is why things cost them so much. They are in a great hurry to clear karma, they need to. Very good clairvoyants. Seeing things before they happen. Path 23. Yang. The influence of the mind on the personality. I give myself over to the spirit. I accept what I «have» to live from love. A karmic path. It joins my mind with my personality (social life). Light, giving yourself, the past and its influence. I make my peace with the past through acceptance. The capacity for sacrifice. Blockages: stagnation in life, melancholy and sadness. Rebellion, I do not accept my past, does not want to see it. Anger, frustration (insists on doing it one particular way). Life is too much for me, no will, resignation. Playing the victim, anchored in the past. An arcanum of paralysis. Things need their time, things are not going to come to them fast. Karma develops between the ages of 3 and 9. 3: Number of Isis (Egyptian goddess). Maximum fertility. Receptiveness. I can understand myself. Emotional intelligence, I am able to put myself in the other person's place. Throwing light on their ideals, listening to the voice of God within them. A need to find a way of expressing something new. Being conscious of what I have to communicate, reaching peace. What throws me out of harmony? Karmic: there is something we have stopped sharing so as not to follow our ideals, or something we have not let someone else manifest, a conscious abuse of power. Surrendering and submitting, accepting God's will. Feeling what vulnerability is. The Hanged Man is one of the most generous and altruistic archetypes of the tarot. He symbolises the capacity to give up your own desires for a greater good, for something really worthwhile. That capacity to put other people's needs above your own, and to put your personal talents at the service of others, receives a great spiritual benefit as its reward, and is combined with a feeling of fullness. This arcanum is related to stillness, serenity, periods of effort that aim at achieving something better and, in general, positive renunciations that bear fruit. It speaks of idealism and humility; it is an archetype that invites us to think about the human need to belong to something greater and more important than the individual. It is often related to the idea of goodness and to the concept of the divine, of the higher, and of the purpose of life. Its archetype is the test, sacrifice, will, perseverance, giving yourself, altruism. It is the path of perseverance, which shows that we want to learn persistence and perseverance. It teaches us to be persevering in the face of adversity. The person who walks this path has placed themselves in difficult situations in their life because they want to train their spiritual perseverance. They are people who are presented with very difficult situations to get through. They are very brave souls who, by sacrificing themselves for other human beings, decide on the plane of the soul to show us struggle, persistence, steadiness. From the spiritual point of view these situations often have to do with karmic reunions. The further we advance on this path the more difficult situations we are going to meet, and those situations will be more and more subtle. On this path what is sought is the inversion from the outer towards the inner, in order to look for transformation and make the most of the life situation we have chosen. It consists of finding ourselves in the situation of having to find the deepest layer of our consciousness. It is a path of renunciation and of sacrifice, in order to find enlightenment. A path of giving yourself and of humility in order to understand something deeper inside us. Duty and service come above personal desires.
12.pareja: (-) Karmic reunions, turbulent and intense relationships. I attract intense, complicated and difficult relationships into my life. You have to accept. (+) A fight with the world. Acceptance, «I accept you as you are». Acceptance, «I accept you as you are».

13.texto: “CONSCIOUSNESS OF TRANSFORMATION”. Tiphereth–Netzach. Yin-passive movement. They do not get attached to anything. They are changing all the time, they have to learn. Archangel Raphael. Constant death and renewal. Break – die – transcend. The soul wants to live its creative force (Sun) and a varied, exciting life; they cannot bear monotony. They live very fast, they need to. They need free space, to bring out their creative force. In a company, if you have a partner with this path, you have to understand that transformation. Path 24. A link between the mind and the personality. Flowing from the battlefield. Healing through love. I let go of the sterile part of my life. Death of the ego, of the victim. Light, forgetting, forgiveness towards oneself. Relationships with teenage children. Acceptance of the emotional torments. Non-attachment and letting go of what is false. Either I am in forgetting or in forgiving. Blockages: Dark night of the soul (emotional aspect). Fear of and resistance to change. I put off decisions about my life. Extreme self-criticism / anger / hatred. Emotional loss of control. Guilt after the destructive outburst. Robberies, murders. 24: Fulfilment in matter in order to reach unconditional love. Number of faith in matter. Behind it there is a decisive decision and tension, there is ego (2+4=6). A process of transformation, nothing is the same any more. I heal when I love myself. The ego disappears = the neuroses. It gives light to the heart, a new way of living. Closing a cycle, a new paradigm. The sun lights up the capacity to enjoy (Venus). Non-attachment, coming out of the victim role. The Death card is the basic archetype of transformation and change. It represents the natural cycles of the seeds that grow, flower and die, in order to be born again the following spring. It is the idea of metamorphosis: leaving behind the identity of the past so that you can go on growing. This archetype of natural change happens at every stage of life, every time we cut away thoughts, situations and definitions that have become obsolete and no longer nourish you. To go on feeding yourself and growing you have to let go of what was, and to flow with what is. It is related to maturity, to becoming conscious and changing, to cutting away what is no longer of use, starting with the material and reaching the soul. It also represents loss in its widest sense and the mourning for the things, people and situations of life we have to say goodbye to. The archetype of Death, transformation, change, transmutation, regeneration, the final solution, liberation, purification, the death of concepts. This death represents the end and the beginning of something. To renew ourselves we first have to finish with the old. Whenever our soul wants to transform itself we have to break, die, transcend. It is so in all the cycles: birth, growth and death. On this path this law of as it is inside, so it is outside. The people who walk this path are people with a lot of imagination, creativity. They need a multiple and very changeable life. They always look to renew themselves, new paths, new learnings; they are in a great hurry to close cycles so as to open themselves again to other possibilities. They need freedom, independence, so that they can live their creative force. But the risk of this path is that others can think they are mad and that they never sit still anywhere. These people want to decide everything for themselves and the way they do it. This path refers to spiritual renewal in a conscious form, which is why they need constant evolution and self-improvement. It leads us to an energy of liberation; however, immobility and fears of change bring on the opposite, attracting apathy and frustration. This path symbolises the death of the circumstantial ego and the disappearance of the needs created by our mind. In nature life and death are inseparable, the one and the other are joined. Here you live change, the loss of old habits formed by the ego. We have to go through the fear in order to make the changes that lead to a necessary renewal. The ties of dependency are cut so that we can get back the freedom we had lost.
13.pareja: Understanding that life is constant change. (-) Self-limiting beliefs, paralysing fears. People who have been in therapy for years. (+) People who flow with life, with no fear of changes. Non-attachment.

14.texto: “CONSCIOUS ENERGY OF FLEXIBLE GOVERNMENT”. Communication between the unconscious and the conscious. Energy of communication. Power of communication. Tiphereth–Yesod. They are leaders. High spiritual current. They can bring stability and reconciliation with those around them. We should flow; she is surrounded by water. Born to communicate, a charismatic leader. Towards the common good. Does not let themselves be ruled by matter, speaks according to what they are feeling. They want to guide us, but they are always an example, they do not impose. They put themselves at the service of others. «We are going to achieve», not «I achieved»; it is teamwork. If they carry the path well, they have a lot of help, spiritual capacities. Path 25. Path of the arrow. Flowing with life and the universe. I pacify by example, I live my purpose, without noise. A link between mind and personality. Light: flexibility and adaptability to all circumstances. Temperance and balance (the mid-point between extremes). Acceptance of the failings of ambiguity. I accept the other person. Blockages: Identity crisis and excesses. Imbalance. Extreme duality, mask and ignorance. Fears from a lack of understanding of my being. A compulsive search for gurus and masters. A need to feel special. Touchiness and vulnerability to the astral. Disconnection from my essence. A true spiritual guide, practises what they preach. In the measure that I understand myself, I love myself. I love myself because I understand myself, I love myself because I am at peace. The Sun lights up my Moon, emotions, mother… Mastery of the emotions. Who I am. Ego. 25: Number of luck, fortune and happiness. Living the expression of your soul. I love myself, I take part. I love myself when I take part in my soul's plan. My deeds are fertile when I love myself. What it is that I really need in order to touch my work. Tempering their emotions; that is where they discharge energetically. It throws light on our purpose (gold). The ego has to say «I am at your service and I do what I have to do». Honest sexuality. Temperance symbolises balance, the mid-point that takes in the extremes. It is moderation, mediation and serenity, when all the levels of consciousness are balanced, in a natural and peaceful way. It is related to meditation, to energy work, to transcendent wisdom and to harmony. Temperance represents the conciliation that comes from deep understanding: it accepts both the positive and the negative, and places itself in the middle. It expresses calm, stability, harmony, balance, peace, and the capacity to pass all these virtues on to others. It is a very spiritual archetype that has reached a deep understanding of existence. Archetypes: Harmony, communication, self-mastery, an inner guide, stability, prudence, reconciliation, guardian angel, calm, fluidity. Flexible government. The people who walk this path have to learn to rule out any kind of power struggle. They want to learn their own self-mastery. They need to be able to do their task here on this Earth. This task is to be a leader, a charismatic leader. They will put their spiritual capacities to the test, in order to steer, to guide, and to pass things on to other people from the strength of their centre. The capacities for this path are humility, honesty, loyalty, commitment. This path urges us to put ourselves in the hands of the higher guide, and by putting ourselves in the hands of that force that is inside us, we wake the guidance of the spiritual forces that are in the subconscious. The people who walk this path will also guide other people, and that is why they will have to go towards their centre, let things happen and listen to their inner voice. These leaders have to discover their spiritual capacities little by little.
14.pareja: Mastery of consciousness. A spiritual guide. The enlightened man is able to rescue his subconscious from the shadows of the moon and light them up in the Sun. «Practise what you preach».

15.texto: “CONSCIOUS ENERGY OF RENEWAL”. Tiphereth–Hod. An active path: if it looks, it will find the Sun. The darkest part of a person is part of us. A fear can enslave you, it is darkness. They need to draw the devilish out of their thoughts. They have to take out the negative; if they manage it, they react and can become great healers. They draw out what is devilish, they clean. They come to purify others. They can be found in settings to do with the environment. The force of love, in order to be a true healer. Helping your neighbour and yourself. Freedom of the spirit, bringing out our demons, being conscious of our negative desires and thoughts and being able to admit that they are part of our personality. Path 26. A link between Mind and Personality. I understand my emotions. What makes me free and what makes me a slave? Light: acceptance of my mental confusion. Light to free ourselves, a tendency to dependencies (false gratification). Relationships with children or descendants. Slavery = the instinctive. I am not afraid of my shadow, I know what its power is and I take responsibility for it. Blockage: subconscious, ignorance. Memory of unpleasant experiences. A feeling of dirtiness, of having something bad. Fears and mental darkness. A destructive nature. A need to understand the dark side of life. I understand, I understand myself (I love myself); I have to throw light on my mind. Rebelling against reality, against rules. 26: What stops unconditional love is my ego. Accepting my part in matter. Number of the ego and of duality. I refuse to accept the changes in my life. I love myself and I understand myself. The only way to love ourselves is to understand ourselves and to be clear about who I am. If my mind is not with my emotions, I do not know what my gifts and capacities are. The connection is cut. Hod receives the echo of Chokmah. We fall into indulgence with ourselves, I deceive myself, a love that is not true. Becoming conscious that we are the ones putting the obstacle there. This archetype represents the shadow, the dark, sometimes denied, part of our personality. It is an energy related to pure desire, to getting everything you want. It has to do with survival and with the ego, and with the animal, wild part inside the human being. It represents power and ambition, charisma, a magnetic personality, an absence of empathy and the capacity to use any resource to get what you want, with no remorse and no scruple. It is also related to primitive needs and to sexuality. One of the great teachings of the Devil is to help us question how much of our shadow we recognise and how much we take in our own power. To understand this unlimited energy is to learn to use it as you decide, to create or to destroy. ARCHETYPES: Warnings, matter, attachments, temptation, healing, consciousness of the dark parts, fears. The person who walks this path needs to draw the devilish out of situations, out of people, out of circumstances, so as to renew their surroundings and purify them. It is a path of renewal, of drawing the negative out of thoughts. If I manage to draw the negative out of thoughts then I act, I do not react. It is a healer's path, since the person who walks it wants to devote themselves to healing, of people, of companies, and so on. They are also people who want to heal the environment, and they can become people who clean, who look after nature, so renewing the dirt others leave. What matters on this path is the acceptance of that shadow side that every human being has, and creatively and with love polishing it, giving it light, and working on it. The fears, the traumas, the experiences are in our human side, they are in the subconscious and they tie us down in some circumstances of our life; the more conscious we become of those monsters, the more easily we will be able to take them out of ourselves and of others, and this is natural healing. This healer's path will give us chances to heal companies, places, families, since, by accepting the shadow in full light, it will be easy for these people to see it and clean it. The universe has a reward for them for this arduous work of love. This reward is the true freedom of the spirit. So that our soul can grow more and more inside us, and that will turn us into beings of light, and more and more light. Freedom of the spirit is seeing the demons in our thoughts and taking them out, purifying our mind and removing the chains of the slavery to which, without meaning to, we find ourselves subjected by thoughts that limit us.
15.pareja: (-) Infidelities. A person cut off from their truth, looks for the immediate reward, falls into the temptations of the ego, toxic relationships. As a path of Destiny, they have to master their shadow, their instincts. (+) Very high emotional intelligence.

16.texto: “CONSCIOUS ENERGY OF ENTHUSIASM”. Hod–Netzach. A lot of energy, Yin-Yang, and you have to know how to use it. A path of enthusiasm and constant renewal. Spiritual motivation. Motivation to be of use to ourselves. They are highly motivated, they can pass it on and encourage others to grow. To help. It brings people together. They want greatness, to reach the maximum, the summit. They have to motivate themselves in order to achieve the maximum. A path of ambition. These people have had a lot of success in other incarnations and because of the comfort they have lost their motivation. They can raise castles if they wish, but if they prop themselves up and let themselves go, the Tower will bring the castle down on them in the blink of an eye. Motivation helps them let go of old ideas and renew them over and over. Creating new opportunities for growth. We free ourselves from blockages. Path 27 – crosswise. Triad of matter. Behind the crisis is the liberation. I understand what heals my life. What went was not me. What am I building my life on? It is only activated when the spirit wants to bring order to matter. A person who has fought a lot in life, used to starting from zero several times. Getting past a personal crisis, removing ties. Learning through hard situations. The fall of the mask and of what has no truth in it. Blockages: I do not meet my needs, I am worth nothing. Fear of material lack. An extreme need to be accepted. Mask. Being trapped in the past. Fear and depression. I do not learn from the past. A cure of Humility. 27: healing, discovering the truth behind the appearance so as to find love, spirit in your life. Number of the esoteric student. A path of force and polarity. Trauma of abandonment. I understand myself and I heal. When I understand what it is that hurts me, I decide to stop suffering. Taking the dead weights out of our life, what does not belong to us. What is it that makes me enjoy life? Freeing yourself from the inner and outer prisons. Work of discipline and endurance. Will. Energy of transformation, nothing is the same any more. When you notice something new, you cannot pretend you do not know it. Dismantling inner and outer limitations. The Tower symbolises what we cannot control. It is the outside influences, what destroys the ideas we had made for ourselves and that crumble in the face of reality. It is a card linked to disappointment, to the fall, to the feeling of betrayal, and one that can be associated with a time of anguish and pain, above all if it is rejected. It is related to the need to knock down ideas and mental structures that are no longer valid, but it also symbolises breaking with those elements of our path that no longer stand up, that are fancies and daydreams, or simple prejudices. Within itself, the Tower represents the antagonism of arrogance and humility. It helps us understand that we are simply human, and to accept that a small part of our lives is not under our control, but in the hands of life. Archetype: Liberation, destruction, separation, the end, resistance, the house, the ego, the end of old structures, radical change. Here we have a path of enthusiasm and constant renewal. It is about spiritual motivation, and this comes out of my attitude, of my inside. They should not start anything until that enthusiasm is there and that energy is released. It is an energy that serves to bring people together, to join them, and to help each other. The person who walks this path does everything in their power to achieve the highest, to reach places of prestige, to get promoted at work, always to get their objective. If the aim of this learning is lost, life and the soul begin to give them enough grief to make them go back to the task, and they will have to motivate themselves again to raise the castle once more. That motivation drags you into letting go of old ideas and renewing them over and over so as not to fall into slackness; and so in this way the motivation this path teaches us will go hand in hand, over and over, with new opportunities and growth. You live situations of sudden change, which will sweep everything away and transform it radically in order to free us and to reach the true vision of ourselves.
16.pareja: (-) Advice: «Run as if there were no tomorrow». (+) Super-vital, putting the ashes back together.

17.texto: “ENERGY OF COSMIC NATURE”. Water = emotions. Yesod–Netzach, ascending direction. To light up and understand, to see beyond worldly eyes. Looking further. Wisdom, trust, beginning, joy, the cosmos, fertility, creativity, altruism. Trust in the future, feeling fresh and young. Is not aware of the beauty of things and of other people, needs to understand it. Looking for the beauty in others. Seeing with different eyes. Seeing beyond things; they will have to make an effort. They have to let themselves feel (Yin). They have many abilities they do not know about yet (Moon). Looking into what is behind people, situations. If they achieve this ability, the cosmos gives them the gift of feeling closer to God. Listening to your inner voice. The soul. In the cosmos time does not exist. Flowing with the rhythms of nature. It represents the guide we carry inside. It is a path of faith. It has to be felt. Path 28, Yin. I balance myself and I heal myself. Where do I feel that I do not flow in life? Light: New sap to the energetic structure. Magic, sexuality. Anchored in the earth. Renewal through the natural cycles. Working in solitude, my Tikun (purpose). Creativity and working alone. Reassesses her values, her life: what is hers and what is the family's (the mother's). Blockages: inability to work alone / working alone to excess, even when the task calls for solitude. Unreality, a lack of practical sense (clematis). Self-limiting beliefs / nonconformity. Playing the victim. Needs to flow with their physicality. I need to understand myself in order to heal myself. I heal, I take part. 28: Number of self-responsibility. In the measure that I take part in life, I heal, doing what I came to do. Revelation of the needs, the need to be fertile. Bringing something new to the world. Anything that is not that is worth nothing. Carrying out your purpose. Living a transforming life; I add myself in when I take part in my plan. Allowing yourself to live the truth that transforms me. This is the archetype of deep communication, and also of creativity. The Star represents your inner light, and the way you have of expressing it through any medium, speaking, writing, painting… It is related to all the forms of art, and has a special way of understanding beauty and nature. It is a clean, innocent and transparent energy, which marvels at the world, exploring it, discovering, and letting itself be carried along by a deep feeling of gratitude. The Star reminds us how important it is to find like-minded people with whom you can talk about everything and share the most luminous gifts you have, those qualities that make you unique and special. It is the way we connect meaningfully and inspiringly. Archetype: wisdom, trust, elevation, prosperity, beginning, joy, purity, the cosmos, altruism, fertility, creativity, celebrations. The feeling of the star is trust in the future, feeling fresh and young. This feeling comes when there is a sense of union with the cosmos and with everything. This path has the influence of Venus and of the Moon. This means that for a time in their life the person is not aware of the inner beauty of people and of things. The water is always flowing, as if showing that the capacities we do not yet know about, which are in the subconscious, are still to be discovered and that they are abundant, unlimited. Consciousness of cosmic nature would be the opposite of worldly nature. Worldly nature can be touched, seen, measured. Cosmic nature is everything that comes out of that; it is what is still unconscious for us. The first aim is to recognise it. This kind of process is usually painful. Because if I can see behind things, I realise that I can step into the course of the events of my own life. The more able I am to look behind things, the more consciousness I will wake in myself, and I will see how the spiritual world flows in my life, and I will enter into harmony with the whole, and with the cosmos. It is important to concentrate on the «what for» of things and so at last to see the reason behind those circumstances. The cosmos rewards us with trust, each time we are able to see the invisible and cross the barrier of human eyes. Trusting that the cosmos supplies us with what we need at every moment. For the person who walks this path, it is important to feel fulfilled as a human being. They will have to be able to see, or to have a cosmic vision of, themselves and of what they are capable of becoming. The first thing is to feel it, to see it and to let it happen.
17.pareja: (-) Needs therapy. Needs to understand why they do not live their dreams, why they are always the victim. Am I my mother? Or do I hate my mother? Malignant thoughts. They tend to have emotional outbursts they do not control their emotions. (+) The healing of the deep subconscious. Balance related to their purpose in life.

18.texto: “CONSCIOUS ENERGY OF PURIFICATION”. An old soul, not for having lived a long time but for having had many learnings. In a great hurry, the sense that there is something they have to do. They need earth learnings, with roots. It has to do with the unconscious. They have to come away from everything they have lived in order to be conscious of your place on the earth. The hidden, the night, hidden capacities, feminine. They run the risk of escaping in order to return on their path to their place of origin. Feet planted in the earth. They reflect back to us what is dark in us, they make us see it. I learn from every person I meet. Those on this path project; you can see your own image in them. They feel like something unpleasant, because of what they reflect back to us of ourselves. People who pull at you, so that you learn that you have to get better. Developing faculties. Living my dreams. Path 29. Yin. Fear as a path of transformation and reunion. What am I afraid of? A path of reassessment and karma (yin). Malkuth Netzach (Alternative). Light: daring to live. Sexuality as emotional expression. Magic tied to the earth, the mother. Cleaning and purifying my fears. Contact (physical, emotional, with the other person). The fall of the veil of illusion (Queset). Blockages: trapped in my fears. Confusion between emotion and feeling. Trapped in the past, nostalgia. Deep sadness, trapped in illusion. I have not had the courage to set things in motion. I fulfil myself when I heal myself. By going through my fears. The energy of the moon makes me anchor myself in the past and the family (the mother). If I am not healed I do not fulfil myself. If I do not fulfil myself I do not heal. A path of contact; there may be disordered, denied sexuality… Mental illness or health. Together with the star. 29: Through listening to the heart I reach unconditional love. Number of the mental labyrinth. I make my Venus material. Karmic. I heal – I fulfil myself – the solution is inside. An opening towards something I carry inside. Art, creating life. I have not made my creativity material out of fear. Fears from past lives, trauma of authority, rejection, abandonment. Exercise: Make a list of all your fears. Relate our fears to change. Fear of healing myself, the victim role. Together with the child. The solution = going through the fears. (They come from other lives). This is probably the most complex archetype of the tarot, because within itself it shows cyclical and also antagonistic aspects, just like the moon (full moon with maximum light and new moon with maximum darkness). It connects with the unconscious, intuitive, sensitive, imaginative and empathetic part. The Moon speaks to us of the inner world, of our dreams and fantasies, and of what we can show others through creativity. It represents the capacity to flow and adapt, and to relate to others by being a mirror, blending in some way with what surrounds it. This arcanum teaches us that those emotions that tradition understands as negative are part of us and have a primary function of connecting us to others, of putting us in their place and feeling compassion. It is also related to melancholy and mourning, and in general to everything we need to heal through the emotions and by taking on our own fragility. Archetype: The hidden, the night, the subconscious, intuition, dreams, the psyche, feminine, the reflection, warnings, hidden capacities. Every person we meet acts as a mirror of ourselves. God at the beginning created us in his image and likeness in order to recognise himself. When I am able to see in others things of myself, then I can begin to work in the right direction, and that is why it is very important to bear this in mind, since it lets us work on ourselves and purify ourselves. When someone comes along and reflects back to me something that is in me, it is very hard for us to accept that there is something we do not like about ourselves. I am a being eager to learn and able to evolve within myself. That is, I want to learn and I can evolve through that. This learning only works when I am willing to change myself. If, on the contrary, I believe I am perfect and only expect others to change, this is going to bring on a lot of pain. Once we have remembered and become conscious of cleaning and purifying ourselves through this path, we turn into mirrors that reflect in only one direction. We turn into reflections for others, seeing what they have to purify, and it no longer comes back, because we have seen to cleaning our own well. Old souls often come with that purpose, making themselves available to reflect so that it is easier to find yourself in the deepest part. It takes a lot of love to become a single mirror, since we will see what we want and what we do not want amplified.
18.pareja: (-) A woman: is she looking for dad in her partner? A man: is he looking for mum in his partner? (+) I go through my fears.

19.texto: “CONSCIOUS ENERGY OF COLLECTIVITY”. Yesod–Hod. Wants what is good for the family, for the community. They suffer when there is division.
