Light, day, childhood, success, health, energy, family… A path of much light. A path of groups; it is good for them to do things in a group. They want to rest with souls, to feel that connection. They come to unite. To wrap others up and to feel wrapped up. They want to be leaders, and they take an interest in their collective. A good intermediary and conciliator. They try to clean up the lacks in order to heal. Learning: not isolating yourself, living in a collective. Wisdom, within nature. It gives strength to give out that shine of the sun, which has been covered over by an earlier lack (the child). They have to make their peace with themselves and with the world. Path 30. Yang. Triad of matter. I am not afraid to be who I am. What stops me shining? A dialogue between the concrete mind and what nourishes my needs in matter. Light: solar personality. Conciliation of mind and emotion. Creativity in the collective. Accepting the other person's reasons. Fertile work in a group. Fertile sexual union – (children). Blockages: devaluation, a lack of self-esteem. Dissociation of the ego, problems, identity. Superficiality and selfishness. I do not recognise myself, I do not accept my mistakes. 30: Unblocking our life so that it is fertile. Number of unproductiveness and stagnation. 30 – 39: Reaching cosmic fertility (The Empress). Sharing my gifts. I understand myself, I take part. I understand my needs, fears, lacks. When I understand myself I am able to act actively in the divine plan. Extra help to light up this part; the saboteur is left exposed. Strength to make the change. Something we need to manifest inside. Relationships. Starts transforming relationships, builds. It lights up our needs. Financial independence in order to evolve – finances. The Sun is the archetype of happiness and joy. It represents the community and how it can be improved through collaboration. It is the archetype with the most positive mentality, and it always approaches any matter from an optimistic perspective. The Sun does not worry about things, it deals with them. One of the most interesting parts of this arcanum is that the source of its happiness is not that things go well for it. The Sun is happy because it has decided to be. Every morning it practises its best smile and its overflowing energy, and tries to pass them on to those around it. It is a beneficial will, which flows in tune with life, which delights in small things and enjoys surrounding itself with the people it loves. It is the determination of joy, happiness conquered step by step. It is the path for waking collective consciousness or community. It is a path of groups, of spiritual centres, of meditation groups, of positive gatherings. What matters here is creating a union between people, in order to unite and bind themselves back again with other souls. The person who walks this path wants the highest good of all, and needs to form communities where personal evolution is the aim. NGOs, spiritual groups, healing groups, country houses; in the family they will be the people who take charge of keeping the community together. They can come to suffer a great deal when people turn a separation into an isolation, since for them the aim is to unite and to keep the well-being and the unification of souls. The child will need to see that between the parents there is still communication and human harmony. Keeping the community together, and making sure harmony exists, will be some of this person's crucial aims. If a soul has chosen this path, it is also that it has decided to learn what it is not to isolate yourself and to live in a collective. Walking this path, more and more capacities will be released from inside and I am going to be more able, since it is ruled by the Moon. The person who walks this path has to understand that their mission is to make their peace with themselves, to reconcile their animal nature and their spiritual nature, and so in the union of the two a new rebirth comes about towards the path of light and inner wisdom. Spiritual maturity is the aim, and being able to live life from the spiritual purity that brings on the awakening and the liberation of our inner child.
19.pareja: (-) Demands all the attention. The narcissist, hogging the spotlight. Oriented towards the social, towards shining. (+) Noble, committed, works for the community.

20.texto: “CONSCIOUS ENERGY OF REVIVAL”. Hod–Malkuth path. Helps people to rise. An old soul. They come to help close karma. They are in a great hurry, they have something very specific to learn. They go through hard situations and have to free themselves by bringing order to them. Freeing situations actively. Freeing the chaos, bringing order. Harmony and quiet. Helps to revive others. Moving the things that are stagnant and bringing order where there is chaos. A path of karmic reunions. The plane of psychosomatic force. Archetype: inner judgement, order, values, agreements, judgements. Many recognitions between souls, much recognition of situations that have to be brought to a close so that cycles can be closed. Helping people make the process easier. A feeling of excessive responsibility; they can fall into guilt. Path 31. Yang. The influence of the mind on the personality. A karmic path and a path of resitting the exam: the soul feels ready to go to the next level. It speaks to us of the rational mind. Light: acceptance of my final acts. I gather what I have sown. Responsibility for what I think and feel. Receptive to the cosmic message. My family ties and the immediate surroundings. I see to my life. Blockages: I feel overwhelmed, drained of life. Passivity and a blockage in life. I do not find my place in the clan. Family karma. My life worries me. I understand my role in life in order to fulfil myself. How the child soaks up the family's values. How we build our life, according to our way of thinking. I understand myself, I fulfil myself. I understand, I take part. Am I the solution or the problem? Making material what I understand myself to be. A mental need to fulfil myself. What I have stopped manifesting in matter, or something others have stopped manifesting. They show themselves in the family, they clear karma with one another. Praying and asking is good. A need to have faith and to accept. Acceptance of the situations. The aspect of the enlightened family. Pink and blue = violet = last rites. Judgement is the archetype of renewal, of reinventing yourself. It is related to waking up after a time «asleep», it is becoming conscious. It has to do with the capacity to question yourself about what is really important, and to act accordingly. This energy involves changes, when you say goodbye once and for all to those things that had in fact been «dead» for some time, in order to focus on what the soul truly wants. It is a card of rebirth, of serene change that involves knowing very well who you are and what you really want to achieve in your life. It is a deep connection with the truth, and the capacity to sift and separate the gold from the gravel. It involves calling all your beliefs and life situations into question. Archetype: inner judgement, order, values, spiritual justice, the call, attention, agreements, judgements. A need to root yourself to the root and to live the present. An old soul with many lived experiences behind them. Here there are many recognitions between souls, and there is much recognition of situations that have to be brought to a close so that cycles can be closed. This energy of consciousness of revival will help us relive karmic encounters with other souls in order to bring to a close processes that were left pending and unresolved. Revival also means having the help of souls that have been with us at some other moment, supporting us and helping us; those encounters are gifts to make this process easier. You have to try to free situations actively, since we find the yang force and the Earth that leaves us in the place that belongs to us. The person who walks this path has the mission of moving the things that are stagnant, and above all of bringing order where there is chaos. That is why they can find themselves in difficult situations where they will have to be active and to notice the karmic situation that has to be brought to a close, bringing order, discipline and serene judgement, and from a place of calm. The people who walk this path want to learn the highest art of healing. It is the master path in the art of healing. At first they may have feelings of guilt because either they feel responsible for the situation or because they have not been able to resolve it. But if we look at a deep level we realise that the reason is that many karmic reunions are taking place. Only by opening our heart and doing committed work to unify our opposites and master our lower nature will we be able to reach the resurrection and the true healing of our trinity. Learning to transcend the ego and you return to your inside, knowing your lights and your shadows.
20.pareja: (-) A tendency to have complicated situations that get blocked; instead of accepting, they fight. (+) Accepts, is able to hold out and bring the best out of complicated situations.

21.lema: Conscious energy of true success in life
21.texto: “CONSCIOUS ENERGY OF TRUE SUCCESS IN LIFE”. Malkuth–Yesod. Feet on the ground. An old soul. The four figures = the four evangelists. Everything I want to achieve, I am going to achieve. Laurel = triumph in love, money… The number 4 = it is magic for bringing matter into my life. Example: 4 laurel leaves. A path of victory, they want to achieve great things. They have to be clear about what they want. They have to share, to teach others. To share with others what they have achieved. True success in life, the highest path of a good kabbalist. What is essential? What is my calling? Selfishness and personal gain do not come into it. As long as they share, the successes are greater. Another very important thing on this path is that people who set out to achieve something will come to reach it, since their soul wants to learn with success, with joy. When they have achieved the purpose, they will have to share it with others. The strength of the moon puts itself at their disposal. Mother earth sees to supplying you. «Happiness never has an end» is their motto. Path 32. Path of the arrow. Where do I have to put a full stop? I concentrate my strength. It is ruled by Saturn, reality. Light: I close cycles and open a new stage of life. An empathetic capacity (getting into someone else's skin). Deep listening (beyond appearances). I accept the pain and I transcend them. Tau path – or the cross of sorrows. Material fulfilment, being yourself. Blockages: a lack of will through focusing on the family. I forget myself, I forget my surroundings. Unnecessary suffering, I let myself be trodden on. Stagnation through not making things concrete. A very painful path, you face the shadow. I take part – I fulfil myself. When I take responsibility for my purpose, I fulfil myself. A path of resitting the exam, the soul goes all in. A path of old souls, learning to plant your feet firmly and to live rooted in our place. Good polarity, a path of control of consciousness. Total materialisation, material-spiritual. The truth of unconditional love, full acceptance. Fulfilment in every aspect of their life. They cannot lose energy on anything that is not productive. Closing cycles from love. The purest act of love there is. The World is the last card, and in a way it takes in the knowledge of all the other arcana. It symbolises fullness, complete fulfilment, the acceptance of everything that makes you up. It speaks of generosity, of altruism and of having access to all the virtues of the human being. It is the card of the being in fullness, the one who understands themselves and who understands the world and the people around them, with their motives and reactions. We take in this archetype when we are able to feel genuine interest in things or people other than ourselves. It represents what is full and complete, when the purpose of life is being lived, or at least you are on the path to achieving it. In a deeper way, the World refers to oneness; it invites us to reflect on what links us with everything that exists. It is the interconnection between all living beings and the universe. This archetype helps us understand that we are all part of one and the same energy, that we are part of an integrated whole and that we are connected by the same thread of life with all creatures. Archetype: Triumph, victory, true success, protection, fullness, culmination, perfection, goals achieved, elevation. These people are in a hurry to fulfil their aims, and they look for the cosmic egg, the protection of the cosmos, the fullness of feeling at home again. Here the following question has to be asked: what is true success in life for me? What is it that is really important to me? What is it that really makes me happy? What is essential, what is my true calling? Perhaps they will begin to realise that they will have to prioritise and focus on what they really want to achieve, and this will help them plant both feet on the Earth. Not doing only what is to my advantage, but rather, once I have achieved it, being willing to share it with others, and to think of others, without forgetting myself. Here it is very important to find the true calling and to do the things that really make you happy, because happiness never has an end. In the calling, talents that were deep inside will be discovered, one capacity after another, and the personality more and more settled, greater. Mother Earth will see to it that you have your place, and that you manage to connect your root with her womb. Work with the Earth and Nature.
21.pareja: (-) Closing cycles. Needs every aspect of their life to work. There is frustration. (+) Everything is perfect, the world at their feet.

2.texto: To begin with they will distrust people. They want all or nothing, and half measures are no use to them. Their energy runs in a cascade, so that as soon as they manage to carry one learning through well, that energy falls back and frees the others. They can be afraid that matter will not be enough, afraid of losing control and bolting. They often feel little loved, and they get tense when someone tries to influence them by imposing dogma. They make excuses when they think they ought to be doing something else, or concentrating and getting organised. Under God's motto they come to sacrifice themselves for other people, to serve and to see God in others, giving themselves through their calling. On matters of decision, they have to take the decisions that have to do with their money and their matter.
2.negativo: Denial of their emotions and the crushing weight of reason. Disconnected from their essence.
2.positivo: Learning unconditional love. Opening yourself to the power and the strength of your own Soul. Their soul goes all in.

3.texto: At certain moments they can feel that they do not fit on this earth, but it is they who feel that way. Great inventors, because they have a lot of creative energy and are co-creators. They need a great deal of energy to start things. Once they are under way they do not stop, but beginnings are hard for them. They need to live God from joy, from life, from active energy: «less talking and more doing». Their decisions should come from inside and always from an openness to stepping out of the routine and trying to make new decisions. Their security lies in being authentic, in not blocking themselves and in expressing who they are.
3.negativo: Mental rigidity, stubbornness, refuses to help and love others.
3.positivo: Getting past their rational limitations and developing their fertility, or capacity to give and share themselves.

4.texto: They come to clear karma, through communication; they need to free themselves from old ties, from slavery, and that is why they are free spirits. This structure carries the energy of luck. They need to live God in a very material and very worldly way, with closeness and healing work with the sick, and by doing things others do not dare to do. Meditation is for them the best tool for reaching their harmony. For a long time they have not believed in their potential, and that is why in this life they have to wake their virtues up. They have to take decisions without getting tense, without taking the blame for the results, letting God show himself in the results. They usually have a lot of charisma, but they have to want the same freedom for others that they want for themselves.
4.negativo: Trapped in matter by fears, I do not learn from life.
4.positivo: Learning in matter. Getting past the fears and darkness to do with matter.

5.texto: These structures have the number of the Messiah; they want to take Jesus as an example for their lives. They wish to live God as he did: love your neighbour as yourself. They have to be especially careful that the energy of a couple does not lead them to be afraid of expressing themselves, or to lose their freedom and independence. They make good volunteers: helping animals, and creation, NGOs, union with nature. They have a great longing to return home, they often feel the call of the soul, which is a reward of help when they are deeply distressed. Free, with no pressure in their spirituality.
5.negativo: A cold technocrat with no conscience, materialistic, learned and pedantic.
5.positivo: Learning of the soul. Learning to live from my wisdom and self-awareness in the service of others.

6.texto: The divine has great force in their life. Their soul wants them to try, to experience strength and steadiness, to put themselves to the test. They wish to live spiritual couples of the soul. In the family they are good guides, they are strong pillars for their children and friends. They want to learn in an esoteric way, and they come to bring order to their life and to other people's. They can go a long time without feeling God in their search, until in the end they find him inside themselves, but their insecurity can lead them to doubt that they are able to do these things. They have to set priorities so that their energy does not escape and get lost, so that they can get better results.
6.positivo: Polarity, duality. Polarity as the engine that generates consciousness so that I can focus correctly in matter.

7.texto: They demand a lot of themselves, trying to do everything perfectly. Matter matters to them, because what they have they give away in order to help. They too look for freedom of the spirit, and they tend to come across people who want to possess and control them. They wish to live the 22 paths of initiation. They can feel guilty about everything, because of their need to do things perfectly. Understanding and charisma at work. Happiness and enthusiasm are important to them. They have a strong sense of justice. The best way for them to put themselves back together is sacred geometry.
7.negativo: Neglect, irresponsibility, ignorance, does not fulfil their purpose.
7.positivo: Becoming aware of what I have come here to do. Looking for refinement and awareness in matter.

8.texto: Temptation: this is the structure of temptation. They have to show which way they decide to lean in this life, to live being open to decisions. They can lose themselves in order to get others out of their spiritual labyrinths. For a long time the physical, the superficial and the material will matter to them, until they realise that this does not take them to the depth of their being. They need everything very fast, and they have to learn patience and inner calm. Deeply emotional, they suffer when their feelings are not returned and their skin tends to break out. They make good psychologists and therapists.
8.negativo: Lost in their spiritual labyrinth. Searches and does not find. Does not accept their tasks and does not connect with their divinity. A slave to their fears.
8.positivo: Freeing yourself from fears, emotional cleansing and finding freedom again by being in communion with the Soul.

9.texto: A great capacity to love, very open to new possibilities. Their structure carries the Essene motto. TO HELP, TO TEACH AND TO HEAL. They like to express themselves in small circles, they tend to be very deep and from childhood they have a great need to resolve questions such as: where do I come from? what am I doing here? where am I going? What others think affects them, and those influences will help them recognise themselves and take decisions from their soul's needs. They can fall victim to jealousy, suspicion and distrust, because they have to learn to love themselves and to be sure of themselves. The family circle matters a great deal to them, keeping friends together. Trust in God is their motto. DOCTORS, HEALERS, NATURAL MEDICINE.
9.positivo: A spiritual task. Selfless service to humanity (To Help, To Teach, To Heal).

10.texto: A great capacity for telepathy and for reading thoughts. God has many forms, is everywhere, God is free. They wish to live God in respect and in the wisdom that everything is open for them to find him. They want to infect others with their enthusiasm. This structure wants to motivate others. Spiritual advisers, personal trainers. Love for one's neighbour, trusting in human change. They wish to be aware of God's presence in everything.
10.negativo: Spiritual anxiety, mental and emotional confusion, rigidity and denial of your gifts. You do not find the thing that makes you happy.
10.positivo: Finding their calling in life and becoming a co-creator by taking part in the divine plan. Their soul goes all in. The energetic structures where we find most tension are: • In structure 6: the somatisations coincide with the axes of tension. • In structures 10 and 2: because of the cascading movement of energy, their learnings are chained together like dominoes.

1.texto: Rear opening of the 6th chakra, the third eye. The arrow points inwards, it is a Yin task. This is the highest current. How do I create my connection with God? Universal union, reconnecting myself with plants, animals, spiritual beings, with the cosmos. I am a part of God, any person is a part of God, every plant is a part of God, every planet has a soul, it is a being, I am connected with it. So every planet helps me with its energy, since we can also send energy consciously out to the cosmos. There is another important point in this learning as well: who do I blame when things go badly for me sometimes? A lot of people say «I just do not know how God lets this happen». If things do not turn out well it depends on me alone; that is what the 7 universal laws are there for. God created these laws so that we would all be equal. It is through our behaviour that we receive blessings or hard moments of learning. The law of sowing and reaping. So God is the same for everyone; he sets the 7 laws so that whoever keeps them has their reward. None of us can get out of these laws. When things do not turn out well, I cannot blame anyone. God is not responsible for our wedding, nor for our separation. RECONNECTION WITH THE DIVINE I have to understand that I am inseparable from God, I am bound to God. In the good moments and in the bad. All I need is recognition. To be connected with everything divine. When this is so, we stop criticising and insulting, since I understand that if I do this to my brothers I am doing it to myself; this is a task I have to accept and let grow inside me. In this learning it is important not to fall into the role of victim, nor to blame life, other people or God himself. «Law of sowing and reaping». UNIVERSAL UNION This union shows itself in daily life, not isolating yourself. Feeling that we are joined and that what I do to another person I do to myself. This is universal union. Recognising that I have sown in order to have this harvest and, with an attitude of love, being able to make it better for next time.
1.hiloRojo: An absent father, or an absent father figure, which sets off a feeling of abandonment and helplessness in the child. An orphan.
1.neurosis: A rebel without a cause, a victim. I do not trust life and its process. I must protect myself, insecurity. «I feel alone and abandoned».
1.sanador: Universal union – Developing an existential awareness of life. What is the meaning of existence? What is the meaning of life? «I let who I am flow». I take responsibility for my actions and develop inner certainty.

2.nombre: Loving instead of wanting to be right
2.texto: This portal of energy sits in the seventh chakra, the crown. This task consists of learning to use our intelligence and our intuition together. Using our capacities so that our thinking is productive. Any form of stubbornness or dogmatism, or inflexibility about learning, has to be avoided. Dogmatism, being inflexible about opening our mind and knowing that we can go on learning in order to grow, means that love has no place and no room. As long as I go on living, I go on learning from others. If I cannot see that I might be wrong about something, I have no capacity to grow. What is asked of us here is being able to be available to listen. The other person can show me something that helps me improve. When I believe I hold the absolute power of truth, then I do not love, I want to be right. Inflexibility and dogmatism about my ideas. Respect towards others, towards what they think, towards how they live, without wanting to change them, is something very important at this point of energy. Accepting others, and not only wanting to teach. Love towards myself and allowing myself to change my focus on what I live, since only in this way can I go on moving forward. The learning here is not to demand too much of yourself. Because these people want to do things perfectly, and they demand too much of themselves. This brings on hardness and demands with themselves and with others. Their inflexibility about being able to change a thought gets stronger and stronger. In childhood they have felt at some moment that they were not taken into account, they have felt an injustice from a member of the family. They create an injustice of their own and from there they learn to notice everything, every detail, who speaks well, who speaks badly, whether they have the same rights at home or whether more attention is paid to their brother. LOVING INSTEAD OF WANTING TO BE RIGHT The child needs to learn tolerance. They need to be right and to express themselves stubbornly in order to realise that it is a waste of time and that it uses up a lot of energy. Only reflection helps me change. At this point, especially women who in their childhood had a hard, inflexible, macho or dogmatic father and a weaker mother will try to imitate the father. When we learn that having respect for someone else's opinion weighs more than imposing my own thinking, then we will know what it is to love instead of wanting to be right.
2.hiloRojo: An authoritarian father who imposed his own judgement. A child who feels attacked and who is only rewarded through academic or practical achievements. Conditional love.
2.neurosis: Mental rigidity and inflexibility. The mind and reason of the ego. A dogmatic, practical mind. Argumentative, quarrelsome. Domineering, divide and rule. «They do not love me and they treat me unfairly».
2.sanador: Loving instead of wanting to be right – Developing the attributes of the giver and connecting ourselves with divinity and universal love. «I am part of the Father and his creative power is in me». Love from non-attachment.

3.texto: It is a Yang task, it is found at the front opening of the 6th chakra, the third eye. Positive means that decisions have to be cosmically productive. Having the power to decide. Inside me there has to be a component of strength and clarity so that these decisions come from the soul and not from the mind. Here the person wants to decide their spiritual, material, emotional matters, and so on. In this task there can be a fear of deciding and getting it wrong, because they always want a positive result and the soul needs experiences in order to grow. This fear of the result, of getting it wrong, means we hand over to other people decisions we ought to be making ourselves. Positive decisions means that, if I decide and I get it wrong, it turns out productive for my soul, because I have learnt what that decision brought me and this turns into positive productive decisions. You have to lose the fear of the result and learn that, whatever we choose, we are here to experience and that decision has to come from the heart. POSITIVE DECISIONS Taking a decision in a positive way does not mean saying YES to everything. It means, rather, first, that I should be realistic and see that I have to take a decision. Not looking the other way, thinking that the decision will take itself. This learning task asks us to take decisions for ourselves, without handing the reins to other people. You have to look from the heart and ask yourself honestly what it is that we really need, want and long for. It is very important to know what I want in order to be able to take the decision from the heart, and not let other people's influences steer me away from my experience. As children, these people have not been allowed to take part in changes or decisions. They tell me how I have to do everything, how to dress, how to eat and so on. The family here helps you long to take decisions and to have your needs taken into account
3.hiloRojo: A mother full of fears with a negative view of the world. Manipulative, overprotective, castrating.
3.neurosis: Mental blockage. Paralysed by indecision. Crushing logic. A selfish mind. «They will not let me decide, I am blocked».
3.sanador: The power of positive decision – Learning to work together through my fertile deeds: «I know what to give» and I find my place in the world.

4.texto: It is a Yang task, it is placed at the front opening of the 5th chakra, which is the throat chakra. The power to express oneself. Every one of us needs to express outwards how we are, what we need. To express what forms part of our own being. That is, to live as each of us needs to and to express it in the widest sense of the word. Communicating with others is of vital importance if we are to grow and bear fruit. Expressing myself. If I am very sensitive and I express myself outwards in a completely different way, I am blocking the expression of myself. If I know myself well, I will be able to express my true self well to others. I will be able to avoid, right from the start, expressing something that is not me. When I learn to express myself freely, with respect and at the right moment, I free this energy and I recognise myself more and more. When I express myself with conviction, it will always turn out well, since in those moments we are being true. The power of the word makes me identify myself, and that is why I must let my heart, my inside, my essence speak; in this way I will be able to express my being outwards and I will have recognition from myself and from others. Expressing myself from my soul, in order to reach the other soul. Self-expression. People who have a learning task here are going to have these circumstances from childhood. For example, where the adults constantly shushed them or where their judgement or opinion was not taken into account. So much insecurity is passed on to the child that in the end they do not know what they can say and what they cannot. Expression in childhood. As adults these children hesitate when it comes to expressing themselves; the doubt is always about whether what they are going to say is the right thing. Maybe what I am going to say is not the right thing! It can take a long time to bring the point of expression into balance. Some people, because they find themselves unable to be credible when they speak and express themselves, swallow it. Others because they are about to explode and their words come out like real cannon fire. Balance comes when my expression is free, with love, at the right moment. Task number 4 needs to work on expression with help. Painting, music, writing, crafts, dance. This kind of expression helps bring the energy down to the 4th chakra.
4.hiloRojo: A family in which emotions are not shown. What the family circle focuses on is social relations, status, prestige, what people will say, keeping up appearances. Emotions are shameful.
4.neurosis: Disconnection from myself. A lack of authenticity. Living from behind the mask. Fear of social rejection. «I feel inferior».
4.sanador: Expressing your own essence – There are no 2 souls alike. We are bound to be authentic and to leave our mark on the world. Developing emotional intelligence as the ground for working from love and compassion. «Power in the service of love».

5.texto: Here we find the front opening of the 3rd and 4th chakras, which correspond to the solar plexus and the heart. Yang learning, activity, movement. «True self-determination». Every one of us is unique and special. What this is about is working out in this life what makes me unique and special. Giving up wanting to imitate anyone and looking for my own virtues and capacities. Freeing yourself from any influence or determination from outside that wants to influence or manipulate us. Nowadays we have a great many outside and social influences shaping our ideas and our thoughts. Being unique and special means being free and shedding those influences. This influence happens at many levels and in many forms, from the influence television has on us, political parties, society in general with its fashions and trends, down to things as everyday as eating at a set time without being hungry, because it is the usual time to eat. Being able to step out of those influences of upbringing so that we can find ourselves. RECONNECTING WITH OUR ABILITIES The work here consists of recognising ourselves, of connecting with our essence, which makes us feel on certain points a sensitivity that lets us give that potential to humanity. It is very unlikely that this can happen if I let myself be carried along by influences, since I run the risk of being carried along by what they think and say is best for me. We have to take the decision to know ourselves and act accordingly, to act on the basis of what we feel from inside, without caring what others think. To live in accordance with what we vibrate, as long as we do not harm or damage anyone, in order to find our unique and special being. Not wanting to please others is something we have to work on, and to act only out of loyalty to ourselves. Pleasing others will only serve to make you feel and ask that you be accepted, and this will not let you grow and develop at the level of the soul. When a person has a learning at point 5, we can say that this person has been badly hurt at the emotional level. They have often been given examples of other people to push them into being like them. This is damaging at the emotional level, since it makes us feel smaller and smaller. Here insecurity about oneself grows and you look for ways to do things that are not in keeping with our essence in order to please. So I do not live an active life but a reactive one, I do not say my opinion, instead I let myself be influenced. In childhood it is important that their qualities are brought out and that they can express and feel that their virtues are accepted and not judged. They look for freedom of the spirit and to live intensely without caring about other people's opinions.
5.hiloRojo: A child who has felt rejection, especially from the mother. The child feels emotionally undernourished, wanting. Very busy parents who get home late and tired to attend to their children's emotional demands. A possible feeling of abuse, mistreatment, a lack of love in our childhood…
5.neurosis: Fear of loneliness. Emotional deprivation. Anxiety about being accepted. Emotional manipulation. Men look for their mother. Prostituting our values. «I feel rejected».
5.sanador: Self-esteem, self-acceptance, true self-determination – Learning to live by my truth, whoever it upsets. I am perfect for reaching my purpose. There is nothing wrong with me.

6.texto: Placed at the front opening of the second chakra, the sexual chakra. For us it is an important material learning towards the body and how to bring our spirituality into matter. A joy of living that takes everything in. The joy of physical love. Here it is important to feel loved, to feel you have a satisfying love life, and that takes in sexual energy too. When spiritual love comes together with physical sexual energy, a kind of energy is switched on that is what we call Christic work. This is where spontaneity is born, creativity, being able to be happy and to bring life and enthusiasm. At this point you can have blockages in the joy of life and almost always you end up with serious emotional lows and even depression. What is asked of us is being able to give ourselves, being able to love, and knowing how to receive a partner's love without tension, with joy, with a capacity to enjoy, and with respect. When I have problems in my relationships with other human beings, I will almost certainly have problems with a partner. In childhood they have been given too much responsibility and the child in them has not been able to show itself; that joy of living has been taken from them. Their inside swells up with held-in emotions, with no way to let them out, and they are pushed harder and harder, and even asked for more and more, until a moment comes when they explode. This pressure from outside makes them fall into depression and feel apathetic about everything, they even reach the point of feeling motivated by nothing. They tend to have their emotions on the surface, but they try to control themselves and not let it show. They have to learn spontaneity; having a good relationship with a partner will help them bring work full of enthusiasm and fun into their life. People who have a learning task here should start looking for things they like, hobbies and pursuits that begin to bring stimulation into their life. They should have experienced relationships until they find their companion on the way. Having a good sexual relationship, since it is related to the joy of living. The more consciously we can live our joy of living and our capacity to love, the more the Kundalini energy rises inside us up our spine. For this to happen there has to be joy of living and a capacity to love. Portal 1 and portal 6 correspond to each other. In the 1 we learn spirituality and in the 6 it is how we master our life in matter as human beings.
6.hiloRojo: A stolen childhood: unable to play, to have fun and to develop like the other children. Possibly because of hard situations of illness, financial hardship… within the family home.
6.neurosis: Extreme seriousness and control. Focused on material needs. Denial of the body and of enjoyment. No joy of living, unhappiness. «They will not let me play, I do not enjoy life».
6.sanador: Joy of living, the capacity to relate from love – How do I behave in this world? Learning to have the right spiritual focus in matter through my outer ego. Getting out of the trap of material and emotional lack. Developing a fertile ego.

7.texto: Placed in the first chakra, the root chakra, the connection with the Earth, it is in our feet. Reconciliation with oneself. FORGIVE US, MOTHER EARTH We have to start reconciling ourselves with the Earth, respecting our training ground, nature, which is reflected in me. This task of reconciliation is with all living beings, animals and plants, and above all with what holds us up and keeps us alive, what feeds us, which is the Earth. There are no mistakes. Creation is right and God does not get it wrong, everything is perfect and you are perfect. When we have learnt that creation is perfect and that mother earth is perfect, we have to accept that our creation in this life is perfect too. Accepting ourselves and feeling our place on this Earth. Accepting ourselves and planting our feet firmly on the Earth. Looking for and finding our place and putting down roots where we belong. Feeling that we fit and that with our being we can bring some help to this universe. When I reconcile myself with myself, I have to be able to forgive myself and to admit that I did what I could. When I forgive myself, then I have to pass it on to others, but first the forgiveness is towards myself. Everything that happened was the right thing for me to be here today. The next thing is to accept yourself at every level, physically and in attitude; only with recognition and acceptance can we create consciousness and work on getting better. These people have gone through moments of not liking themselves physically and they have to work on acceptance at every level. In this learning it is important to be a wanted child. In the family a boy is expected and a girl arrives, or the other way round, and this is where the problem of acceptance and reconciliation can begin. Or not arriving at the moment they were wanted. Not looking at others and feeling they are better than me, feeling good about the body, and not turning out the light so that they cannot see you. Here there is a danger of not being able to forgive yourself and, as a result, you can look for self-destruction. Bad habits with food, drink, drugs and tobacco.
7.hiloRojo: A traumatic gestation, which makes the soul feel unwanted, feel that its arrival is not welcome. A possible unwanted pregnancy, because of money problems, one of the parents leaving… makes them feel there is something bad inside and they feel the world rejecting them.
7.neurosis: I have no ground under my feet. Fear of responsibility. I do not accept my life or my darkness. Feels they are good for nothing. Does not want to see their shadow, the truth. Total rejection of the world. «The world does not accept me, I am worth nothing».
7.sanador: Reconciliation with life and with divine creation – Accepting the fact that this is the «perfect» place to develop my purpose.

8.texto: Yin learning. This point is placed in the lumbar area. Rear opening of chakra 2. People at this point look for harmony, calm, union and quiet, but they have to feel that this balance comes from inside. HARMONY IN THE FAMILY It is important for people who have a learning task in the force of unification that in childhood they did not witness fights, shouting, or bad manners and bad ways in their family. Union matters a great deal to them. Any form of fighting or anger in their surroundings creates disunion, exactly the opposite of what they are looking for. In the end these people build up more and more anger and rage inside them. They can turn into fighting cocks. They have to work on inner calm and feel that, inside any outward conflict, they are able to look for peace and quiet in their being. Fights and conflicts leave them exhausted, and they feel that all their strength has gone. They always look for calm outside, when what they have to do is create harmony inside. What has to be learnt here is how to fight well, to fight and defend yourself without dodging the conflict. If I dodge something I have to settle with another person out of fear of a fight, I am also passing over the learning. The conflict has to be settled with the emotions calmed and with the inner harmony of unification with myself and with God. When the conflict is not settled and I am emotionally hurt, my body, my being fill up with anger, rage and fury. This is harmful to us, since we will lash out at whoever is least to blame and we can drive away the people who love us. This creates disunion. We have to heal the wounds so that we can have inner harmony again, and this is something that can perfectly well be learnt. It can bring ups and downs in the character. You are fine and a little while later you are not. FORGIVENESS At this point, people have to learn to be able to ask for forgiveness, when they really feel from inside that the matter is now settled. They can react very badly to conflicts because it is something they have to learn. Not talking about the other person in order to settle the conflict, but about the hurt it has caused in me, about how I feel. If we manage to carry this learning through successfully, Healing will be given to us.
8.hiloRojo: Families in which it is not easy to settle conflicts harmoniously. There is a lot of tension and violence in the air (spoken and possibly physical too) which brings on an enormous fear of failure and of the punishment that follows.
8.neurosis: No emotional control. Hypersensitive. Difficult, with outbursts of rage and frustration. Drastic break-ups. Vulnerability to the astral. «Everyone hurts me».
8.sanador: Unification and harmony – Personality and inner ego (how I rate myself). Making peace in my relationships through empathy. Developing inner peace by taking on my soul's plan. Cultivating non-attachment to the material as part of the fuel of my ego. Energetic discipline and protection from the astral.

9.texto: Yin learning. A point placed in the thoracic area, it is mirrored in the heart. Rear opening of chakras 3 and 4. Having understanding and empathy. Here there is an excessive sensitivity in perception; you can become so sensitive that everything that happens to other people affects you, to the point of making it your own. The person is able to put themselves in other people's place and to be helpful. At this point it is very important that the person knows how to set limits, and that if they help, they do not wear themselves out. Empathy has to have its limit, and we should open up just as much as is needed without harming our energy. They have to learn to say enough, at the point where they have to respect themselves. EMPATHY IN THE RIGHT MEASURE There is a danger that their goodness and their giving will be taken advantage of. Then they start to feel manipulated and there is a danger that they will close up so as not to spend too much of themselves. This is something that can happen. From the outside they can look like proud people. INTUITION When a person who has a learning at point 9 closes up so as not to suffer, that is, they have found themselves manipulated, they have to trust again and again, but above all in their intuition. When their intuition warns them that they have to stop, they must do it. Understanding towards oneself and respect are important. As much as towards others, so that there is a good balance. If we manage to carry this learning through successfully, Clairvoyance will be given to us.
9.hiloRojo: A helpless child, with no home, with no roots. They have not felt love because there was no love where they grew up. It can come from the parents moving house constantly, which stopped the child ever having the feeling of putting down roots. The child grows up with a feeling of vulnerability and of having no protection and no home.
9.neurosis: Control so as not to suffer. Perfectionists who demand a lot of themselves. Mental rigidity and stubbornness. Sickly jealousy. They want to run everyone's life. «I do not understand myself».
9.sanador: Clear perception and understanding – I find the capacity to determine myself and I get my personal power back by opening myself to the power of love. Being honest with my essence in order to open up to intuition, love, inner truth. All the guidance you need you carry inside. Who am I?

10.texto: A Yin task placed at the rear opening of the 5th chakra, at the height of the laryngeal chakra. It is important that these people think that things do not have to be difficult and costly in order to turn out well. It is very important that in the force of determination the things that are started get finished. Focusing energy on one thing to be achieved and not moving on to the next until the first is done. They run the risk of starting many things and rarely being steady enough to finish them. There is no need to prove that things cost a lot to achieve and that what I am doing takes a great deal of sacrifice. This can come from childhood; we are taught that things that are not very difficult are not worth anything. Being able to begin and to focus attention on the present. PROFESSION What is asked of us is attention, so that we can enjoy and live what it falls to me to do at that moment. It is important to find and give yourself fully to your calling in life. This point does not help us give ourselves wholeheartedly to our profession. WHAT DO I WANT TO DO WITH MY LIFE In childhood, parents who teach their children that they have to carry on the family business can block that child later on, because their own wishes look impossible; they have to carry something that has been left to them. This is often where the frustration comes from; people should always work at what they like and feel. GIVING YOURSELF When this cannot be achieved because of circumstances, then you have to learn to be present and to give yourself to what you are living, to what you are working at in that moment, and this always gives a positive result: giving yourself, making your profession a calling. In this task it would be advisable to start with small things and finish them. So as to know the feeling of satisfaction of finishing something. It has to do with concentration, with being in the moment and being able to enjoy what you are doing. Do I like my profession? If we manage to carry this learning through successfully, Mediumship will be given to us.
10.hiloRojo: A family with strong rules and codes based on the material. Making money, being someone in life, looking after the family business from an early age… the child is rewarded only when they focus on these values and dismissed when they express their inner creativity. They learn not to hand the drawing to mum or dad, because they do not value it, but to do their homework and hand over their marks in order to be recognised. They learn to do «the right thing».
10.neurosis: Constant dissatisfaction. Work that makes me unhappy. Civil-servant syndrome. Starts many things and finishes nothing. Disconnection from their desires and gifts. What am I good for in the world? «I have no purpose and no will».
10.sanador: The force of determination to manifest my gifts and God's will through me. I live my calling as a co-creator.
