1.texto: In this matrix the 1 is the highest point, the point above. It is spirit over spirit. Here everything relates to the 7 cosmic laws. It does not matter what happens to us, it does not matter what we achieve, it does not matter how much dedication we put in. It does not matter what we fail to achieve; in the end the one responsible is always one of these 7 cosmic laws. One of these 7 cosmic laws is responsible for what happens. Whether I act in the right way or not is my responsibility. We cannot dodge the cosmic laws or ignore them. They hold for all human beings, whether they are aware of them or not.

2.texto: The first thing this plane teaches us is self-responsibility. I have to be willing to accept responsibility for my life, for myself. I have to take the reins of my life. On this plane of consciousness it is no use saying «God will take care of me». What this is about here is accepting my own responsibility. At some moment, you are able to perceive that, to realise whether you can be responsible. This helps us a great deal in seeing how we approach the plane of causal consciousness. Hidden in this plane is the word responsibility, that is, how I sum up my life… Am I willing to accept responsibilities for myself? Am I willing to let others be responsible for their lives?

3.texto: Spiritual-mental plane: finding the path of my existence, deciding and finding motivation for myself; that is deciding for me, for my life, for my joy. An impulse for change, it is the energy of getting myself going. On this plane of consciousness we want to build and, if we do not take the leap, we will be destroying ourselves. Being able to focus my life and change paradigm: what worked for me a few years or months ago no longer does and I have to decide again. This mutation, this death, this birth, is being alive and being active in life. Being humble and patient does not mean not being active. Energy that does not flow stagnates and dies, it produces illnesses. Once we know what we want, we have to get going and take decisions, make everything in matter move around that direction. When I do not move and I let life decide for me, I can get ill. Thinking and reflecting is a normal thing, but it has to be accompanied by movement, by a push of energy towards a goal.

4.texto: This plane is about the unconscious things in my personality, that is, everything we have inside us without knowing it. They are the capacities I do not yet hold consciously. On the tree of life this one corresponds especially to the planet of the moon. You can trust that we have many capacities inside us, in our inside, only that, for some reason, we do not release them. Activating new areas of my brain: there are paths or tracks that run through our brain and are engraved on it when we use them. These new tracks can be trained actively. Doing different things, getting out of monotony, not doing things just because and automatically, discovering new capacities inside our subconscious plane. Having confidence that there are many things to discover inside us, trusting that those capacities are my tools for reaching my goals in this life. By changing habits, areas of the brain that are asleep start to switch on.

5.texto: Awareness of our divine being, of the part of divinity there is in us. The soul is called the Higher Self and has nothing to do with your material side. Your Lower Self has a first name by which you are known. The soul feels and does not think; the lower self thinks, that is, it has a mental body. What this is about is consciousness of that part and of that divine body called the soul. The material body is needed in order to learn from experiences, while the self-consciousness that you are soul gives you wings to be above any desire. As a material human person, I make many mistakes in my experiences, because I come to learn. I have to become conscious that I am soul, purely soul, and that I need a body in order to be able to live experiences. I have to widen my consciousness that I am a soul in a body, not the other way round. If this consciousness is taken on, I am perfect. Most of us are not conscious that we have a divine being or a divine part. We find it hard to feel this part that forms us. This affects our Self. That is why, sometimes, it is hard to identify what makes up our being. I should never feel bad about myself, because I as a soul am always good, but my human part often makes mistakes.

6.texto: We have to take into account how much influence the ego has on us, because it is here that the soul meets matter, even though the soul cannot be seen. There are times when we show a front that does not match our inner personality. We are not here to be actors on earth, even though sometimes we take on roles to go up on stage. On the stage of our life, we should play only our own part. A person who plays the game of pretending to be well too much ends up ill, because this game is a sick one. What matters is working out what our role in this life is, because this is the most important role and it should be our priority. We should watch ourselves, see what our surroundings are, feel that we fit well in our working environment, with our family, and try to love what we do without pretending anything; that is no use to our soul. The ego of inferiority, the ego of superiority, the ego of denial… When we are unwell, why do we have to make out that we are fine? Why do I have to play the strong one if I do not feel well? Why can I not say «leave me alone, I need some quiet»? I am not well, I should rest, but I have to be at this party because all the important people will be at this party. We should not do anything that does not match our inner personality. The inner personality has to do with the soul, because the soul does not handle any of it, it does not take in that you are playing a wrong part. But what lies behind this at the spiritual level? The key phrase is being separated from God. If it is true that the most important part of our soul is alive with God and that we as divine creatures are connected with God through our soul, then it is not good to separate yourself from him spiritually. The Denial ego: «It is not true, it is not right». However you argue it, this person will always tell you it is not true, which also fits the atheist. With an atheist you have to have 30 or 40 good conversations for him to say to you «all right, it might be true». Self-justification: here you start justifying yourself straight away. When something is done badly or they make a mistake, but they explain that deep down it was the right thing. When in the end there is nothing else for it, they say «well, but I meant well». Self-accusation: this is the poor ego, poor me… «Yes, yes, yes, you are right, you are right, I will never do it again… you are right… I am sure it is my fault, if I had not…». Counter-attack: if you attack me, I attack you too. You remember what he did to you yesterday, and the other day, and 10 years ago. «Yes it was me, but you did the same thing last year», and so on.

7.texto: This is where thoughts of lack are generated, to do with our body, with our capacities in general, with money, clothes, the car… For example: thinking of buying a big car because the neighbour has a big car too. The new fur coat because it is in fashion, but not because I need it. Consciousness of reality. The whole subject of the thought of lack is the original cause of these blockages arising here. I should put my thoughts of lack aside, so that my thoughts are real. Here we have to be in our present. To live our current situation. I can only see to my learnings if I look around me cleanly. This is what I need and this is what I am living, and not look the other way. It can make us feel oppressed and distressed. The blockage also comes when certain subjects cannot be raised with me, it is as if they were nothing to do with me, I stop being realistic. CHALLENGE: Being realistic. The more I block myself, the less chance I have of really seeing that I am not looking at the bottom of the problem, that is, of being able to see the real background. Obsessive neuroses can develop here, manias can be created. Fears can turn into phobias and giving a lot of importance to what I lack can mean that the law of thought in negative polarity brings me more emptiness than fullness, through the law of resonance. Living in the present is what consciousness of reality asks of us so that we wake up and live in the spiritual work that falls to us. We cannot look the other way, because it is no use at all. The thought of lack carries a lot of fear, and this fear blocks the flow of energy that would tune us in to living in the present. The thought of lack begins in the part of matter. Why do the same things always happen to me? It has to do with the thought of lack, with not being present in the moment in which we are living the experience. By not being present, we do not notice the learning and the story repeats itself again.

8.texto: We need our feelings, but we have to respond to them with coherence, control and balance, because feelings are part of our emotional body, and losing control over them creates a feeling that can contaminate our growth. We should not swallow our emotions either, since this brings on depression and pressure on our being. This blockage does not let us be free, and what it is about is learning to handle our emotions well. «When a soldier has a complaint, he should sleep on it for a night before complaining». We should all live a little by this motto, because very often emotional decisions are the wrong decisions. These uncontrolled emotions can create blockages that have come about for that reason alone: we have lived over and over again, taking our decisions according to these emotions. When we are acting in a very emotional way, we can never take rational decisions. We have to pay attention: our emotions are not the only indicator in our life. If we lived everything from the emotions, they are not the only indicator in our life. If we lived everything from the emotions, a few hours later we would be as if we had been drunk for three days.

9.texto: Consciousness of mentality is the same as opinion. This plane stores the sum of our opinions, opinions gathered across all my incarnations. Having opinions about life, about some of its subjects, is the most normal thing, and we should all have these opinions, defend them and live by our own grounds. What matters here is recognising when my opinion may be wrong or when someone can show me another one that fits better with what I believed. Changing my opinion at the right moment, at the proper moment. In personal changes, in the spiritual evolutions of our being, lies the change of ideas and of paradigms; that is why it is good to defend our opinions, but we have to be flexible about change at the moment when it is our turn to move on. Let us remember that the universe is flowing, it does not stagnate, and the human being should have this change at every stage too. A fixed opinion held all through life or for a long time creates blockages in the consciousness of mentality. It is normal to form opinions, but it is not normal to be influenced by them. «Collective thinking».

10.texto: Developing spiritual mobility, or spiritual flexibility. Consciousness of transformation means that the first thing I need is mental and spiritual flexibility. I have to be able to move mentally and spiritually. To understand that we are here to learn and not only to enjoy ourselves. Learning can be fun, but fun on its own cannot make me forget the learning. «I am not doing any more. These 4 years I have left until retirement, I will get through them however I can. Everything I had to do in this life, I have already done». You have to go on learning, you have to go on studying. You cannot think that nobody can teach you anything any more. What can the soul do when I am not willing to evolve? Well, the consequence will always be a mental illness. This consciousness is about stepping away from everything dogmatic, being able to be flexible and having the need to transform yourself spiritually and mentally.

planos_conciencia.intro: 23.2 Bloqueos Los bloqueos que me impiden crecer y aprender se repiten una y otra vez hasta que sea consciente de ellos. Por ejemplo: Siempre me ocurre lo mismo con las parejas, siempre me encuentro con gente que me acaba estafando, etc. Nosotros cogemos tareas nuevas para tener una posibilidad de aprenderlas en esta vida, pero los bloqueos existen y me hacen tener enfoques erróneos y miradas desajustadas. Los bloqueos pueden venir de la infancia, de la pubertad o de otras vidas. Los traumas son acontecimientos que en ese momento nos impactaron y no pudimos razonar o entender. Para seguir viviendo, el subconsciente los guarda, se llama supervivencia. Pero más tarde, cuando queremos seguir creciendo, pueden impedir que yo alcance o consiga cosas, estos aparecen para sanarlos o entenderlos en ese momento. Estos traumas, en el momento que los entendemos y tomamos conciencia, nos liberan y podemos dejar de repetir los patrones erróneos. Los pensamientos de carencia también son fuerzas que pueden separarme de mi yo superior, me pueden causar bloqueos, porque estos pensamientos sólo dan fuerza y alimentan lo que no tengo. Entonces, la ley de resonancia se pone en marcha señalándome de forma más grande, lo que no tengo o de lo que carezco. Mientras yo esté en estas carencias, no podré tener la conexión con mi alma, ya que estaré sólo focalizada en lo que me falta. Un trauma no es más que una experiencia que nos impacta o simplemente que no podemos procesar en su momento. Los traumas no tienen por qué ser cosas muy espectaculares, como una violación, un accidente, etc. Un trauma puede ser un cambio de ciudad muy a menudo sin poder procesar. Una preocupación sobre mi cuerpo que a mí me paraliza, siento miedo o baja autoestima. Estos quedan anclados en nosotros y nos hacen una y otra vez cometer los mismos errores. Se sanan aceptándolos con conciencia y liberando el patrón de conducta. Nuestra alma conoce lo que es importante para nosotros y nuestras tareas. Es el alma quien decide qué bloqueo va a ir quitando y qué es lo que es más urgente o prioritario para mí sanar en este momento. Es importante conocer los planos de conciencia y los egos, para saber en cuál de ellos estoy bloqueado. Los planos de conciencia más conocidos, pero no los únicos, son tres: El subconsciente, la conciencia diaria y el Yo Superior (alma). Para la Kabbalah existen 10 planos de conciencia, que deben estar en constante flujo energético y dando energía unos a otros. En el momento que esta energía se estanca, surgen debilidades y separación de nuestro ser divino o alma. Aquí se encuentran las disfunciones psíquicas y los comportamientos erróneos que nos lleva a generar enfermedades psíquicas o enfermedades primarias. Las enfermedades primarias o psíquicas empiezan en las emociones y eso lleva a comportamientos erróneos. Ejemplo: La avaricia desmesurada provoca enfermedad, es decir, el no compartir, el acaparar más y cuanto más mejor. En el fondo, el nunca estar satisfecho, es un pensamiento de carencia. El ego puede provocar un pensamiento de superioridad y de creer que no necesitamos de nadie. Hay 7 emociones que nos pueden provocar la desconexión del cuerpo, se conocen como las 7 enfermedades primarias emocionales de pensamiento que son: 1) Codicia. 2) Ignorancia. 3) Inestabilidad 4) Egoísmo 5) Odio 6) Crueldad 7) Orgullo La codicia es para que nosotros desarrollemos la libertad y la individualidad. El alma necesita soltar, ser individual, desprenderte de las cosas, dejar ir. La ignorancia nos habla de la flexibilidad y la experiencia para aprender. Apaga el alma, debemos aprender y experimentar. La inestabilidad nos dice que no tenemos autodeterminación. Tomar decisiones bloquea la energía y produce una gran debilidad. El egoísmo es para dejar de pensar en ti y ocuparte más de los demás. Como me cuido a mí, debo cuidar a otros. Devoción hacia los demás. Se pierde la empatía. El odio quiere aprender el amor. Si negamos al otro, negamos a Dios. Amar, aceptar y fluir si pienso desde el amor. La crueldad hay que trabajarla con la compasión, ser comprensivo. Para el orgullo hay que trabajar la humildad, ser humilde. No somos ni más ni menos que nadie.

ciclos.1: It is an invitation to position yourself better, to develop autonomy and to leave personal projects It is a period in which the person can act with drive and energy; at this stage you feel the possibility of finding inner strength and confidence in yourself A school for making room for your inner leader and discovering your own identity
ciclos.2: It is a moment during which the person can pay more attention to their emotions and their intuition They go to meet their inner sensitivity and can have the chance of a more harmonious emotional life It is marked by flexibility, receptiveness and listening to your inner voice It is an ideal moment for developing your feminine yin qualities, or the feminine side of yourself.
ciclos.3: During a 3 life cycle you can learn to free yourself from other people's approval and become aware of your own social image It is a period in which the person can recover or find their «inside» and let it out with optimism and joy of living. It is a period well suited to bringing out artistic talents, and talents for communication and human relations. A stage of life in which you can make the most of applying creativity in every field.
ciclos.4: This cycle invites us to live according to our frames of life — the physical, our profession, our home, our family — with more attention and responsibility It is a moment for taking stock and for regulating ourselves. It can go with freeing ourselves from the fears or the limiting inheritances passed down by our family history. A period well suited to organising our daily life better and making the most of our capacity to organise and manage our resources. A moment aimed at personal development with our feet well rooted in the earth, trusting in material, professional and emotional abundance.
ciclos.5: During this cycle we are invited to use our physical and sexual strength with balance and to release inner tensions. A period for living experiences, adventures and new risks in the search to reaffirm our true being. It is a moment for showing our analytical capacity and throwing ourselves into investigating new things. It invites us to mobility, to changes, to travel, but without falling into excesses of activity or scattering ourselves. In principle it is a period of release and freedom
ciclos.6: This cycle invites us to trust ourselves, to believe in life, love, beauty, harmony It is a moment for letting go, for enjoying ourselves, relaxing and opening ourselves to inner healing and light. It is a period of giving ourselves to life, with love towards ourselves and towards others. A moment of peace, of conciliation, of bodily and emotional expression. A school aimed at opening the heart, at feminine values. A cycle ruled by feelings, human warmth and pleasure.
ciclos.7: This cycle invites us to be aware of our intellectual and spiritual path. A moment of life well suited to going inwards, to stepping back from the noise outside, to getting to know our inner light and making room for it. A period for study and for opening up to new knowledge An invitation to recognise and take stock of the cultural values inherited from our families. A moment of inner intellectual and spiritual progress
ciclos.8: This period offers us the chance to find our own inner strength and to show it with confidence. An ideal period for becoming conscious of our talents and putting them to use. A good occasion for making wishes and hopes material, with a view to throwing ourselves into new and solid things and projects. This cycle is a demanding and thrilling school for developing our capacities for strategy, for building, for achievement, at the material level Making the most concrete use of my possibilities at every level. It invites us to be ambitious with ourselves, developing our power of alchemy in order to transform ourselves and transform the earth.
ciclos.9: This cycle invites us to open our consciousness towards universal and humanist paths, to live compassion and love towards others. During this period you can get involved in social or humanitarian help, with an opening of awareness in the face of everyday events. It invites us to make more room for intuition, wisdom, and the capacity to interpret symbols and the world of the imagination. It can correspond to a cycle of artistic creation. A moment for holding and radiating our inner light and living connected to cosmic energy A cycle of listening, aimed at developing a planetary consciousness with no limits and no social or cultural taboos
ciclos.11/2: This cycle has the features of a 2 cycle but widened by the messages of the 11. It is a period for allowing yourself to be a channel of light in the service of others. A moment for the inner awakening, which invites us to be in harmony with ourselves and to carry out an inner cleansing It is a period of development in which the being places itself in the service of the light, like a lighthouse when it comes to guiding others. An optimal period for developing personal charisma and the mental and emotional faculties
ciclos.22/4: This cycle takes the messages of the 4 cycle with the dimension of the 22. A period for developing the potential of the great builder and throwing yourself into ambitious projects in the service of collective evolution, with a social and universal consciousness. It invites us to steady and strengthen our roots in the earth.

realizaciones.1: Learning to assert your personal position, to undertake independent action, to take initiatives in the direction proposed. It is a moment of life during which the aptitudes for self-determination or leadership can wake up. The Being is invited to use its potential for action, or inner strength, to build in a positive way, and to build itself truly. It is the moment of life in which to connect with the powerful energy of KETHER
realizaciones.2: It is an invitation to take part in the lessons of the 2: learning to feel, to listen, to open up to the other and to live your feminine potential. In this period emotions or intuitions predominate; it is an invitation to develop your feminine right hemisphere through inspiration, creativity and spirituality. It is lived rather in relation to the heart and to values such as receptiveness, serenity, kindness and gentleness. It is a moment well suited to working on the relationship with the mother or the maternal archetype, and on the relationship with a partner Opening yourself to an energy that carries peace and hope. It is the moment of life in which to connect with the energy of CHOKMAH, revealed wisdom.
realizaciones.3: It is an invitation to take part in the lessons of the 3: exploring the forms of personal expression, of communication or of creativity It is a moment of meeting our inner child again. It is an invitation to live with joy and happiness, and to enjoy the present Life is lit up with more fantasy, more colour, more enthusiasm. Our Being is invited to discover its own personality, asserting itself without fearing other people's opinion. It is a moment well suited to accepting ourselves and loving ourselves just as we are. It is a chance to connect ourselves with BINAH, to go into ourselves in order to understand the meaning of life.
realizaciones.4: It is an invitation to take part in the lessons of the 4: learning to find your place in the different frames of life and to have confidence to build solid and stable works. During this period it is fitting to place yourself within the family history, in order to live stability and financial prosperity. It is a favourable moment for putting down roots with your feet firmly on Mother Earth. It is a period of transformation of matter thanks to work and Responsibility. The Being is invited to consider its work as a path of expansion, to feed its body and its spirit. On the tree of life, CHESED is associated with Jupiter, mercy and abundance.
realizaciones.5: It is an invitation to take part in the lessons of the 5: learning to change our aims quickly and to throw ourselves into the adventure of life without fear of changes, risks or challenges, in order to free our body and mind. It is a moment for working on the circulation of our own energies and the way we handle them. It is a dynamic period that invites us to make the most of new talents, while demanding a certain inner discipline of us in order to avoid scattering ourselves. A period for travelling and discovering other, liberating worlds. The being is invited to open itself to the divine energy and to the world, keeping its feet on the ground, in order to live with more openness and freedom. On the tree of life, the 5 corresponds to GEBURAH, rigour and strength
realizaciones.6: It is an invitation to take part in the lessons of the 6: learning to discover love towards oneself, so as to allow love for others to be born Service, sharing with others, and respect for oneself and for others are the priorities. It is a privileged moment for working on serenity, tenderness, physical harmony and letting love express itself — the Divine Sun present in the centre of one's own body. During this realisation it is also fitting to find our feminine part, and to express it fluidly and harmoniously It is a moment for listening to the wish to protect, and so developing your potential for healing and service towards others (therapies of any kind). On the tree of life it corresponds to TIPHERETH, beauty.
realizaciones.7: It is an invitation to take part in the lessons of the 7: learning to classify, to organise knowledge and to throw ourselves into intellectual or spiritual study It is a time of reflection, introspection and becoming conscious, so as to know how to use knowledge wisely and follow our inner path. A moment for learning while knowing that our knowledge does not belong to us, and that we are merely the keepers of the «Our task is to pass on what we know, and to learn to receive from others. During this period time is needed to meditate and reflect, without falling into isolation and without closing ourselves off from life Connecting ourselves with our deep spiritual life and raising higher and higher our demands for perfection and for meeting our inner master. On the tree of life it corresponds to NETZACH, victory Expressing the beauty and perfection of our being.
realizaciones.8: It is an invitation to take part in the lessons of the 8: learning to assert ourselves in the battle of life with our own resources, weapons and power, to commit ourselves to our own evolution, and to develop our power of strategy. At this moment the priority is recognising our personal talents so as to use them with discernment, and so asserting our physical, material, mental and spiritual power. This realisation offers a chance to manifest our power of alchemy, that is, the capacity to transmute the Earth thanks to the talents we receive We must not forget that the 8 receives and transforms cosmic energies. Our being is invited to refine its strategy of action and achievement, and to face its limits and fears in order to give the best of itself On the tree of life it corresponds to HOD, glory. It is an invitation to manifest the glory and the power of our Being.
realizaciones.9: It is an invitation to take part in the lessons of the 9: opening our consciousness to a wider view of life, undertaking social or collective action. It is a special period for developing our intuition, taking in higher ideals of consciousness or of universal love, which will let us reach liberating wisdom and light and be in contact with the divine energy. During this realisation we have to increase our availability towards others and our capacity to pick up their messages; we have to listen to the collective unconscious. We can also learn to make room for our potential for creation and connection with the world of the imagination, and to manifest it through creativity. The main aim of a 9 realisation is to help others, without forgetting to help ourselves And to connect with divine love and compassion and pass our inner light on to others. On the tree of life, it is associated with YESOD, the foundation
realizaciones.11: It is an invitation to take part in the lessons of the 2 and the 11 To reach what the 11 offers we have to do a work of cleansing our emotions and not be afraid to receive. It is a period well suited to inner listening and spiritual receptiveness. It is a thrilling call to develop our capacities for telepathy and personal charisma, to wake consciousnesses up and speed up the evolution of the earth. During this realisation we are invited to connect ourselves with the divine energies so as to let luminous spiritual messages flow through, meant for the common good. It is a favourable period of life in which to widen the spiritual faculties, the gifts of healing or of telepathy. On the tree of life it corresponds to DAATH, knowledge It is the moment well suited to opening ourselves to divine wisdom and to knowledge (opening of the third eye)
realizaciones.22: It is an invitation to take part in the lessons of the 4 and the 22 Before living the aspects of the 22 we have to consolidate our roots and our security on the Earth with solid foundations. Before the high-level vibrations emerge we have to carry out a spiritual and energetic purification, which will let us favour the transmutation of the Earth. In that period we can develop a potential for invention, for building and for achievement on a large scale, in order to serve Humanity. This realisation invites us to undertake ambitious projects in the service of the collective.
realizaciones.33: It is an invitation to take part in the lessons of the 6: working on the harmony of the heart and the spirit so that unconditional love and giving yourself in the service of all can show themselves. To live this special realisation we have to connect ourselves with our inner masters and let ourselves be flooded by divine love so as to give it away to others. These miracles of generosity, gratitude and universal love will happen from the moment our soul is ready and made fertile by God's love towards all his creatures.

desafios.0: We find no precise indications, but it is an invitation to develop the potential of nothingness and of everything possible, without falling into the trap of Excess.
desafios.1: In deficiency it means that the person shows difficulty in trusting themselves, in asserting their place or their position in the world. They find it hard to live independence and autonomy. It is an invitation to work on strengthening the will so as to manage to be recognised just as they are, or to be able to act in a more individual way. In excess it indicates that the person has to bring down their level of self-esteem, their wish to dominate others, and to limit their aggressive and authoritarian impulses.
desafios.2: In deficiency it means that the person has to learn to trust themselves, to accept themselves completely, to live their feminine aspects, to be able to cooperate without fear, and to use their gifts of diplomacy, listening and intuition. In excess it indicates that the person has to strengthen the aspects of the 2 in order to avoid vulnerability, excessive submissiveness and the tendency to let themselves be handled by others, without reacting out of too much shyness.
desafios.3: In deficiency it is an invitation to work on verbal or artistic expression, to communicate with others through kindness, cheerfulness and perhaps a sense of humour. It is an invitation to enjoy life, here and now. In excess, an invitation to a more inward life without the need to be the centre of attention or to be recognised by others in order to exist.
desafios.4: In deficiency it means that the person has to find their roots in the Earth and live abundance It is an invitation to be more methodical, organised and responsible The person has to get down to work and build their stability solidly on this Earth A 4 challenge can reveal fears of any kind. In excess it invites them not to become obsessed with work, responsibility and material security
desafios.5: In deficiency it is an invitation to open yourself to freedom and to life You have to learn to have greater mobility, to take changes in flexibly, to accept risks and adventures, with the wish to open up at every level. In excess it is advisable to learn to centre yourself in order to control impulses or impatience, to handle your freedom more wisely and to rein in your tendency to instability or change. The person has to learn not to embark on experiences that may be dangerous or high-risk. In short, they have to try to tame this fiery, wilful horse overflowing with energy.
desafios.6: In deficiency the person has to work on opening the heart, on generosity, on the expression of love, on emotional responsibility They also have to learn to trust themselves, to indulge themselves and look after themselves lovingly, so that they radiate love without frustrations They have a right to live pleasure and well-being in their life. In excess it is an invitation not to load themselves up too much with emotional responsibilities, to handle their emotions and their sensitivity with more balance and not to fall into the trap of sacrificing themselves for everyone.
desafios.7: In deficiency the person has to work at the inner level to find their spiritual path through becoming conscious or through personal reflection. It is also a suggestion to use their mental capacities more with a view to researching or studying. In excess it is a proposal to lower the level of demand they place on themselves, to come out of their inner world and open up to others, coming down more towards the realm of the heart and of the material. It is an invitation to come down from the heights, from their ivory tower, so as to share social and family life with others, giving up an attitude of reserve and coldness.
desafios.8: In deficiency the person has to learn to be conscious of their talents, to know how to use them to fulfil themselves in life They have to undertake more concrete achievements with the idea of asserting their power of alchemy over the Earth. In excess it is a proposal to control their desires for power, for ambition or for seeking their own gain It is an invitation to master their intolerant tendencies, their excessive pride and an excessive omnipotence.

anioPersonal.1: It represents the beginning of a personal cycle in which we can undertake new activities, throw ourselves into innovative projects and assert our identity. It is a year during which we sow new seeds that will determine the following nine years. It is a very important year because it gives us a dynamic energy capable of changing our life. Year 1 corresponds to the drive of the fiery knight throwing himself into new adventures.
anioPersonal.3: It is a year during which we begin to harvest what we sowed in a year 1 For example, a project that begins in a year 1 ripens in a year 2 and bears fruit in a year 3. It is a year of openness, creativity and happiness During this year we need to be with friends, to go out, to share and to make the most of life. It is a year of such openness to life and to joy that it calls for a certain discipline so as not to scatter yourself. It is generally a pleasant and easy year
anioPersonal.4: After the joy and the openness of life we come back to the energy of the earth. Year 4 is marked by responsibility, work and concrete achievements. It is a year in which stability and balance are needed. During this year the faculties of perseverance, organisation and seriousness can be developed. It is a year without much fantasy, during which we have to feel secure on the earth.
anioPersonal.5: After living the stability of year 4 we need to renew our life with other projects and experiences; it is a year of openness and freedom. The energy of a year 5 can be compared with that of a year 1. It is a year of fire, dynamic and vigorous, endowed with a vital energy that gives us the chance to change the direction of a cycle that began with difficulties. It is a year full of possibilities for expansion and adventure, in which we need to travel, to move, to meet new friends; it is a year of individual freedom. It is advisable to avoid excess of activity or scattering yourself.
anioPersonal.6: After the whirlwind of year 5 we need stability and inner harmony Year 6 calls for tenderness, love and understanding of others. It is a year of intense emotions during which we express our love and surround ourselves with a warm atmosphere. It is a year ruled by the home and family responsibilities During this year we want to look after others and, at the same time, to be pampered and protected. It is a year of peace and harmony throughout which we want to make our peace with everyone. There is a risk of shutting ourselves into our comfortable nest and so avoiding facing life's difficulties. It can be a year of great vulnerability in which emotions are lived on the surface. For its emotions and its sensitivity it can be compared with a personal year 2.
anioPersonal.7: After a year 6 of harmony and peace we enter a year of reflection, of inwardness and meditation. It is a year in which we need to isolate ourselves and keep our distance from others and from life. It is a year of questions and reflections in order to make progress on our path, a year for studying, researching and walking a spiritual path. It can be a hard year to live, because of the loneliness and the tendency to depression That is why it is important to carry through our need to learn, to write or to create. It is a mental year during which we can escape from reality
anioPersonal.8: After living a rather mental year we come back to the energy of the earth A year 8 is a powerful year during which we can throw ourselves into making new projects and achievements concrete. It is a dynamic year that invites us to use our resources in order to fulfil ourselves and create new energies. During this year we have more abundance and prosperity thanks to what we sowed during the cycle. We need to be recognised by others through our material achievements It is a productive year, full of strength and energy.
anioPersonal.9: After the achievements of year 8 we move to a year of taking stock It is the last year of the personal cycle and it is lived following the tendency of the cycle. If the cycle was a hard one at the material or emotional level, year 9 will probably be delicate If the cycle was positive, rich in experiences and in processes of evolution, year 9 will be lived more serenely. A year 9 is a year during which we need to clean up the past, and to open ourselves to other dimensions in order to prepare the future. It is an uncomfortable year because it is lived between the past and the future and also because situations or periods of life come to an end in it: e.g. selling a house, closing businesses, divorces, losing loved ones So it is advisable not to start new projects officially, because it is an end-of-cycle energy. Even so, it is the moment to open ourselves to other possibilities or paths that will be confirmed in the following year 1.

etapas9.1: It runs from our birth to the age of 8. This cycle represents our early childhood, the way we relate to our parents and the way we live our own identity. It is a cycle that will mark us for the rest of our life, because during this cycle we begin to assert ourselves as people, But at the same time we depend on our parents, who play a dominant role during our life
etapas9.2: It runs from the age of 9 to the age of 17; it corresponds to adolescence. This cycle is lived with the energy of the 2, an energy of doubt or duality, of emotional loads and great questions. The relationship with the mother is very important during this period It is a cycle in which you look for your own identity with the need to free yourself from the model of the father and the mother. It is one of the most delicate cycles of life. Normally it is a cycle of inner rebellion, of crisis, of searching for our identity If it is not, the person will live their crisis as an adult
etapas9.3: It runs from the age of 18 to the age of 26. It is the cycle of opening up to the world, it is the moment to leave the family nest, to start studying or to throw yourself into working life. Normally it is a period of release, joy, creativity and communication After the hesitations of adolescence, the person opens up to the Sun of life. In this cycle you live experiences of love, commitments (marriage), travel and an intellectual opening that corresponds to studying. In principle it is a cycle of happiness and enjoyment.
etapas9.4: It runs from the age of 27 to the age of 35. It is the cycle of stability and of building solid roots It is the period of motherhood, of consolidating the family circle, of the financial prosperity that lets you buy a home and feel more stable on the Earth. It is a cycle of responsibility, work and material building, during which we construct our frames of life. It is a cycle related to the energy of the Earth.
etapas9.5: It runs from the age of 36 to the age of 44. After living the stability and seriousness of the 4 the person needs to open up to other horizons and experience freedom. It is a cycle of movement, of changes, of new challenges It can be a cycle of crisis with a partner, personal or professional The person who has not lived their adolescent crisis will do so during this cycle. It has the energy of fire, with drive and vitality, which makes it possible to change your own frames radically. It is a frame of intellectual and spiritual opening It is a central cycle, where new offers appear that will determine the second part of our life.
etapas9.6: It runs from the age of 45 to the age of 53. After living the storm of cycle 5 we come back to peace and harmony. It is a cycle marked by family responsibility, love and tenderness It is a period during which we need emotional quiet and security. In the case of the mother who devoted so much time to bringing up the children, it is a privileged moment for looking after herself, respecting herself and perhaps starting creative activities. It is a cycle marked by emotions, feelings and perhaps vulnerability.
etapas9.7: It runs from the age of 54 to the age of 62. After the harmony, inner peace and serenity of the previous cycle we enter a cycle of inner searching and of questions about our life. It is a cycle of intellectual and spiritual opening during which we want to study and learn again It is a moment in which we need solitude and time to reflect, in order to fulfil our inner growth. It is a demanding cycle that takes us along a spiritual path capable of giving answers to the questions of our life. Who am I now? What have I made of my life so far?
etapas9.8: It runs from the age of 63 to the age of 71. After reflecting during the previous cycle we enter a dynamic and wonderful cycle that offers us the chance to make use of the talents we have not used until then The talents represent what we like in life. In this cycle everything can be tried It is a cycle of achievement that spurs us to get past life's frustrations; someone who fancies painting or playing the guitar could start doing it at this moment. It is a cycle in which we can assert our potential in life with enthusiasm.
etapas9.9: It runs from the age of 72 to the age of 80. After fulfilling ourselves at various levels during cycle 8 we enter a cycle of inner opening and of taking stock. In this cycle we need to clean ourselves inwardly and, at the same time, to open ourselves spiritually with the aim of preparing to pass into other dimensions. It is a cycle of inner retreat in which we need to connect with divine love and inner peace. This cycle is the reflection of our life If we have had a life serenity and peace, cycle 9 will be lived in that way If, on the contrary, we have not fulfilled our evolutionary project, this cycle can be a cycle of anguish and fears. AFTER 80: After the age of 80 we enter cycle 10 with the same energy as cycle 1 but with less intensity and with the experience of a long life. After the age of 89 we enter cycle 11 2 with the same energy as in cycle 2 but with more wisdom.

0.pos: Spiritual rescue. Searching, taking a risk.
0.neg: Blockage, stagnation, neglect. I do not know what to do.

1.pos: Spiritual life. Faith. God, action in matter.
1.neg: Distrust, insecurity, denial of the spiritual.

3.pos: Fertile life and deeds, abundance, I share my gifts.
3.neg: Negativity, mental blockage, denial of my essence.

4.pos: Fulfilment in matter, acceptance of the world.
4.neg: Fears in matter, rational limitation, material scarcity.

5.neg: Identity crisis, low self-esteem, easily influenced.

6.pos: The right spiritual focus in matter, I accept my part.

7.neg: Superficiality, I do not accept my darkness.

9.pos: Inner certainty, wisdom. Listening to the heart.
9.neg: Self-demand, control, self-sabotage, dictatorship of the mind.

estructuras.iguales: Companions in life, they do not generate great passion. Neither is a source of growth for the other. Great understanding of one another. Possibly twin souls.
estructuras.distintas: This is what you want in a couple. Where one has a task, the other has karmic capital.

portales.2: They want to be right before they love. They will not give an inch. Pride.
portales.3: A mental labyrinth. Indecision. They put things off.
portales.4: An inferiority complex. Does not find any communication with their partner. Does not set limits.
portales.5: Identity crisis. Low self-esteem. Emotional vulnerability, very easily influenced. The men look for their mothers in their partners.
portales.6: The capacity to love, sexuality. Joy of living, impotence, frigidity.
portales.7: Specific to the couple = roots. Submissive in the relationship, I do not value myself.
portales.8: The portal of relationships. Quarrelsome. I either freeze or I go off.
portales.10: People with no will, dissatisfied, frustrated.

combinaciones.1+7: Negative people (glass half empty). They reproach the other. «The world is shit, I am shit.»

planos.4: Neglectful. Always running at half throttle: they have something to do and, knowing how to do it, they leave it half done.
planos.5: Self-acceptance. Held-in rage, they blow up. Arrogance. Anger. They load up and flare up without limit.
planos.6: The ego. A tendency to put on masks and to say what others want to hear. Emotional immaturity.
planos.7: Excessive fear about money and the family finances. An obsession with controlling my resources and my partner's.
planos.8: They do not manage their lives emotionally. No emotional intelligence. Hysteria, emotional manipulation.
planos.9: A tendency to be demanding, controlling, jealous, obsessive. A military father.
planos.10: «This is how I am and this is how you have to accept me.»

cuentas.mismaCuenta: The same number in open accounts: we hurt each other in another life. A karmic reunion.
cuentas.mismoPotencial: The same number in archaic potential: we act as a mirror for each other to help bring out our potential.
cuentas.cruzado: The same number in one's open account and the other's archaic potential: one helps the other settle their open account.
cuentas.afinidad: Matching affinity numbers: this is the whole load carried in the karma. People who vibrate the same way. It gives us information in the case of twin souls.
